AlbumSort_Tooltip.comment: Tooltip on the album wall's sort button.

AlbumSort_Artist.comment: Album wall sort order: by album artist, then album name.

AlbumSort_Album.comment: Album wall sort order: by the record's own name.

AlbumSort_Added.comment: Album wall sort order: newest in the library first.

AlbumSort_Year.comment: Album wall sort order: newest release first; untagged records last.

AlbumSort_Plays.comment: Album wall sort order: most listened to first.

AlbumGrid_PlayAll.comment: Tooltip on the play button in an open album band (album grid).

AlbumGrid_Shuffle.comment: Tooltip on the shuffle button in an open album band (album grid).

AlbumGrid_CoverSize.comment: Tooltip on the cover-size slider in the album grid header.

AddMusic_CdHint.en: Rip a disc in your drive
AddMusic_CdHint.fr: Extraire un disque de votre lecteur
AddMusic_CdHint.es: Extraer un disco de la unidad

AddMusic_DvdHint.fr: Extraire l’audio d’un DVD de concert
AddMusic_DvdHint.es: Extraer el audio de un DVD de concierto
AddMusic_DvdHint.zh-Hans: 抓取演唱会 DVD 的音频

AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCss.en: This DVD is copy-protected. Install libdvdcss (run “brew install libdvdcss”) and try again.
AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCss.fr: Ce DVD est protégé contre la copie. Installez libdvdcss (« brew install libdvdcss ») puis réessayez.
AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCss.es: Este DVD está protegido contra copia. Instala libdvdcss («brew install libdvdcss») e inténtalo de nuevo.
AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCss.de: Diese DVD ist kopiergeschützt. Installieren Sie libdvdcss („brew install libdvdcss“) und versuchen Sie es erneut.
AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCss.zh-Hans: 此 DVD 有防拷贝保护。请安装 libdvdcss（运行“brew install libdvdcss”）后重试。

AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCssWindows.en: This DVD is copy-protected. rpm can rip it with libdvdcss-2.dll, which it does not ship. Download the 64-bit build from videolan.org, then browse for it below.
AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCssWindows.fr: Ce DVD est protégé contre la copie. rpm peut l’extraire avec libdvdcss-2.dll, qu’il ne fournit pas. Téléchargez la version 64 bits sur videolan.org, puis recherchez-la ci-dessous.
AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCssWindows.es: Este DVD está protegido contra copia. rpm puede extraerlo con libdvdcss-2.dll, que no incluye. Descarga la versión de 64 bits desde videolan.org y búscala abajo.
AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCssWindows.de: Diese DVD ist kopiergeschützt. rpm kann sie mit libdvdcss-2.dll auslesen, die nicht mitgeliefert wird. Laden Sie die 64-Bit-Version von videolan.org herunter und suchen Sie sie unten aus.
AddMusic_DvdNeedsLibDvdCssWindows.zh-Hans: 此 DVD 有防拷贝保护。rpm 可借助 libdvdcss-2.dll 抓取，但不随附该文件。请从 videolan.org 下载 64 位版本，然后在下方浏览选择。

AddMusic_LibDvdCssInstalled.en: libdvdcss installed. Reading the disc again…
AddMusic_LibDvdCssInstalled.fr: libdvdcss installé. Nouvelle lecture du disque…
AddMusic_LibDvdCssInstalled.es: libdvdcss instalado. Leyendo el disco de nuevo…
AddMusic_LibDvdCssInstalled.de: libdvdcss installiert. Disc wird erneut gelesen…
AddMusic_LibDvdCssInstalled.zh-Hans: 已安装 libdvdcss。正在重新读取光盘…

AddMusic_LookupSignIn.en: Sign in to your rpm account to identify the disc. You can still rip it and type the titles in.
AddMusic_LookupSignIn.fr: Connectez-vous à votre compte rpm pour identifier le disque. Vous pouvez quand même l'extraire et saisir les titres.
AddMusic_LookupSignIn.es: Inicia sesión en tu cuenta rpm para identificar el disco. Aun así puedes extraerlo y escribir los títulos.
AddMusic_LookupSignIn.de: Melde dich bei deinem rpm-Konto an, um die Disc zu identifizieren. Du kannst sie trotzdem rippen und die Titel eintippen.
AddMusic_LookupSignIn.zh-Hans: 登录您的 rpm 账户即可识别光盘。您仍然可以抓取光盘并手动输入曲目名称。
AddMusic_LookupSignIn.comment: Status line in the rip window when a disc is inserted while signed out.

AddMusic_LookupFailed.es: No se pudo buscar el disco

AddMusic_NoDisc.en: No audio CD in the drive
AddMusic_NoDisc.fr: Aucun CD audio dans le lecteur
AddMusic_NoDisc.es: No hay ningún CD de audio en la unidad
AddMusic_NoDisc.zh-Hans: 驱动器中没有音频 CD

AddMusic_NoDrive.es: No se encontró ninguna unidad de disco

AddMusic_NoDvd.en: No video DVD in the drive
AddMusic_NoDvd.fr: Aucun DVD vidéo dans le lecteur
AddMusic_NoDvd.es: No hay ningún DVD de vídeo en la unidad
AddMusic_NoDvd.zh-Hans: 驱动器中没有视频 DVD

AddMusic_PendingDeleteBody.en: The ripped files will be removed. The disc itself is untouched. You can always rip it again.
AddMusic_PendingDeleteBody.fr: Les fichiers extraits seront supprimés. Le disque lui-même n’est pas touché. Vous pourrez toujours le réextraire.
AddMusic_PendingDeleteBody.es: Se eliminarán los archivos extraídos. El disco en sí no se toca: siempre puedes volver a extraerlo.
AddMusic_PendingDeleteBody.de: Die gerippten Dateien werden entfernt. Die Disc selbst bleibt unangetastet. Du kannst sie jederzeit erneut rippen.
AddMusic_PendingDeleteBody.zh-Hans: 抓取得到的文件将被删除。光盘本身不受影响，你随时可以重新抓取。

AddMusic_PendingIntro.en: These discs were ripped but never taken into the collection. Import one without ripping the disc again, or delete it.
AddMusic_PendingIntro.fr: Ces disques ont été extraits mais jamais ajoutés à la collection. Importez-en un sans réextraire le disque, ou supprimez-le.
AddMusic_PendingIntro.es: Estos discos se extrajeron pero nunca se añadieron a la colección. Importa uno sin volver a extraer el disco, o elimínalo.
AddMusic_PendingIntro.de: Diese Discs wurden gerippt, aber nie in die Sammlung übernommen. Importiere eine, ohne die Disc erneut zu rippen, oder lösche sie.
AddMusic_PendingIntro.zh-Hans: 这些光盘已抓取，但从未加入音乐收藏。可直接导入而无需重新抓取，或将其删除。

AddMusic_UnknownDisc.en: Could not automatically identify the disc
AddMusic_UnknownDisc.es: No se pudo identificar el disco automáticamente
AddMusic_UnknownDisc.de: Die Disc konnte nicht automatisch erkannt werden

AddMusic_VerifyHint.en: Verifying reads every track twice and compares them. Catches a scratched disc, and takes about twice as long.
AddMusic_VerifyHint.fr: La vérification lit chaque piste deux fois et les compare. Détecte un disque rayé, et prend environ deux fois plus de temps.
AddMusic_VerifyHint.es: La verificación lee cada pista dos veces y las compara. Detecta un disco rayado y tarda aproximadamente el doble.
AddMusic_VerifyHint.de: Die Überprüfung liest jeden Titel zweimal und vergleicht sie. Erkennt eine zerkratzte Disc und dauert etwa doppelt so lange.
AddMusic_VerifyHint.zh-Hans: 校验会将每首曲目读取两次并比对。可发现划伤的光盘，耗时约为两倍。

AddMusic_VinylHint.en: Record from a turntable or line-in
AddMusic_VinylHint.fr: Enregistrer depuis une platine ou une entrée ligne
AddMusic_VinylHint.es: Grabar desde un tocadiscos o entrada de línea
AddMusic_VinylHint.zh-Hans: 从唱机或线路输入录制

Art_CtxPictureCount.comment: Artwork header right-click menu, informational top line: which backdrop of how many is shown.

Art_CtxPrevPicture.comment: Artwork header right-click menu: flip to the previous artist backdrop.

Art_CtxNextPicture.comment: Artwork header right-click menu: flip to the next artist backdrop.

Art_CtxChooseImage.comment: Artwork header right-click menu: pick a picture from this computer to use as the artist's artwork.

Art_CtxRefreshArtwork.comment: Artwork header right-click menu: re-fetch and re-rank this artist's backdrops.

Art_CtxRemovePicture.comment: Artwork right-click menu: takes the picture on the header off this artist for good.

Art_CtxPositionArtwork.comment: Artwork header right-click menu: open the window that places the artist's photo by hand.

ArtPlace_Title.comment: Title of the window that places an artist's photo in the header by hand.

ArtPlace_Zoom.comment: Position artwork window: slider label, how far into the photo the header is zoomed.

ArtPlace_Width.comment: Position artwork window: slider label, how far the photo reaches across the header before the record.

ArtPlace_Across.comment: Position artwork window: slider label, where the photo sits left to right.

ArtPlace_Down.comment: Position artwork window: slider label, where the photo sits top to bottom.

ArtPlace_Percent.comment: Position artwork window: the value beside a slider, as a percentage.

ArtPlace_UseApp.comment: Position artwork window: button that gives the photo back to the app's automatic placement.

ArtPlace_FitWhole.comment: Position artwork window: button that zooms all the way out, so the header shows as much of the photo as it can fit.

ArtPlace_Save.comment: Position artwork window: the confirm button.

ArtPlace_Hint.en: Drag the picture to move it, scroll to zoom.
ArtPlace_Hint.fr: Faites glisser l'image pour la déplacer, faites défiler pour zoomer.
ArtPlace_Hint.es: Arrastra la imagen para moverla, desplázate para hacer zoom.
ArtPlace_Hint.de: Bild zum Verschieben ziehen, zum Zoomen scrollen.
ArtPlace_Hint.zh-Hans: 拖动图片可移动，滚动可缩放。
ArtPlace_Hint.comment: Position artwork window: how to use the preview.

ArtPlace_ByHand.comment: Position artwork window: status, the photo is placed by hand rather than by the app.

ArtPlace_ByApp.comment: Position artwork window: status, the photo is placed automatically.

ArtPlace_Loading.comment: Position artwork window: shown while the photo is being fetched.

ArtPlace_NoPicture.en: This picture could not be loaded.
ArtPlace_NoPicture.es: No se pudo cargar esta imagen.
ArtPlace_NoPicture.de: Dieses Bild konnte nicht geladen werden.
ArtPlace_NoPicture.comment: Position artwork window: shown when the photo cannot be fetched or decoded.

Art_ParkedTagline.zh-Hans: 重新发现你的音乐收藏
Art_ParkedTagline.comment: Tagline beside the rpm mark in the parked header, when nothing is playing.

Catalog_DiscogsConnectFailed.en: Discogs did not finish connecting. Try again.
Catalog_DiscogsConnectFailed.fr: Discogs n'a pas terminé la connexion. Réessayez.
Catalog_DiscogsConnectFailed.es: Discogs no terminó de conectarse. Inténtelo de nuevo.
Catalog_DiscogsConnectFailed.de: Discogs hat die Verbindung nicht abgeschlossen. Versuchen Sie es erneut.
Catalog_DiscogsConnectFailed.zh-Hans: Discogs 未能完成连接。请重试。

Catalog_DiscogsPending.en: Finish signing in to Discogs in your browser, then check again.
Catalog_DiscogsPending.fr: Terminez la connexion à Discogs dans votre navigateur, puis vérifiez à nouveau.
Catalog_DiscogsPending.es: Termine de iniciar sesión en Discogs en su navegador y vuelva a comprobar.
Catalog_DiscogsPending.de: Schließen Sie die Anmeldung bei Discogs in Ihrem Browser ab und prüfen Sie dann erneut.
Catalog_DiscogsPending.zh-Hans: 请在浏览器中完成 Discogs 登录，然后重新检查。

Catalog_DiscogsSignIn.de: melde dich zuerst bei rpm an
Catalog_DiscogsSignIn.comment: Discogs status in Catalogues settings when nobody is signed in to rpm.

Catalog_DiscogsWhy.en: Discogs is catalogued by the people who own the records, so pressings the rpm database does not have are usually there. Connecting your own account means your searches count against your rate limit rather than one shared by every rpm user.
Catalog_DiscogsWhy.fr: Discogs est catalogué par les propriétaires des disques : les pressages absents de la base rpm s'y trouvent en général. Avec votre propre compte, vos recherches comptent sur votre quota et non sur celui partagé par tous les utilisateurs de rpm.
Catalog_DiscogsWhy.es: Discogs lo cataloga la gente que tiene los discos, así que los prensajes que no están en la base de datos de rpm suelen estar ahí. Al conectar tu cuenta, tus búsquedas cuentan en tu límite y no en uno compartido por todos los usuarios de rpm.
Catalog_DiscogsWhy.de: Discogs wird von den Leuten katalogisiert, denen die Platten gehören. Pressungen, die in der rpm-Datenbank fehlen, sind dort meist zu finden. Mit einem eigenen Konto zählen deine Suchen auf dein Limit statt auf eines, das sich alle rpm-Nutzer teilen.
Catalog_DiscogsWhy.zh-Hans: Discogs 由唱片持有者共同编目，rpm 数据库没有收录的压片通常在这里能找到。连接你自己的账户后，搜索计入你自己的调用额度，而不是所有 rpm 用户共用的额度。

Catalog_Intro.en: Where rpm looks when you look an album up. Searching needs an rpm account; connect a Discogs account to search Discogs too.
Catalog_Intro.fr: Où rpm cherche lorsque vous recherchez un album. La recherche nécessite un compte rpm ; connectez un compte Discogs pour interroger Discogs aussi.
Catalog_Intro.es: Dónde busca rpm cuando consultas un álbum. Buscar requiere una cuenta rpm; conecta una cuenta de Discogs para consultar Discogs también.
Catalog_Intro.de: Wo rpm sucht, wenn du ein Album nachschlägst. Die Suche benötigt ein rpm-Konto; verbinde ein Discogs-Konto, um auch Discogs zu durchsuchen.
Catalog_Intro.zh-Hans: 查找专辑时 rpm 会搜索的位置。搜索需要 rpm 账户；连接 Discogs 账户即可一并搜索 Discogs。

Catalog_RpmSearched.es: Siempre se consulta. Nada que conectar.
Catalog_RpmSearched.de: Wird immer durchsucht. Nichts zu verbinden.
Catalog_RpmSearched.zh-Hans: 始终参与搜索。无需连接。
Catalog_RpmSearched.comment: RPM catalogue status on the Catalog settings page, signed in.

Catalog_RpmSignIn.en: Sign in to your rpm account to search the catalogues.
Catalog_RpmSignIn.fr: Connectez-vous à votre compte rpm pour interroger les catalogues.
Catalog_RpmSignIn.es: Inicia sesión en tu cuenta rpm para buscar en los catálogos.
Catalog_RpmSignIn.de: Melde dich bei deinem rpm-Konto an, um die Kataloge zu durchsuchen.
Catalog_RpmSignIn.zh-Hans: 登录您的 rpm 账户即可搜索唱片目录。
Catalog_RpmSignIn.comment: RPM catalogue status on the Catalog settings page, signed out.

Catalog_FanartWhy.en: rpm gets artist photos, square artist pictures and logos from fanart.tv. Add your own free fanart.tv personal key to get new images after 2 days instead of 7. The key is saved to your rpm account and used on all your devices.
Catalog_FanartWhy.fr: rpm récupère les photos d'artistes, les images carrées et les logos sur fanart.tv. Ajoutez votre clé personnelle fanart.tv gratuite pour recevoir les nouvelles images après 2 jours au lieu de 7. La clé est enregistrée dans votre compte rpm et utilisée sur tous vos appareils.
Catalog_FanartWhy.es: rpm obtiene fotos de artistas, imágenes cuadradas y logotipos de fanart.tv. Añade tu clave personal gratuita de fanart.tv para recibir las imágenes nuevas a los 2 días en lugar de a los 7. La clave se guarda en tu cuenta de rpm y se usa en todos tus dispositivos.
Catalog_FanartWhy.de: rpm lädt Künstlerfotos, quadratische Künstlerbilder und Logos von fanart.tv. Füge deinen kostenlosen persönlichen fanart.tv-Schlüssel hinzu, um neue Bilder nach 2 statt nach 7 Tagen zu erhalten. Der Schlüssel wird in deinem rpm-Konto gespeichert und auf allen deinen Geräten verwendet.
Catalog_FanartWhy.zh-Hans: rpm 从 fanart.tv 获取艺人照片、方形艺人图片和标志。添加你自己的免费 fanart.tv 个人密钥，新图片将在 2 天后而不是 7 天后可用。密钥保存在你的 rpm 账户中，并在你的所有设备上使用。
Catalog_FanartWhy.comment: Catalog settings page, fanart.tv section: what fanart.tv provides and what adding a personal key changes.

Catalog_FanartKeyPlaceholder.zh-Hans: fanart.tv 个人 API 密钥
Catalog_FanartKeyPlaceholder.comment: Placeholder in the fanart.tv key box.

Catalog_FanartChecking.fr: Vérification de la clé auprès de fanart.tv…
Catalog_FanartChecking.zh-Hans: 正在向 fanart.tv 验证密钥…
Catalog_FanartChecking.comment: Shown while the pasted fanart.tv key is being verified.

Catalog_FanartKeyRejected.en: fanart.tv did not accept that key, so it was not saved. Check it and try again.
Catalog_FanartKeyRejected.fr: fanart.tv n'a pas accepté cette clé ; elle n'a pas été enregistrée. Vérifiez-la et réessayez.
Catalog_FanartKeyRejected.es: fanart.tv no aceptó esa clave, así que no se guardó. Compruébala e inténtalo de nuevo.
Catalog_FanartKeyRejected.de: fanart.tv hat diesen Schlüssel nicht akzeptiert, er wurde nicht gespeichert. Bitte prüfen und erneut versuchen.
Catalog_FanartKeyRejected.zh-Hans: fanart.tv 未接受该密钥，因此未保存。请检查后重试。
Catalog_FanartKeyRejected.comment: The pasted fanart.tv key was refused by fanart.tv and not stored.

Catalog_FanartKeyUnchecked.en: fanart.tv could not be reached to check the key, so it was not saved. Try again later.
Catalog_FanartKeyUnchecked.fr: fanart.tv est injoignable pour vérifier la clé, elle n'a donc pas été enregistrée. Réessayez plus tard.
Catalog_FanartKeyUnchecked.es: No se pudo contactar con fanart.tv para comprobar la clave, así que no se ha guardado. Inténtalo más tarde.
Catalog_FanartKeyUnchecked.de: fanart.tv war zur Prüfung des Schlüssels nicht erreichbar, daher wurde er nicht gespeichert. Versuche es später erneut.
Catalog_FanartKeyUnchecked.zh-Hans: 无法连接 fanart.tv 验证该密钥，因此未保存。请稍后再试。
Catalog_FanartKeyUnchecked.comment: Catalog settings page: the fanart.tv key was not saved because fanart.tv did not answer the check.

Catalog_FanartConnectedEnding.comment: Catalog settings page, fanart.tv status. {0} is the last four characters of the saved key.

Catalog_FanartSignIn.en: Sign in to add a key
Catalog_FanartSignIn.es: Inicia sesión para añadir una clave
Catalog_FanartSignIn.de: Melde dich an, um einen Schlüssel hinzuzufügen
Catalog_FanartSignIn.comment: Catalog settings page, fanart.tv status when signed out. The key is saved to the account.

Catalog_FanartStatusUnknown.es: No se pudo obtener el estado
Catalog_FanartStatusUnknown.comment: Catalog settings page, fanart.tv status when the rpm server could not be asked.

Catalog_FanartSaveFailed.en: The change could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
Catalog_FanartSaveFailed.fr: La modification n'a pas pu être enregistrée. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
Catalog_FanartSaveFailed.es: No se pudo guardar el cambio. Comprueba tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.
Catalog_FanartSaveFailed.de: Die Änderung konnte nicht gespeichert werden. Prüfe deine Verbindung und versuche es erneut.
Catalog_FanartSaveFailed.zh-Hans: 无法保存更改。请检查网络连接后重试。
Catalog_FanartSaveFailed.comment: Catalog settings page: saving or clearing the fanart.tv key failed because the rpm server could not be reached.

Cloud_Intro.en: Keep your music in the rpm cloud as well as on this computer. Your files stay on disk unless you ask otherwise.
Cloud_Intro.fr: Gardez votre musique dans le cloud rpm en plus de cet ordinateur. Vos fichiers restent sur le disque, sauf demande contraire.
Cloud_Intro.es: Guarda tu música en la nube de rpm además de en este ordenador. Tus archivos permanecen en el disco salvo que indiques lo contrario.
Cloud_Intro.de: Bewahre deine Musik zusätzlich zu diesem Rechner in der rpm-Cloud auf. Deine Dateien bleiben auf der Festplatte, sofern du nichts anderes verlangst.
Cloud_Intro.zh-Hans: 把你的音乐同时保存在 rpm 云端和这台电脑上。除非你另行设置，文件都会留在磁盘上。

Cloud_ModeAllHint.en: Your whole collection, and anything you add.
Cloud_ModeAllHint.fr: Toute votre collection, et tout ce que vous ajoutez.
Cloud_ModeAllHint.es: Toda tu colección y todo lo que añadas.
Cloud_ModeAllHint.de: Deine gesamte Sammlung und alles, was du hinzufügst.
Cloud_ModeAllHint.zh-Hans: 你的整个音乐收藏，以及之后添加的内容。

Cloud_ModeNoneHint.zh-Hans: 任何内容都不会离开这台电脑。

Cloud_ModeSelectedHint.fr: Uniquement les morceaux que vous choisissez.
Cloud_ModeSelectedHint.de: Nur die Titel, die du auswählst.

Cloud_OnlyInCloud.en: Music that is only in the cloud
Cloud_OnlyInCloud.es: Música que solo está en la nube
Cloud_OnlyInCloud.de: Musik, die nur in der Cloud liegt
Cloud_OnlyInCloud.comment: Cloud settings, heading of the card that says what is not on this computer.

Cloud_OnlyInCloudHint.en: rpm never removes your files. If you delete music to free up space, the cloud copy stays, and you can download it again from the right-click menu.
Cloud_OnlyInCloudHint.fr: rpm ne supprime jamais vos fichiers. Si vous supprimez de la musique pour libérer de l'espace, la copie dans le cloud est conservée et vous pouvez la retélécharger depuis le menu contextuel.
Cloud_OnlyInCloudHint.es: rpm nunca elimina tus archivos. Si borras música para liberar espacio, la copia en la nube se conserva y puedes volver a descargarla desde el menú contextual.
Cloud_OnlyInCloudHint.de: rpm entfernt deine Dateien nie. Wenn du Musik löschst, um Platz zu schaffen, bleibt die Cloud-Kopie erhalten, und du kannst sie über das Kontextmenü wieder herunterladen.
Cloud_OnlyInCloudHint.zh-Hans: rpm 从不删除你的文件。如果你为了腾出空间而删除音乐，云端副本会保留，你可以在右键菜单中重新下载。

Cloud_SignInNeeded.en: Sign in to your rpm account to use cloud storage.
Cloud_SignInNeeded.fr: Connectez-vous à votre compte rpm pour utiliser le stockage cloud.
Cloud_SignInNeeded.es: Inicia sesión en tu cuenta rpm para usar el almacenamiento en la nube.
Cloud_SignInNeeded.de: Melde dich bei deinem rpm-Konto an, um Cloud-Speicher zu nutzen.
Cloud_SignInNeeded.zh-Hans: 登录你的 rpm 账户即可使用云存储。

Details_Analysis.comment: Track details > Sound: label on the row shown when a track has not been analysed.

Details_Art.comment: Tab label in the track-details window: the record's cover and the label printed on the disc.

Details_ArtHint.en: The image is embedded into the file when you apply, and written beside the tracks as the album folder's cover.jpg.
Details_ArtHint.fr: L'image est intégrée au fichier lors de l'application, et écrite à côté des pistes comme cover.jpg du dossier de l'album.
Details_ArtHint.es: La imagen se incrusta en el archivo al aplicar, y se guarda junto a las pistas como cover.jpg de la carpeta del álbum.
Details_ArtHint.de: Das Bild wird beim Anwenden in die Datei eingebettet und neben den Titeln als cover.jpg des Albumordners gespeichert.
Details_ArtHint.zh-Hans: 应用时图片会嵌入文件，并作为专辑文件夹的 cover.jpg 保存在音轨旁边。
Details_ArtHint.comment: Hint under the artwork buttons. Both folder-cover writers run unconditionally, so this states what happens rather than referring to a setting.

Details_BeatGrid.comment: Track details > Sound: label for how the beats and bar lines fall.

Details_BeatGridValue.en: {0} beats to the bar, first bar line on beat {1}
Details_BeatGridValue.fr: {0} temps par mesure, première barre sur le temps {1}
Details_BeatGridValue.es: {0} tiempos por compás, primer compás en el tiempo {1}
Details_BeatGridValue.de: {0} Schläge pro Takt, erster Taktstrich auf Schlag {1}
Details_BeatGridValue.zh-Hans: 每小节 {0} 拍，第一个小节线在第 {1} 拍
Details_BeatGridValue.comment: Track details > Sound: {0} beats per bar, {1} the 1-based index of the first downbeat.

Details_BpmCounted.en: Counted as {0} BPM instead of the measured {1}.
Details_BpmCounted.fr: Compté à {0} BPM au lieu des {1} mesurés.
Details_BpmCounted.es: Contado a {0} BPM en lugar de los {1} medidos.
Details_BpmCounted.de: Wird als {0} BPM gezählt statt der gemessenen {1}.
Details_BpmCounted.zh-Hans: 按 {0} BPM 计数，而不是测得的 {1}。
Details_BpmCounted.comment: Track details > Sound: shown when the user has changed how the track is counted. {0} the tempo in use, {1} the tempo the analyser measured.

Details_BpmOtherCount.en: This could also be counted as {0} BPM.

Settings_AnalysisTagsHint.en: rpm works out the tempo and key of every track used in DJ mode. With this on, each track that finishes analysing has them written into its own tags, where a file browser and any other music program can read them. Only empty fields are filled: a value already in a file is left alone.
Settings_AnalysisTagsHint.fr: rpm détermine le tempo et la tonalité de chaque piste utilisée en mode DJ. Avec cette option, chaque piste analysée les reçoit dans ses propres tags, lisibles par un explorateur de fichiers et par tout autre logiciel musical. Seuls les champs vides sont remplis : une valeur déjà présente est conservée.
Settings_AnalysisTagsHint.es: rpm calcula el tempo y la tonalidad de cada pista usada en el modo DJ. Con esto activado, cada pista analizada los recibe en sus propias etiquetas, donde un explorador de archivos y cualquier otro programa de música pueden leerlos. Solo se rellenan los campos vacíos: un valor que ya esté en el archivo se deja intacto.
Settings_AnalysisTagsHint.de: rpm ermittelt Tempo und Tonart jedes Titels, der im DJ-Modus genutzt wird. Settings_HeaderRecordHint.fr: Affiche le disque qui tourne à droite du bandeau. Désactivé, l'illustration occupe toute la largeur.
Settings_HeaderRecordHint.es: Muestra el disco giratorio a la derecha del panel. Desactivado, la imagen ocupa todo el ancho.
Settings_HeaderRecordHint.de: Zeigt die drehende Schallplatte rechts in der Coveranzeige. Aus füllt das Bild die volle Breite.
Settings_HeaderRecordHint.zh-Hans: 在封面展示区右侧显示旋转的唱片。关闭时，图片将铺满整个宽度。
Settings_HeaderRecordHint.comment: Settings > Display: hint under the spinning record toggle.

Settings_HeaderArtistPhoto.comment: Settings > Display: toggle for the artist photograph behind the art display.

Settings_HeaderArtistPhotoHint.en: Show a photo of the artist behind the art display. Off, no photos are downloaded and the album colours are used instead.
Settings_HeaderArtistPhotoHint.fr: Affiche une photo de l'artiste derrière le bandeau. Désactivé, aucune photo n'est téléchargée et les couleurs de l'album sont utilisées.
Settings_HeaderArtistPhotoHint.es: Muestra una foto del artista detrás del panel. Desactivado, no se descargan fotos y se usan los colores del álbum.
Settings_HeaderArtistPhotoHint.de: Zeigt ein Foto des Künstlers hinter der Coveranzeige. Aus werden keine Fotos geladen und stattdessen die Albumfarben verwendet.
Settings_HeaderArtistPhotoHint.zh-Hans: 在封面展示区后面显示艺人照片。关闭时不会下载照片，改用专辑配色。
Settings_HeaderArtistPhotoHint.comment: Settings > Display: hint under the artist photo toggle.

Settings_MultiDisc.comment: Settings > Collection: title of the card choosing how multi-disc releases are handled.

Settings_MultiDiscHint.en: How a release that spans several discs is handled when you rip or import it.
Settings_MultiDiscHint.fr: Comment traiter une publication répartie sur plusieurs disques lors du rip ou de l’import.
Settings_MultiDiscHint.es: Cómo se trata una edición repartida en varios discos al copiarla o importarla.
Settings_MultiDiscHint.de: Wie eine Veröffentlichung über mehrere CDs beim Rippen oder Importieren behandelt wird.
Settings_MultiDiscHint.zh-Hans: 在抓取或导入跨多张碟的发行版时如何处理。

Settings_Fingerprint.fr: Calculer les empreintes de la collection en arrière-plan

Settings_Fingerprint.comment: Settings > Collection: toggle that turns the background Chromaprint pass on or off.

Settings_ShareListening.comment: Settings toggle: send anonymous per-song play counts so album pages can mark the most played track.

Settings_ShareListeningHint.en: Sends a count of how often you play each song, with no times and no history. It marks the most played song on album pages. Turn it off and nothing more is sent.
Settings_ShareListeningHint.fr: Envoie le nombre de fois que vous écoutez chaque morceau, sans horodatage ni historique. Cela met en avant le morceau le plus écouté sur les pages d'album. Désactivez et plus rien n'est envoyé.
Settings_ShareListeningHint.es: Envía cuántas veces reproduces cada canción, sin horas ni historial. Sirve para marcar la canción más escuchada en las páginas de álbum. Desactívalo y no se envía nada más.
Settings_ShareListeningHint.de: Sendet, wie oft Sie jeden Titel spielen, ohne Zeiten und ohne Verlauf. Damit wird der meistgespielte Titel auf Albumseiten markiert. Ausgeschaltet wird nichts mehr gesendet.
Settings_ShareListeningHint.zh-Hans: 发送您播放每首歌曲的次数，不含时间和历史记录。用于在专辑页面标记最常播放的歌曲。关闭后不再发送任何内容。
Settings_ShareListeningHint.comment: Settings hint under the Share what I play toggle: what leaves the computer and what it is for.

Settings_FingerprintHint.en: rpm computes an audio fingerprint for each track and shares it with the recognition service, which makes identifying music better for everyone. It runs in the background and never changes your files.
Settings_FingerprintHint.fr: rpm calcule une empreinte audio pour chaque piste et la partage avec le service de reconnaissance, ce qui améliore l'identification pour tout le monde. Cela tourne en arrière-plan et ne modifie jamais vos fichiers.
Settings_FingerprintHint.es: rpm calcula una huella de audio para cada pista y la comparte con el servicio de reconocimiento, lo que mejora la identificación para todos. Se ejecuta en segundo plano y nunca modifica tus archivos.
Settings_FingerprintHint.de: rpm berechnet für jeden Titel einen Audio-Fingerabdruck und teilt ihn mit dem Erkennungsdienst, was die Identifizierung für alle verbessert. Das läuft im Hintergrund und ändert deine Dateien nie.
Settings_FingerprintHint.zh-Hans: rpm 会为每首曲目计算音频指纹并共享给识别服务，从而让所有人的识别效果更好。它在后台运行，且不会修改你的文件。
Settings_FingerprintHint.comment: Settings > Collection: hint under the fingerprinting toggle.

Settings_Discs.comment: Settings section heading, above the setting that makes rpm the app the machine opens for a music CD.

Settings_DiscDefault.en: Open rpm when a music CD is inserted
Settings_DiscDefault.fr: Ouvrir rpm à l’insertion d’un CD audio
Settings_DiscDefault.es: Abrir rpm al insertar un CD de música
Settings_DiscDefault.de: rpm öffnen, wenn eine Musik-CD eingelegt wird
Settings_DiscDefault.zh-Hans: 插入音乐 CD 时打开 rpm
Settings_DiscDefault.comment: Toggle that registers rpm as the machine's handler for an inserted music CD.

Settings_DiscDefaultHint.en: This computer opens audio discs with rpm instead of its own music app. rpm asks before it rips anything. This is the same setting as the one in the system settings, and either place can change it.
Settings_DiscDefaultHint.fr: Cet ordinateur ouvre les disques audio avec rpm plutôt qu'avec son propre lecteur. rpm demande avant de lancer une extraction. C'est le même réglage que celui du système, et les deux endroits le modifient.
Settings_DiscDefaultHint.es: Este ordenador abre los discos de audio con rpm en lugar de con su propia aplicación de música. rpm pregunta antes de extraer nada. Es el mismo ajuste que el del sistema, y se puede cambiar desde cualquiera de los dos.
Settings_DiscDefaultHint.de: Dieser Rechner öffnet Audio-Discs mit rpm statt mit der eigenen Musik-App. rpm fragt nach, bevor es etwas rippt. Es ist dieselbe Einstellung wie in den Systemeinstellungen, und beide Stellen ändern sie.
Settings_DiscDefaultHint.zh-Hans: 这台电脑用 rpm 而不是系统自带的音乐应用打开音频光盘。rpm 在抓取前会先询问。这与系统设置中的选项是同一项，两处均可更改。

Settings_DiscDefaultUnavailable.en: Only the installed app can be registered, so this is off in a development build.
Settings_DiscDefaultUnavailable.fr: Seule l’application installée peut être enregistrée : ce réglage est donc inactif dans une version de développement.
Settings_DiscDefaultUnavailable.es: Solo se puede registrar la app instalada, así que esto está desactivado en una compilación de desarrollo.
Settings_DiscDefaultUnavailable.de: Registrieren lässt sich nur die installierte App, daher ist dies in einem Entwicklungs-Build deaktiviert.
Settings_DiscDefaultUnavailable.zh-Hans: 只有已安装的应用才能注册，因此开发版本中此项不可用。
Settings_DiscDefaultUnavailable.comment: Shown instead of the disc-handler toggle when the app is not running from an installed bundle.

Settings_DiscDefaultFailed.de: Das System hat die Änderung nicht übernommen.
Settings_DiscDefaultFailed.comment: Shown when writing the disc-handler preference did not take effect.

Settings_BackgroundSheetMusic.comment: Backdrop tile: a printed score in warm sepia, sharp across the middle.

Settings_BackgroundYours.comment: Backdrop tile: the picture the user chose from disk. Only present while one is set.

Settings_LibraryIntro.en: Where your music is kept, how files are named, and what happens when new music comes in.

Settings_LibraryIntro.zh-Hans: 音乐存放的位置、文件的命名方式，以及导入新音乐时的处理方式。

Settings_MusicFolderHint.fr: L’endroit où rpm range votre collection.

Settings_NamingHint.en: How ripped, recorded and imported files are named and filed. Rips and vinyl recordings enter the queue with the default template, and Import files everything the same way. Build your own layout from the tokens below.
Settings_NamingHint.fr: Comment les fichiers extraits, enregistrés et importés sont nommés et classés. Les extractions et les enregistrements vinyle entrent dans la file avec le modèle par défaut, et l'import classe tout de la même manière. Composez votre propre disposition avec les jetons ci-dessous.
Settings_NamingHint.es: Cómo se nombran y archivan los archivos extraídos, grabados e importados. Las extracciones y las grabaciones de vinilo entran en la cola con la plantilla predeterminada, y la importación archiva todo igual. Crea tu propio diseño con los tokens de abajo.
Settings_NamingHint.de: Wie gerippte, aufgenommene und importierte Dateien benannt und abgelegt werden. Rips und Vinyl-Aufnahmen kommen mit der Standardvorlage in die Warteschlange, und der Import legt alles genauso ab. Baue dein eigenes Layout aus den Bausteinen unten.
Settings_NamingHint.zh-Hans: 抓取、录制和导入的文件如何命名与归档。抓取和黑胶录音会以默认模板进入队列，导入也按同样方式归档。可用下方的标记自定义命名格式。

Settings_NamingErrorEmpty.zh-Hans: 每个模板都需要名称和模板字符串。

Setup_ExistingLibrary.en: Existing rpm music folder. It will be opened.

Setup_ExistingLibrary.zh-Hans: 现有的 rpm 音乐文件夹。将直接打开。

Setup_NotEmpty.en: This folder isn't empty. Pick an empty folder, or an existing rpm music folder to open it.
Setup_NotEmpty.fr: Ce dossier n'est pas vide. Choisissez un dossier vide, ou un dossier musical rpm existant pour l'ouvrir.

Split_AlbumHintTooltip.en: The album's length for this track
Split_AlbumHintTooltip.fr: La durée de l'album pour cette piste
Split_AlbumHintTooltip.es: La duración del álbum para esta pista
Split_AlbumHintTooltip.zh-Hans: 此曲目在专辑中的时长

Split_ApplyTimingTooltip.en: Set this track to the album's length
Split_ApplyTimingTooltip.fr: Appliquer la durée de l'album à cette piste
Split_ApplyTimingTooltip.es: Ajustar esta pista a la duración del álbum
Split_ApplyTimingTooltip.de: Diesen Titel auf die Albumlänge setzen
Split_ApplyTimingTooltip.zh-Hans: 将此曲目设为专辑时长

Split_Failed.comment: Split window, when cutting the album into tracks fails. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Split_FileInUse.en: The album file is in use and could not be split. Stop playback and try again.
Split_FileInUse.fr: Le fichier album est en cours d'utilisation et n'a pas pu être découpé. Arrêtez la lecture et réessayez.
Split_FileInUse.es: El archivo del álbum está en uso y no se pudo dividir. Detenga la reproducción e inténtelo de nuevo.
Split_FileInUse.de: Die Albumdatei wird verwendet und konnte nicht geteilt werden. Beenden Sie die Wiedergabe und versuchen Sie es erneut.
Split_FileInUse.zh-Hans: 专辑文件正在使用中，无法分割。请停止播放后重试。
Split_FileInUse.comment: Shown in the split window when the album file is still open after playback was stopped, so the cut was not started.

Split_Intro.en: This file looks like a whole album. Drag the markers on the waveform to place the cuts, name the tracks below, then split. The original is kept in an “Originals” folder beside it, and stays in the queue, so a cut that came out wrong can simply be made again.
Split_Intro.fr: Ce fichier ressemble à un album entier. Déplacez les marqueurs sur la forme d'onde pour placer les coupes, nommez les pistes ci-dessous, puis coupez. L'original est conservé dans un dossier « Originals » à côté et reste dans la file d'attente : une coupe ratée peut donc simplement être refaite.
Split_Intro.es: Este archivo parece un álbum entero. Arrastre los marcadores en la forma de onda para colocar los cortes, nombre las pistas abajo y luego divida. El original se conserva en una carpeta «Originals» junto a él y permanece en la cola, así que un corte que salió mal se puede rehacer sin más.
Split_Intro.de: Diese Datei sieht nach einem ganzen Album aus. Ziehen Sie die Marken in der Wellenform an die Schnittstellen, benennen Sie die Titel unten und teilen Sie dann. Das Original bleibt in einem Ordner „Originals“ daneben erhalten und bleibt in der Warteschlange, ein misslungener Schnitt lässt sich also einfach wiederholen.
Split_Intro.zh-Hans: 此文件看起来是整张专辑。在波形上拖动标记来放置切点，在下方为音轨命名，然后进行切分。原始文件保留在旁边的“Originals”文件夹中，并留在队列里，因此切错了可以直接重来。

Split_IntroRecording.en: The sides you recorded were joined into one long recording. Place the cuts on the waveform (drag a marker, or select a stretch and listen to it), then name the tracks and split.
Split_IntroRecording.fr: Les faces que vous avez enregistrées ont été réunies en un seul long enregistrement. Placez les coupes sur la forme d'onde (déplacez un marqueur, ou sélectionnez un passage et écoutez-le), puis nommez les pistes et coupez.
Split_IntroRecording.es: Las caras que grabaste se unieron en una sola grabación larga. Coloca los cortes en la forma de onda (arrastra un marcador, o selecciona un fragmento y escúchalo), luego nombra las pistas y divide.
Split_IntroRecording.de: Die aufgenommenen Seiten wurden zu einer langen Aufnahme zusammengefügt. Setze die Schnitte in der Wellenform (ziehe eine Marke, oder wähle einen Abschnitt aus und höre ihn), benenne dann die Titel und teile.
Split_IntroRecording.zh-Hans: 你录制的各面已合并为一段长录音。在波形上放置切点（拖动标记，或选择一段试听），然后为曲目命名并拆分。

Split_NeedTwoTracks.en: At least two tracks are needed to split

Split_NeedTwoTracks.zh-Hans: 拆分至少需要两首曲目

Split_RecognizeUnavailable.de: Die Erkennung ist gerade nicht verfügbar.
Split_RecognizeUnavailable.comment: Split window: status when the recognition service cannot look anything up. The service's reason is in the log.

Split_SourceAligned.en: Placed from the album's track durations (no audible gap)
Split_SourceAligned.fr: Placé d'après les durées de l'album (pas de silence audible)
Split_SourceAligned.es: Colocado según las duraciones del álbum (sin silencio audible)
Split_SourceAligned.de: Aus den Titellängen des Albums platziert (keine hörbare Pause)
Split_SourceAligned.zh-Hans: 按专辑曲目时长推算（无可闻间隙）

Split_SourceCue.en: Exact position from the cue sheet
Split_SourceCue.fr: Position exacte d'après la cue sheet
Split_SourceCue.es: Posición exacta según la hoja cue
Split_SourceCue.zh-Hans: 来自 cue 表的精确位置

Split_StatusDetecting.fr: Analyse de l'audio pour trouver les limites de pistes…
Split_StatusDetecting.es: Analizando el audio en busca de límites de pista…
Split_StatusDetecting.zh-Hans: 正在扫描音频以查找曲目边界…

Split_StatusLookingUp.en: Looking the album up in the rpm database…
Split_StatusLookingUp.fr: Recherche de l'album dans la base rpm…
Split_StatusLookingUp.es: Buscando el álbum en la base de datos de rpm…
Split_StatusLookingUp.de: Album wird in der rpm-Datenbank gesucht…
Split_StatusLookingUp.zh-Hans: 正在 rpm 数据库中查找专辑…

Split_TracksFound.zh-Hans: 检测到 {0} 首曲目。可调整后拆分

Vinyl_CalibrateHint.en: Watch the meters while a loud passage plays. Aim for peaks near the top without lighting the red clip indicators.
Vinyl_CalibrateHint.fr: Surveillez les indicateurs pendant un passage fort. Visez des crêtes proches du sommet sans allumer les témoins d'écrêtage rouges.
Vinyl_CalibrateHint.es: Observe los medidores durante un pasaje fuerte: busque picos cerca del máximo sin encender los indicadores rojos de saturación.
Vinyl_CalibrateHint.de: Beobachten Sie die Pegelanzeigen bei einer lauten Passage. Spitzen nahe am oberen Rand, ohne die roten Übersteuerungsanzeigen auszulösen.
Vinyl_CalibrateHint.zh-Hans: 在响亮的段落播放时观察电平表。让峰值接近顶部，但不要点亮红色削波指示灯。

Vinyl_DeviceIntro.en: Choose the input your turntable is connected to.
Vinyl_DeviceIntro.fr: Choisissez l'entrée à laquelle votre platine est connectée.
Vinyl_DeviceIntro.es: Elige la entrada a la que está conectado tu tocadiscos.
Vinyl_DeviceIntro.de: Wählen Sie den Eingang, an dem Ihr Plattenspieler angeschlossen ist.
Vinyl_DeviceIntro.zh-Hans: 选择唱机所连接的输入端。
Vinyl_DeviceIntro.comment: Hint under the INPUT heading, step 1 of Record from vinyl.

Vinyl_Gain.comment: Field label on the input gain slider, step 1 of Record from vinyl.

Vinyl_InputDevice.comment: Field label on the input picker, step 1 of Record from vinyl.

Vinyl_MonitorOffMic.en: Monitoring is off: this looks like a microphone, and playing it through the speakers would feed back. Turn it on if you are using headphones.
Vinyl_MonitorOffMic.fr: L'écoute est désactivée : ceci semble être un microphone, et le diffuser par les haut-parleurs provoquerait un effet Larsen. Activez-la si vous utilisez un casque.
Vinyl_MonitorOffMic.es: La monitorización está desactivada: esto parece un micrófono y reproducirlo por los altavoces provocaría acoplamiento. Actívela si usa auriculares.
Vinyl_MonitorOffMic.de: Mithören ist aus: Das sieht nach einem Mikrofon aus, und über die Lautsprecher würde es rückkoppeln. Schalten Sie es ein, wenn Sie Kopfhörer verwenden.
Vinyl_MonitorOffMic.zh-Hans: 监听已关闭：这看起来是麦克风，通过扬声器播放会产生啸叫。如果您使用耳机，可以打开它。

Vinyl_MonitorOffUnknown.en: Monitoring is off: this input cannot be identified, so it might be a microphone. Turn it on if it is a turntable, or if you are using headphones.
Vinyl_MonitorOffUnknown.fr: L'écoute est désactivée : cette entrée n'a pas pu être identifiée et pourrait être un microphone. Activez-la s'il s'agit d'une platine ou si vous utilisez un casque.
Vinyl_MonitorOffUnknown.es: La monitorización está desactivada: no se puede identificar esta entrada y podría ser un micrófono. Actívela si es un tocadiscos o si usa auriculares.
Vinyl_MonitorOffUnknown.de: Mithören ist aus: Dieser Eingang lässt sich nicht identifizieren und könnte ein Mikrofon sein. Schalten Sie es ein, wenn es ein Plattenspieler ist oder Sie Kopfhörer verwenden.
Vinyl_MonitorOffUnknown.zh-Hans: 监听已关闭：无法识别此输入，它可能是麦克风。如果它是唱机，或您使用耳机，可以打开。

Vinyl_MoveSideDown.fr: Déplacer cette face vers le bas

Vinyl_MoveSideUp.fr: Déplacer cette face vers le haut

Vinyl_NoInput.en: No audio input is available. Connect a turntable or audio interface and reopen this wizard.
Vinyl_NoInput.fr: Aucune entrée audio disponible. Connectez une platine ou une interface audio et rouvrez cet assistant.
Vinyl_NoInput.es: No hay entrada de audio disponible. Conecte un tocadiscos o una interfaz de audio y vuelva a abrir este asistente.
Vinyl_NoInput.de: Kein Audioeingang verfügbar. Schließen Sie einen Plattenspieler oder ein Audiointerface an und öffnen Sie diesen Assistenten erneut.
Vinyl_NoInput.zh-Hans: 没有可用的音频输入。请连接唱机或音频接口后重新打开此向导。

Vinyl_RecordIntro.en: Record one side at a time. Stop when the side ends, then flip the record.
Vinyl_RecordIntro.fr: Enregistrez une face à la fois. Arrêtez à la fin de la face, puis retournez le disque.
Vinyl_RecordIntro.es: Graba una cara cada vez. Detén la grabación al terminar la cara y da la vuelta al disco.
Vinyl_RecordIntro.de: Nehmen Sie eine Seite nach der anderen auf. Stoppen Sie am Ende der Seite und drehen Sie die Platte um.
Vinyl_RecordIntro.zh-Hans: 一次录制一面。该面结束后停止，然后翻面。
Vinyl_RecordIntro.comment: Hint under the RECORD heading, step 2 of Record from vinyl.

Vinyl_RecordKicker.comment: Heading over the transport controls, step 2 of Record from vinyl.

Vinyl_SideDone.en: Side saved. Record another side, or finish and split.
Vinyl_SideDone.fr: Face enregistrée. Enregistrez une autre face ou terminez et découpez.
Vinyl_SideDone.es: Cara guardada. Grabe otra cara o finalice y divida.
Vinyl_SideDone.de: Seite gespeichert. Nehmen Sie eine weitere Seite auf oder beenden und aufteilen.
Vinyl_SideDone.zh-Hans: 已保存该面。可录制另一面，或完成并分割。

Vinyl_SidesEmpty.en: No sides yet. Record side 1, then flip the record and record side 2.
Vinyl_SidesEmpty.fr: Aucune face pour l'instant. Enregistrez la face 1, puis retournez le disque et enregistrez la face 2.
Vinyl_SidesEmpty.es: Aún no hay caras. Graba la cara 1, luego da la vuelta al disco y graba la cara 2.
Vinyl_SidesEmpty.de: Noch keine Seiten. Nehmen Sie Seite 1 auf, drehen Sie dann die Platte um und nehmen Sie Seite 2 auf.
Vinyl_SidesEmpty.zh-Hans: 尚无录制的面。先录制第 1 面，然后翻面录制第 2 面。
Vinyl_SidesEmpty.comment: Empty state of the sides list, step 2 of Record from vinyl.

Vinyl_SidesKicker.comment: Heading over the list of recorded sides, step 2 of Record from vinyl.

Lookup_ClearTooltip.fr: Vider tous les champs de recherche
Lookup_ClearTooltip.es: Vaciar todos los campos de búsqueda

AlbumMenu_AddToCloud.comment: Album context-menu item: upload the whole album to the cloud.

Delete_Menu.comment: Label of the Delete submenu on the album, track and library context menus. It opens the three entries below.

Delete_Local.comment: Delete submenu entry, dialog title and confirm button: move the files on this computer to the Trash and leave the cloud copy alone.

Delete_Cloud.comment: Delete submenu entry, dialog title and confirm button: delete the cloud copy and leave the files on this computer alone.

Delete_Everywhere.comment: Delete submenu entry, dialog title and confirm button: move the local files to the Trash and delete the cloud copy.

AlbumDelete_Local.zh-Hans: 将“{0}”的本地文件移到废纸篓？云端副本会保留，因此该专辑仍在你的收藏中，并可从云端播放。

AlbumDelete_LocalLast.en: Move "{0}" to the Trash? It is not in the cloud, so the album is removed from your collection. You can restore it from the Trash.
AlbumDelete_LocalLast.fr: Déplacer « {0} » vers la corbeille ? L’album n’est pas dans le cloud, il est donc retiré de votre collection. Vous pouvez le restaurer depuis la corbeille.
AlbumDelete_LocalLast.es: ¿Mover «{0}» a la papelera? No está en la nube, así que el álbum se quita de tu colección. Puedes restaurarlo desde la papelera.

AlbumMenu_WriteReview.comment: Album context-menu item: open the review editor.

AlbumMenu_ShowInFolder.comment: Album context-menu item: open the album's folder in the file manager.

AlbumMenu_ShowInDiscogs.comment: Album context-menu item: open the album's Discogs release page.

AlbumMenu_ShareAlbum.comment: Album context-menu item: share the album (future social feature).

AlbumMenu_EditAlbum.comment: Album context-menu item: open the mass-edit window over every track on the album.

Review_Title.comment: Title of the album review editor dialog.

Review_RatingLabel.comment: Label before the star rating in the review editor.

Review_ClearRating.comment: Button that clears the star rating in the review editor.

Review_EditorLabel.comment: Label above the markdown text box in the review editor.

Review_PreviewLabel.comment: Label above the live markdown preview in the review editor.

Review_Placeholder.en: Share what you think. Markdown works: **bold**, *italic*, # heading, lists.
Review_Placeholder.fr: Partagez votre avis. Le Markdown fonctionne : **gras**, *italique*, # titre, listes.
Review_Placeholder.es: Comparte tu opinión. Markdown funciona: **negrita**, *cursiva*, # título, listas.
Review_Placeholder.de: Teile deine Meinung. Markdown funktioniert: **fett**, *kursiv*, # Überschrift, Listen.
Review_Placeholder.zh-Hans: 分享你的想法。支持 Markdown：**粗体**、*斜体*、# 标题、列表。
Review_Placeholder.comment: Placeholder text in the review editor's markdown box.

Review_Save.comment: Primary button in the review editor.

Album_Back.comment: Tooltip on a back key: the album page’s top-left chevron, the playlist pane’s back key, and the key that goes up a playlist folder.

Album_Tracks.comment: Heading above the tracklist on the album page.

Album_DiscHeader.comment: Divider above each disc's tracks in a multi-disc album's tracklist. {0} is the disc number.

Album_ReviewHeading.comment: Heading above the review section on the album page.

Album_ReviewEmpty.en: No review yet. Write one to remember what you thought.
Album_ReviewEmpty.fr: Pas encore de critique. Écrivez-en une pour vous souvenir de votre avis.
Album_ReviewEmpty.es: Aún no hay reseña. Escribe una para recordar tu opinión.
Album_ReviewEmpty.de: Noch keine Rezension. Schreibe eine, um deine Meinung festzuhalten.
Album_ReviewEmpty.zh-Hans: 还没有评论。写一条来记录你的想法。
Album_ReviewEmpty.comment: Shown on the album page when the album has no review yet.

TrackDelete_Failed.en: The track could not be moved to the Trash. It is still in your collection.
TrackDelete_Failed.fr: Le morceau n'a pas pu être mis à la corbeille. Il est toujours dans votre collection.
TrackDelete_Failed.es: No se pudo mover la pista a la papelera. Sigue en tu colección.
TrackDelete_Failed.de: Der Titel konnte nicht in den Papierkorb verschoben werden. Er ist weiterhin in deiner Sammlung.
TrackDelete_Failed.zh-Hans: 无法将该曲目移到废纸篓。它仍在你的收藏中。
TrackDelete_Failed.comment: Shown when a track delete could not move the file to the trash.

TrackDelete_FailedSome.en: {0} tracks could not be moved to the Trash. They are still in your collection.
TrackDelete_FailedSome.fr: {0} morceaux n'ont pas pu être mis à la corbeille. Ils sont toujours dans votre collection.
TrackDelete_FailedSome.es: No se pudieron mover {0} pistas a la papelera. Siguen en tu colección.
TrackDelete_FailedSome.de: {0} Titel konnten nicht in den Papierkorb verschoben werden. Sie sind weiterhin in deiner Sammlung.
TrackDelete_FailedSome.zh-Hans: 有 {0} 首曲目无法移到废纸篓。它们仍在你的收藏中。
TrackDelete_FailedSome.comment: Shown after a multi-track delete when some files could not be moved to the trash. {0} is how many were left behind.

MassEdit_MenuEdit.comment: Right-click menu item on both track grids: opens the mass-edit window for the selected tracks.

MassEdit_Multiple.comment: Placeholder in a mass-edit field where the selected tracks hold different values.

MassEdit_ChooseImage.comment: Button that opens a file picker to choose new album art in the mass-edit window.

MassEdit_LookUpRelease.comment: Button at the top of the mass-edit window: searches the release catalogues and fills every ticked field from the pressing the user picks.

MassEdit_LookUpNeedsFields.en: Please select the fields you wish to update
MassEdit_LookUpNeedsFields.fr: Veuillez sélectionner les champs à mettre à jour
MassEdit_LookUpNeedsFields.es: Seleccione los campos que desea actualizar
MassEdit_LookUpNeedsFields.de: Bitte wählen Sie die Felder aus, die aktualisiert werden sollen
MassEdit_LookUpNeedsFields.comment: Tooltip on the mass-edit window's disabled "Look up release" button: it fills ticked fields, so nothing ticked means nothing to fill.

MassEdit_CautionManyAlbums.en: These tracks come from more than one album. A ticked field is set on all of them.
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbums.fr: Ces pistes proviennent de plusieurs albums. Un champ coché est appliqué à toutes.
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbums.es: Estas pistas son de varios álbumes. Un campo marcado se aplica a todas.
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbums.de: Diese Titel stammen aus mehreren Alben. Ein aktiviertes Feld wird auf alle angewendet.
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbums.zh-Hans: 这些曲目来自多个专辑。勾选的字段将应用于全部曲目。
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbums.comment: Caution band at the top of the mass-edit window when the selected tracks sit in more than one album folder.

MassEdit_CautionManyAlbumsArt.en: A picture you pick is set on every album in the selection.
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbumsArt.fr: Une image choisie est appliquée à chaque album de la sélection.
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbumsArt.es: La imagen que elija se aplica a todos los álbumes de la selección.
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbumsArt.de: Ein ausgewähltes Bild wird auf jedes Album der Auswahl angewendet.
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbumsArt.zh-Hans: 您选择的图片将应用于所选内容中的每个专辑。
MassEdit_CautionManyAlbumsArt.comment: Second sentence of the mass-edit caution band, added when a cover or disc art row is ticked and the selection spans albums.

MassEdit_GroupRelease.comment: All-caps group heading in the mass-edit window over the fields describing the record itself: album, album artist, year, genre, disc, cover.

MassEdit_GroupPublishing.comment: All-caps group heading in the mass-edit window over the publisher and copyright fields.

MassEdit_GroupCredits.comment: All-caps group heading in the mass-edit window over the artist, composer and conductor fields.

MassEdit_GroupTrack.comment: All-caps group heading in the mass-edit window over the tags that belong to the track rather than the record: BPM, grouping, comment.

MassEdit_Of.comment: Joins two number boxes that are one fact on one form row: "Disc [1] of [2]", "Track [3] of [12]".

Playlists_Title.comment: Header/tab label for the playlists pane, and the deck pill that opens it.

Playlists_GenerateNew.comment: Tooltip on the button in the automatic playlist header that builds a different selection of songs.

Playlists_Generating.fr: Nouvelle liste en cours de création
Playlists_Generating.comment: Shown under the spinner while an automatic playlist is being generated again.

Playlists_SaveAsPlaylist.comment: Tooltip on the button in the automatic playlist header that keeps the generated songs as the user's own playlist, and the title of the name prompt it opens.

Playlists_AutoMix.comment: Tooltip on the DJ button in the playlist header: plays the playlist as one continuous beat-matched mix.

Dj_Start.comment: Album context menu: the now-playing queue becomes this album and the DJ plays it as one continuous beat-matched mix.

Dj_StartHere.comment: Track context menu: replaces the now-playing queue with this track and what follows it, and plays them as one continuous beat-matched mix.

Refuse_Artist.comment: Track context menu in a generated playlist: stop this kind of list from offering anything by this artist.

Refuse_ArtistUndo.comment: Track context menu in a generated playlist: undo Refuse_Artist, so this kind of list can offer the artist again.

Refuse_Album.comment: Track context menu in a generated playlist: stop this kind of list from offering anything on this album.

Refuse_AlbumUndo.comment: Track context menu in a generated playlist: undo Refuse_Album, so this kind of list can offer the album again.

Playlists_SongCount.comment: Playlist detail header: number of songs. {0} = count.

Playlists_LenHours.comment: Playlist detail header total length when an hour or more. {0}=hours, {1}=minutes.

Playlists_LenMinutes.comment: Playlist detail header total length under an hour. {0} = minutes.

LeftNav_Visualization.comment: Left-pane vertical nav button: the visualizer gallery.

NowPlaying_Empty.en: Nothing playing right now. Start a track and it appears here.
NowPlaying_Empty.fr: Rien en lecture pour l'instant. Lancez un morceau et il apparaîtra ici.
NowPlaying_Empty.es: No se está reproduciendo nada. Inicia una pista y aparecerá aquí.
NowPlaying_Empty.de: Gerade läuft nichts. Starte einen Titel, dann erscheint er hier.
NowPlaying_Empty.zh-Hans: 当前没有播放。开始播放曲目后即会显示在这里。
NowPlaying_Empty.comment: Empty state in the Now Playing pane when nothing is playing.

Queue_EmptyTitle.comment: Import pane empty state, shown when no folder is queued.

Queue_EmptyHint.en: Add a folder, rip a CD or record a side: the files appear here to check before they join the collection.
Queue_EmptyHint.fr: Ajoutez un dossier, extrayez un CD ou enregistrez une face : les fichiers apparaissent ici pour vérification avant d'entrer dans la collection.
Queue_EmptyHint.es: Añade una carpeta, extrae un CD o graba una cara: los archivos aparecen aquí para revisarlos antes de entrar en la colección.
Queue_EmptyHint.de: Ordner hinzufügen, CD rippen oder eine Seite aufnehmen: Die Dateien erscheinen hier zur Prüfung, bevor sie in die Sammlung kommen.
Queue_EmptyHint.zh-Hans: 添加文件夹、抓取 CD 或录制唱片一面：文件会先出现在这里供你检查，然后再加入音乐收藏。
Queue_EmptyHint.comment: Import pane empty state, under Queue_EmptyTitle.

Deck_PaneTip.en: Show or hide the side pane
Deck_PaneTip.fr: Afficher ou masquer le volet latéral
Deck_PaneTip.es: Mostrar u ocultar el panel lateral
Deck_PaneTip.comment: Tooltip for the deck's pane pill.

Playlists_NowPlaying.comment: The pinned playlist the player always plays.

Playlists_NewPlaylist.comment: Toolbar/menu action to create a playlist.

Playlists_NewFolder.comment: Toolbar/menu action to create a playlist folder.

Playlists_ViewIcons.comment: Tooltip on the icon button of the playlist pane's view switch: playlists shown as covers in a grid.

Playlists_ViewList.comment: Tooltip on the list button of the playlist pane's view switch: playlists shown as a folder tree.

Playlists_FolderEmpty.en: This folder is empty. Add a playlist to fill it.
Playlists_FolderEmpty.fr: Ce dossier est vide. Ajoutez une liste de lecture pour le remplir.
Playlists_FolderEmpty.es: Esta carpeta está vacía. Añade una lista de reproducción para llenarla.
Playlists_FolderEmpty.de: Dieser Ordner ist leer. Fügen Sie eine Wiedergabeliste hinzu.
Playlists_FolderEmpty.zh-Hans: 此文件夹为空。添加播放列表以填充它。
Playlists_FolderEmpty.comment: Empty state in the playlist icon view when the opened folder has nothing in it.

Playlists_DefaultPlaylist.comment: Default name suggested when creating a new playlist.

Playlists_DefaultFolder.comment: Default name suggested when creating a new folder.

Playlists_Rename.comment: Playlist tree context menu: rename a folder or playlist.

Playlists_Delete.comment: Playlist tree context menu: delete a folder or playlist.

Playlists_Remove.comment: Playlist tree context menu: remove a song or nested playlist from its playlist.

Playlists_AddToCloud.comment: Playlist tree context menu: upload the playlist and every track it plays to the cloud.

Playlists_RemoveFromCloud.comment: Playlist tree context menu: remove the playlist from the cloud, and the tracks that were only there for it.

Playlists_Play.comment: Playlist tree context menu: play this playlist/folder/song.

Playlists_PlayNow.comment: Now-playing queue context menu: move this track to the front of the queue and play it.

Playlists_AddToNowPlaying.fr: Ajouter à la lecture en cours
Playlists_AddToNowPlaying.comment: Playlist tree context menu: append to the player queue without interrupting it.

Playlists_Close.comment: Tooltip on the button that folds a pane away (both rails carry one).

Playlists_Reopen.comment: Tooltip on the same button once the pane is folded, when pressing it opens the pane again.

Playlists_AddToPlaylist.comment: Submenu on a library/album track: add the selection to a playlist.

Playlists_NewPlaylistFrom.comment: Add-to-playlist submenu entry that creates a new playlist from the selection.

Playlists_AlreadyInAll.en: These tracks are already in this playlist. Add them again?
Playlists_AlreadyInAll.fr: Ces morceaux sont déjà dans cette liste. Les ajouter à nouveau ?
Playlists_AlreadyInAll.es: Estas pistas ya están en esta lista. ¿Añadirlas otra vez?
Playlists_AlreadyInAll.de: Diese Titel sind bereits in dieser Wiedergabeliste. Erneut hinzufügen?
Playlists_AlreadyInAll.zh-Hans: 这些曲目已在此播放列表中。要再次添加吗？
Playlists_AlreadyInAll.comment: Desktop: body of the confirmation when several tracks are added to a playlist that already holds all of them. The title is Rpm_PlaylistPick_AlreadyIn.

Playlists_AlreadyInOneOf.en: One of these {0} tracks is already in this playlist.
Playlists_AlreadyInOneOf.fr: Un de ces {0} morceaux est déjà dans cette liste.
Playlists_AlreadyInOneOf.es: Una de estas {0} pistas ya está en esta lista.
Playlists_AlreadyInOneOf.de: Einer dieser {0} Titel ist bereits in dieser Wiedergabeliste.
Playlists_AlreadyInOneOf.zh-Hans: 这 {0} 首曲目中有 1 首已在此播放列表中。
Playlists_AlreadyInOneOf.comment: Desktop: body of the confirmation when several tracks are added to a playlist and exactly one of them is already in it. {0} is how many tracks are being added.

Playlists_AlreadyInSomeOf.en: {0} of these {1} tracks are already in this playlist.
Playlists_AlreadyInSomeOf.fr: {0} de ces {1} morceaux sont déjà dans cette liste.
Playlists_AlreadyInSomeOf.es: {0} de estas {1} pistas ya están en esta lista.
Playlists_AlreadyInSomeOf.de: {0} dieser {1} Titel sind bereits in dieser Wiedergabeliste.
Playlists_AlreadyInSomeOf.zh-Hans: 这 {1} 首曲目中有 {0} 首已在此播放列表中。
Playlists_AlreadyInSomeOf.comment: Desktop: body of the confirmation when several tracks are added to a playlist and some of them are already in it. {0} is how many are already there, {1} how many are being added.

Playlists_AddNewOnes.comment: Desktop: button on that confirmation that adds only the tracks not already in the playlist.

Playlists_AddAll.comment: Desktop: button on that confirmation that adds every track, including a second copy of the ones already there.

Playlists_ChangeCover.comment: Playlist tree context menu: opens the cover picker.

Playlists_CoverTitle.fr: Pochette de la liste de lecture
Playlists_CoverTitle.comment: Title of the playlist cover picker dialog.

Playlists_CoverRecords.comment: Tab in the playlist cover picker: build the cover from the covers of records on this playlist.

Playlists_CoverPicture.comment: Tab in the playlist cover picker: choose a picture file from disk.

Playlists_CoverMoods.comment: Tab in the playlist cover picker: the eight made covers, offered in one set of colours at a time.

Playlists_CoverAutomatic.comment: Button in the Generated tab of the playlist cover picker: applies the automatically generated collage cover.

Playlists_CoverChooseFile.comment: Button in the Picture tab of the playlist cover picker: opens a file picker for a picture on disk.

Playlists_CoverExplicit.comment: Tooltip on the toggle under the tile grid in the Moods tab of the playlist cover picker: stamps the parental advisory mark into the corner of the cover.

Playlists_CoverColours.comment: Button under the tile grid in the Generated tab of the playlist cover picker: redraws all eight covers in a new set of colours.

Playlists_CoverPickFour.en: Pick up to four records. They appear in the order you pick them.
Playlists_CoverPickFour.fr: Choisissez jusqu'à quatre albums. Ils apparaissent dans l'ordre où vous les choisissez.
Playlists_CoverPickFour.es: Elige hasta cuatro álbumes. Aparecen en el orden en que los eliges.
Playlists_CoverPickFour.de: Wähle bis zu vier Alben aus. Sie erscheinen in der Reihenfolge, in der du sie auswählst.
Playlists_CoverPickFour.zh-Hans: 最多选择四张专辑，封面按你选择的顺序排列。
Playlists_CoverPickFour.comment: Instruction text in the Records tab of the playlist cover picker.

Playlists_CoverSearch.comment: Placeholder in the search box of the Records tab in the playlist cover picker.

Playlists_CoverCopied.en: The image is copied into your collection.
Playlists_CoverCopied.fr: L'image est copiée dans votre collection.
Playlists_CoverCopied.es: La imagen se copia en tu colección.
Playlists_CoverCopied.de: Das Bild wird in deine Sammlung kopiert.
Playlists_CoverCopied.zh-Hans: 图片已复制到你的音乐收藏。
Playlists_CoverCopied.comment: Hint in the Picture tab of the playlist cover picker: the chosen file is copied, not linked.

Playlists_CoverNoRecords.en: No records on this playlist have artwork.
Playlists_CoverNoRecords.fr: Aucun album de cette liste n'a de pochette.
Playlists_CoverNoRecords.es: Ningún álbum de esta lista tiene portada.
Playlists_CoverNoRecords.de: Kein Album in dieser Wiedergabeliste hat ein Cover.
Playlists_CoverNoRecords.zh-Hans: 此播放列表中的专辑都没有封面。
Playlists_CoverNoRecords.comment: Empty state in the Records tab of the playlist cover picker when none of the playlist's records have cover art.

Viz_GalleryTitle.comment: Heading of the visualizer gallery pane.

Viz_Launch.comment: Button on a visualizer card: run it full screen.

Viz_Exit.comment: Tooltip of the close button in the full-screen visualizer.

Viz_RibbonSeaName.comment: Name of the built-in OpenGL visualizer.

Viz_RibbonSeaDesc.en: Glowing contour lines over an open sea. The music lifts the whole swell, and wrinkles travel along each line: bass at the back, treble at the front.
Viz_RibbonSeaDesc.fr: Des lignes de niveau lumineuses sur une mer ouverte. La musique soulève toute la houle, et des ondulations parcourent chaque ligne : les graves au fond, les aigus devant.
Viz_RibbonSeaDesc.es: Líneas de nivel luminosas sobre un mar abierto. La música levanta todo el oleaje y las ondulaciones recorren cada línea: los graves al fondo, los agudos al frente.
Viz_RibbonSeaDesc.de: Leuchtende Höhenlinien über offener See. Die Musik hebt die gesamte Dünung, und Kräuselungen wandern über jede Linie: Bass hinten, Höhen vorn.
Viz_RibbonSeaDesc.zh-Hans: 开阔海面上的发光等高线。音乐抬起整片涌浪，涟漪沿着每条线行进：低音在后，高音在前。
Viz_RibbonSeaDesc.comment: Description of the built-in OpenGL visualizer, shown on its gallery card.

Viz_Pin.comment: Tooltip of the pin button in the full-screen visualizer (chrome currently auto-hides).

Viz_Unpin.comment: Tooltip of the pin button in the full-screen visualizer while it is pinned.

Viz_Room.comment: Tooltip of the same button when the next press leaves the room and its drifting figures alone - no record, no words.

Viz_LyricsBack.comment: Tooltip of the lyric button in the full-screen Pegasus visualizer while the lyric is the view on screen, so the next press returns to whichever composition was up before it.

Viz_Lyrics.comment: Tooltip of the same button when the next press shows the time-coded lyric. Only offered when a synced sheet was found for the track playing.

Viz_Volume.comment: Tooltip of the volume slider, both on the RPaMp deck at the bottom of the window and on the right of the transport row in the full-screen Pegasus player. One volume, set from either.

Viz_BackToLibrary.comment: Tooltip on the key that leaves the full-screen player for the album wall.

Viz_Queue.comment: Tooltip of the hamburger under the seek bar in the full-screen Pegasus player, which opens the now-playing list.

Viz_QueueClose.comment: Tooltip of the same hamburger while the now-playing list is open, so the next press closes it.

Viz_FavoriteAdded.comment: Message along the foot of the window after the heart is pressed, in the full-screen player and in the track info pane. {0} is the song title.

Viz_FavoriteRemoved.zh-Hans: 已将 {0} 从收藏中移除
Viz_FavoriteRemoved.comment: Message along the foot of the window after the heart is pressed a second time, in the full-screen player and in the track info pane. {0} is the song title.

Viz_Library.comment: Tooltip on the drawer key that opens the full-screen collection in the Pegasus player.

Viz_LibraryBack.comment: Tooltip on the key that closes the full-screen collection and returns to the Pegasus visualizer.

Viz_LibraryBackHome.comment: Tooltip on the back key of Pegasus's full-screen album wall, which goes to the home screen.

Viz_Menu.comment: Tooltip on the key in the top left corner of Pegasus's home screen, which opens the menu of the collection's screens.

Viz_MenuAlbums.comment: Button in the menu on Pegasus's home screen that opens the album grid.

Viz_MenuArtists.comment: Button in the menu on Pegasus's home screen and in the Android TV app's side menu: opens the artists list.

Viz_MenuGenres.comment: Button in the menu on Pegasus's home screen and in the Android TV app's side menu: opens the genres list.

Viz_ArtistsSort.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the sort button on the artists list in Pegasus (the full-screen player) and the Android TV app.

Viz_MenuPlaylists.comment: Button in the menu on Pegasus's home screen for the playlists. Shown, not yet working.

Viz_MenuRadio.comment: Entry in the side menu on Pegasus's home screen. Opens the radio screen.

Viz_MenuSettings.comment: Title of Pegasus's settings panel, and the tooltip of the settings key at the foot of its side menu.

Viz_MenuSearch.comment: Entry in the side menu on Pegasus's home screen and the Android TV app's. On the TV it opens the search over artists, albums, tracks and radio stations.

Tv_Search_Placeholder.en: Search artists, albums, tracks and stations
Tv_Search_Placeholder.fr: Rechercher des artistes, albums, pistes et stations
Tv_Search_Placeholder.es: Buscar artistas, álbumes, pistas y emisoras
Tv_Search_Placeholder.de: Interpreten, Alben, Titel und Sender suchen
Tv_Search_Placeholder.zh-Hans: 搜索艺人、专辑、曲目和电台
Tv_Search_Placeholder.comment: Placeholder in the search field the Android TV app's side menu opens.

Tv_Search_Artists.comment: Heading over the artists found, in the Android TV app's search.

Tv_Search_Albums.comment: Heading over the albums found, in the Android TV app's search.

Tv_Search_Tracks.comment: Heading over the tracks found, in the Android TV app's search.

Tv_Search_Stations.comment: Heading over the radio stations found, in the Android TV app's search.

Tv_Search_NoResults.fr: Aucun résultat ne correspond à votre recherche.
Tv_Search_NoResults.es: No hay resultados para tu búsqueda.
Tv_Search_NoResults.zh-Hans: 没有符合搜索条件的结果。
Tv_Search_NoResults.comment: Shown in the Android TV app's search when no artist, album, track or radio station matches.

Tv_Search_StationsFailed.fr: Impossible de rechercher les stations de radio.
Tv_Search_StationsFailed.es: No se han podido buscar emisoras de radio.
Tv_Search_StationsFailed.comment: Shown under the radio stations heading in the Android TV app's search when the radio directory could not be reached.

Viz_MenuExit.comment: Button at the foot of Pegasus's side menu. Leaves the full-screen view for the main window.

Viz_MenuSwitch.comment: Tooltip of the key beside the name at the top of Pegasus's side menu. Shown only when a shared collection is available.

Viz_MenuShared.comment: Line under the owner's name at the top of Pegasus's side menu while someone else's shared collection is open.

Viz_RadioTuner.comment: Entry in the wheel down the right of Pegasus's radio screen. Opens the tuner: the dial, the station list and the player.

Viz_RadioMusic.comment: Entry in the wheel down the right of Pegasus's radio screen. Opens the tuner with the list of music genres to pick from.

Viz_RadioNews.comment: Entry in the wheel down the right of Pegasus's radio screen. Opens the tuner listing news stations.

Viz_RadioLocal.comment: Entry in the wheel down the right of Pegasus's radio screen. Opens the tuner listing the stations of the listener's country.

Viz_RadioEssential.comment: Heading over the row of a country's most played stations on Pegasus's radio screen. {0} is the country's name.

Viz_RadioPopular.comment: Heading over the row of the most played stations on Pegasus's radio screen, used when the listener's country is not known or has no stations listed.

Viz_RadioFavorites.comment: Heading over the row of the listener's favorite stations on Pegasus's radio screen.

Viz_RadioNoFavorites.en: No favourite stations yet. Select the heart beside a station in the tuner and it appears here.
Viz_RadioNoFavorites.fr: Aucune station favorite pour l'instant. Sélectionnez le cœur à côté d'une station dans le tuner et elle apparaîtra ici.
Viz_RadioNoFavorites.es: Aún no hay emisoras favoritas. Selecciona el corazón junto a una emisora en el sintonizador y aparecerá aquí.
Viz_RadioNoFavorites.de: Noch keine Lieblingssender. Wähle im Tuner das Herz neben einem Sender, dann erscheint er hier.
Viz_RadioNoFavorites.zh-Hans: 还没有收藏的电台。在调谐器中选择电台旁的爱心，它就会出现在这里。
Viz_RadioNoFavorites.comment: Shown on Pegasus's radio screen under the favorite stations heading when no station is a favorite.

Viz_SwitchingCollection.comment: Shown in the middle of Pegasus, under the owner's picture, while home reads the collection just switched to from the side menu.

Viz_SettingsLayout.comment: Row in Pegasus's settings panel: how the now-playing screen is laid out. OK moves to the next layout. Also the Android TV player's layout key.

Viz_LayoutFull.comment: Value of the Layout row in Pegasus's settings: the record, its title and the spectrum.

Viz_LayoutCompact.comment: Value of the Layout row in Pegasus's settings: the record and its title, without the spectrum.

Tv_FavoriteFailed.en: The song could not be added to favourites.
Tv_FavoriteFailed.fr: Le morceau n'a pas pu être ajouté aux favoris.
Tv_FavoriteFailed.es: No se pudo añadir la canción a favoritos.

Viz_LowFlowName.comment: Name of the Low Frequency Flow visualizer (a proper name, left untranslated).

Viz_LowFlowDesc.en: A flight through a field of turning blocks, lit by the track. The spectrum sets them alight and the camera re-frames itself every few bars.
Viz_LowFlowDesc.fr: Un vol à travers un champ de blocs tournants, éclairés par le morceau. Le spectre les embrase et la caméra se recadre toutes les quelques mesures.
Viz_LowFlowDesc.es: Un vuelo a través de un campo de bloques giratorios, iluminados por la pista. El espectro los enciende y la cámara se reencuadra cada pocos compases.
Viz_LowFlowDesc.de: Ein Flug durch ein Feld drehender Blöcke, beleuchtet vom Titel. Das Spektrum lässt sie aufleuchten, und die Kamera wählt alle paar Takte einen neuen Blickwinkel.
Viz_LowFlowDesc.zh-Hans: 穿越旋转方块阵列的飞行，由曲目点亮。频谱让它们燃起光芒，镜头每隔几个小节重新取景。
Viz_LowFlowDesc.comment: Description of the Low Frequency Flow visualizer, shown on its gallery card.

Viz_BloomName.comment: Name of the Bloom visualizer: a polar spectrogram drawn as a flower.

Viz_BloomDesc.en: A flower of light on a golden spiral. Around the wheel is frequency, outward from the heart is time, so every beat opens at the centre and travels out through the petals.
Viz_BloomDesc.fr: Une fleur de lumière sur une spirale d'or. Le tour de la roue est la fréquence, l'éloignement du cœur est le temps : chaque temps s'ouvre au centre et voyage vers les pétales.
Viz_BloomDesc.es: Una flor de luz sobre una espiral áurea. La vuelta de la rueda es la frecuencia y la distancia al corazón es el tiempo: cada golpe se abre en el centro y viaja hacia los pétalos.
Viz_BloomDesc.de: Eine Blüte aus Licht auf einer goldenen Spirale. Der Umlauf ist die Frequenz, der Weg vom Herzen nach außen die Zeit: Jeder Schlag öffnet sich in der Mitte und wandert durch die Blätter.
Viz_BloomDesc.zh-Hans: 金色螺旋上的光之花。绕圈一周是频率，由花心向外是时间：每一拍都在中心绽开，向花瓣行进。
Viz_BloomDesc.comment: Description of the Bloom visualizer, shown on its gallery card.

Viz_ChladniName.comment: Name of the Chladni visualizer, after the physicist Ernst Chladni. A proper name.

Viz_ChladniDesc.en: Sand on a sounding plate, as Chladni did it in 1787. The grains flee wherever the plate moves and settle on the lines where it stands still, so the figure is the music itself. In silence the sand simply stops.
Viz_ChladniDesc.fr: Du sable sur une plaque que l'on fait sonner, comme Chladni en 1787. Les grains fuient là où la plaque vibre et se posent sur les lignes immobiles : la figure est la musique elle-même. Dans le silence, le sable s'arrête.
Viz_ChladniDesc.es: Arena sobre una placa que suena, como hizo Chladni en 1787. Los granos huyen de donde la placa vibra y se posan en las líneas quietas: la figura es la música misma. En el silencio la arena se detiene.
Viz_ChladniDesc.de: Sand auf einer klingenden Platte, wie es Chladni 1787 tat. Die Körner fliehen dort, wo die Platte schwingt, und sammeln sich auf den ruhenden Linien: Die Figur ist die Musik selbst. In der Stille bleibt der Sand einfach liegen.
Viz_ChladniDesc.zh-Hans: 发声板上的沙，一如克拉尼在1787年所做。沙粒逃离振动之处，聚集在静止的节线上，图形本身就是音乐。寂静时，沙就停下。
Viz_ChladniDesc.comment: Description of the Chladni visualizer, shown on its gallery card.

Viz_ButterflyName.comment: Name of the Butterfly visualizer: the spectrum mirrored into four.

Viz_ButterflyDesc.en: The spectrum, mirrored into four. Bass sits in the middle and treble runs out to the edges. Each band's level draws a dark line with the light opening away from it, so loud bands glow wide and quiet ones close to a seam.
Viz_ButterflyDesc.fr: Le spectre, en miroir sur quatre quadrants. Les graves au centre, les aigus vers les bords. Le niveau de chaque bande trace une ligne sombre d'où la lumière s'ouvre : les bandes fortes rayonnent largement, les faibles se referment en un trait.
Viz_ButterflyDesc.es: El espectro, reflejado en cuatro. Los graves en el centro y los agudos hacia los bordes. El nivel de cada banda dibuja una línea oscura desde la que se abre la luz: las bandas fuertes brillan anchas y las suaves se cierran en un trazo.
Viz_ButterflyDesc.de: Das Spektrum, vierfach gespiegelt. Bass in der Mitte, Höhen nach außen. Der Pegel jedes Bandes zeichnet eine dunkle Linie, von der aus sich das Licht öffnet: laute Bänder leuchten breit, leise schließen sich zu einem Strich.
Viz_ButterflyDesc.zh-Hans: 频谱镜像成四份。低音在中间，高音向两侧展开。每个频段的电平画出一条暗线，光从暗线向两侧展开：响的频段光带宽而亮，轻的收成一道细缝。
Viz_ButterflyDesc.comment: Description of the Butterfly visualizer, shown on its gallery card.

Viz_TunnelName.comment: Name of the Tunnel visualizer: a folded tunnel flown to the beat.

Viz_TunnelDesc.en: A tunnel of folded light, flown to the beat. The camera cuts every two bars and the walls change shape on the phrase, so the edit follows the record instead of a clock. Analysed tracks drive it from their own beat grid.
Viz_TunnelDesc.fr: Un tunnel de lumière repliée, parcouru au rythme du morceau. La caméra coupe toutes les deux mesures et les parois changent de forme à chaque phrase : le montage suit le disque, pas une horloge. Les pistes analysées le pilotent avec leur propre grille rythmique.
Viz_TunnelDesc.es: Un túnel de luz plegada, recorrido al ritmo de la música. La cámara corta cada dos compases y las paredes cambian de forma en cada frase, así que el montaje sigue al disco y no a un reloj. Las pistas analizadas lo controlan con su propia rejilla de tiempo.
Viz_TunnelDesc.de: Ein Tunnel aus gefaltetem Licht, im Takt durchflogen. Die Kamera schneidet alle zwei Takte, und die Wände ändern ihre Form mit der Phrase: Der Schnitt folgt dem Titel und nicht einer Uhr. Analysierte Titel steuern ihn über ihr eigenes Beatraster.
Viz_TunnelDesc.zh-Hans: 一条由折叠光线构成的隧道，随节拍飞行。镜头每两小节切换一次，墙面在乐句处改变形状，剪辑跟随音乐而不是时钟。已分析的曲目会用自己的节拍网格来驱动它。
Viz_TunnelDesc.comment: Description of the Tunnel visualizer, shown on its gallery card.

Viz_KaleidoscopeName.comment: Name of the Kaleidoscope visualizer: space reflected between two mirrors.

Viz_KaleidoscopeDesc.en: Two mirrors, set at an angle, with a single strut between them. Reflecting it four times over builds a rose window, and the record sets the angle: the pattern comes round a different number of times on every phrase.
Viz_KaleidoscopeDesc.fr: Deux miroirs disposés en angle, avec une seule barre entre eux. Quatre réflexions successives forment une rosace, et le morceau règle l'angle : le motif se répète un nombre de fois différent à chaque phrase.
Viz_KaleidoscopeDesc.es: Dos espejos en ángulo, con una sola barra entre ellos. Reflejarla cuatro veces construye un rosetón, y la música fija el ángulo: el patrón se repite un número distinto de veces en cada frase.
Viz_KaleidoscopeDesc.de: Zwei Spiegel im Winkel zueinander, dazwischen eine einzige Strebe. Viermal gespiegelt entsteht daraus eine Fensterrose, und der Titel bestimmt den Winkel: Das Muster wiederholt sich in jeder Phrase unterschiedlich oft.
Viz_KaleidoscopeDesc.zh-Hans: 两面成角度的镜子，中间只有一根支柱。反射四次便构成一扇玫瑰花窗，而音乐决定角度：每个乐句里图案循环的次数都不同。
Viz_KaleidoscopeDesc.comment: Description of the Kaleidoscope visualizer, shown on its gallery card.

Viz_LatticeName.comment: Name of the Lattice visualizer: a three-dimensional slice through a four-dimensional grid.

Viz_LatticeDesc.en: A slice through a grid that has four dimensions instead of three. Nothing in the grid moves. The beat moves the slice, so cells swell out of nothing, open and close again, and every phrase turns the grid in a direction that has no equivalent here.
Viz_LatticeDesc.fr: Une coupe dans une grille à quatre dimensions au lieu de trois. Rien ne bouge dans la grille : c'est le rythme qui déplace la coupe, si bien que les cellules surgissent, s'ouvrent et se referment, et chaque phrase fait pivoter la grille dans une direction sans équivalent ici.
Viz_LatticeDesc.es: Un corte a través de una rejilla de cuatro dimensiones en lugar de tres. Nada se mueve en la rejilla: el ritmo mueve el corte, así que las celdas surgen de la nada, se abren y se cierran, y cada frase gira la rejilla en una dirección sin equivalente aquí.
Viz_LatticeDesc.de: Ein Schnitt durch ein Gitter mit vier statt drei Dimensionen. Im Gitter bewegt sich nichts: Der Takt bewegt den Schnitt, sodass Zellen aus dem Nichts anschwellen, sich öffnen und wieder schließen, und jede Phrase dreht das Gitter in eine Richtung, die es hier nicht gibt.
Viz_LatticeDesc.zh-Hans: 对一个四维而非三维网格的切片。网格本身没有任何运动：节拍推动切片，于是单元格凭空鼓起、张开、再合上，而每个乐句都会把网格转向一个此处并不存在的方向。
Viz_LatticeDesc.comment: Description of the Lattice visualizer, shown on its gallery card.

Split_SelectionTooShort.en: That selection is too short to be a track.
