Split_NoMarkersInSelection.zh-Hans: 该选区内没有音轨标记。

Queue_CtxTrash.fr: Mettre les fichiers à la corbeille

QueueTrash_BodyOne.en: Move “{0}” to the trash? It leaves the queue and the file goes to your system trash, where you can still get it back.
QueueTrash_BodyOne.fr: Mettre « {0} » à la corbeille ? Le fichier quitte la file d'attente et part à la corbeille du système, d'où il peut encore être récupéré.
QueueTrash_BodyOne.es: ¿Mover «{0}» a la papelera? Sale de la cola y el archivo va a la papelera del sistema, donde aún puede recuperarlo.
QueueTrash_BodyOne.de: „{0}“ in den Papierkorb verschieben? Die Datei verlässt die Warteschlange und landet im Papierkorb des Systems, aus dem sie noch zurückgeholt werden kann.
QueueTrash_BodyOne.zh-Hans: 将“{0}”移到废纸篓？它会离开队列，文件进入系统废纸篓，之后仍可恢复。

QueueTrash_Body.en: Move {0} files to the trash? They leave the queue and go to your system trash, where you can still get them back.
QueueTrash_Body.fr: Mettre {0} fichiers à la corbeille ? Ils quittent la file d'attente et partent à la corbeille du système, d'où ils peuvent encore être récupérés.
QueueTrash_Body.es: ¿Mover {0} archivos a la papelera? Salen de la cola y van a la papelera del sistema, donde aún puede recuperarlos.
QueueTrash_Body.de: {0} Dateien in den Papierkorb verschieben? Sie verlassen die Warteschlange und landen im Papierkorb des Systems, aus dem sie noch zurückgeholt werden können.
QueueTrash_Body.zh-Hans: 将 {0} 个文件移到废纸篓？它们会离开队列并进入系统废纸篓，之后仍可恢复。

QueueTrash_Failed.en: {0} file(s) could not be moved to the trash and are still on disk.
QueueTrash_Failed.fr: {0} fichier(s) n'ont pas pu être mis à la corbeille et sont toujours sur le disque.
QueueTrash_Failed.es: No se han podido mover {0} archivo(s) a la papelera y siguen en el disco.
QueueTrash_Failed.de: {0} Datei(en) konnten nicht in den Papierkorb verschoben werden und liegen noch auf der Festplatte.
QueueTrash_Failed.zh-Hans: 有 {0} 个文件无法移到废纸篓，仍留在磁盘上。

Radio_Title.comment: Heading of the Internet Radio pane in the left function rail.

Radio_Subtitle.en: Tune the dial, or search the directory.
Radio_Subtitle.fr: Tournez le cadran ou cherchez dans l'annuaire.
Radio_Subtitle.es: Gira el dial o busca en el directorio.
Radio_Subtitle.de: Am Senderzeiger drehen oder das Verzeichnis durchsuchen.

Radio_SearchPlaceholder.comment: Placeholder in the radio station search box.

Radio_AllCountries.comment: First entry of the radio country filter: no country filter.

Radio_ShowFavorites.comment: Tooltip on the toggle that lists only the user's saved radio stations.

Radio_Filter.comment: Tooltip on the filter button in the internet radio pane.

Radio_FilterFormat.comment: Heading over the stream format entries in the radio pane's filter menu.

Radio_FilterGenre.comment: Heading over the genre entries in the radio pane's filter menu.

Radio_FilterAds.comment: Heading over the advertising entries in the radio pane's filter menu.

Radio_AllFormats.comment: Filter menu entry in the radio pane that clears the format filter.

Radio_AllGenres.comment: Filter menu entry in the radio pane that clears the genre filter, and the placeholder on the phone's genre picker.

Radio_AdsEither.comment: Filter menu entry in the radio pane that clears the advertising filter.

Radio_AdsWithout.comment: Filter menu entry in the radio pane that lists only stations without advertising.

Radio_AdsWith.comment: Filter menu entry in the radio pane that lists only stations that carry advertising.

Radio_OnAir.comment: Tooltip on the lit lamp beside a station name in the internet radio list.

Radio_OffAir.en: Not answering at the last check
Radio_OffAir.fr: Ne répondait pas lors du dernier contrôle
Radio_OffAir.es: No respondía en la última comprobación
Radio_OffAir.comment: Tooltip on the unlit lamp beside a station name in the internet radio list.

Radio_Sort.comment: Tooltip on the sort button in the internet radio pane.

Radio_SortHeading.comment: Heading over the entries in the radio pane's sort menu.

Radio_SortListed.comment: Sort menu entry in the radio pane: the order the station directory returns.

Radio_SortNameUp.comment: Sort menu entry in the radio pane: station name, ascending.

Radio_SortNameDown.comment: Sort menu entry in the radio pane: station name, descending.

Radio_SortVotes.comment: Sort menu entry in the radio pane: the directory's vote count, highest first.

Radio_SortQuality.comment: Sort menu entry in the radio pane: stream bitrate, highest first.

Radio_ResetOrder.comment: Button pinned under the sort list in the radio pane that puts the stations back in the directory's order.

Radio_ClearLocation.comment: Button pinned under the country list in the radio pane that clears the country filter.

Radio_ClearFilters.comment: Filter menu entry in the radio pane that clears every filter at once.

Radio_NoFilterMatch.fr: Aucune station ne correspond à vos filtres.
Radio_NoFilterMatch.es: Ninguna emisora coincide con tus filtros.
Radio_NoFilterMatch.de: Keine Sender passen zu deinen Filtern.
Radio_NoFilterMatch.zh-Hans: 没有符合筛选条件的电台。
Radio_NoFilterMatch.comment: Shown in the radio pane when the filters hide every station that was listed.

Radio_NothingTuned.comment: Readout under the radio dial when no station is playing.

Radio_NoTrack.comment: Readout under the radio dial while a station is playing but has not named a track.

Radio_TunedTo.comment: Message along the foot of the window when the home screen radio card is pressed. {0} is the station name.

Radio_NowPlayingLine.comment: Third line of the home screen radio card, when that station is the one tuned. {0} is what the station announces, usually "Artist - Track".

Radio_Reconnecting.comment: Readout under the radio dial while a dropped station is being reconnected.

Radio_NoResults.fr: Aucune station ne correspond à votre recherche.
Radio_NoResults.es: Ninguna emisora coincide con tu búsqueda.
Radio_NoResults.de: Keine Sender passen zu deiner Suche.
Radio_NoResults.zh-Hans: 没有与搜索匹配的电台。
Radio_NoResults.comment: Shown in the radio pane when a search returns nothing.

Radio_NoFavorites.en: No saved stations yet. Star one to keep it here.
Radio_NoFavorites.fr: Aucune station enregistrée. Ajoutez une étoile pour la conserver ici.
Radio_NoFavorites.es: Todavía no hay emisoras guardadas. Marca una con la estrella para conservarla aquí.
Radio_NoFavorites.de: Noch keine gespeicherten Sender. Mit dem Stern einen hier behalten.
Radio_NoFavorites.zh-Hans: 还没有保存的电台。点击星标即可保存。
Radio_NoFavorites.comment: Shown in the radio pane when the saved-stations filter is on and nothing is saved.

Radio_SharedNoFavorites.en: No saved stations in this shared library.
Radio_SharedNoFavorites.fr: Aucune station enregistrée dans cette bibliothèque partagée.
Radio_SharedNoFavorites.es: No hay emisoras guardadas en esta biblioteca compartida.
Radio_SharedNoFavorites.de: Keine gespeicherten Sender in dieser geteilten Bibliothek.
Radio_SharedNoFavorites.zh-Hans: 此共享音乐库中没有已保存的电台。
Radio_SharedNoFavorites.comment: Phone radio pane (saved-stations filter on) and Apple TV radio screen (favourites row), while a shared library is open whose owner has saved no stations.

Radio_SharedFavoritesError.en: Saved stations could not be loaded.
Radio_SharedFavoritesError.fr: Impossible de charger les stations enregistrées.
Radio_SharedFavoritesError.es: No se han podido cargar las emisoras guardadas.
Radio_SharedFavoritesError.de: Gespeicherte Sender konnten nicht geladen werden.
Radio_SharedFavoritesError.zh-Hans: 无法加载已保存的电台。
Radio_SharedFavoritesError.comment: Phone radio pane (saved-stations filter on) and Apple TV radio screen (favourites row), while a shared library is open and its owner's saved stations could not be read.

Radio_SavedMark.comment: VoiceOver label on the heart of a station that a shared library's owner saved (phone radio pane, Apple TV tuner; it cannot be pressed).

Radio_DirectoryDown.en: Could not retrieve the list of radio stations. Saved stations still play.
Radio_DirectoryDown.fr: Impossible de récupérer la liste des stations de radio. Les stations enregistrées fonctionnent toujours.
Radio_DirectoryDown.es: No se ha podido obtener la lista de emisoras de radio. Las emisoras guardadas siguen funcionando.
Radio_DirectoryDown.de: Die Liste der Radiosender konnte nicht abgerufen werden. Gespeicherte Sender lassen sich weiter hören.
Radio_DirectoryDown.zh-Hans: 无法获取电台列表。已保存的电台仍可播放。
Radio_DirectoryDown.comment: Shown in the radio pane when every Radio Browser mirror failed.

Radio_AdBreak.comment: Shown on the radio dial in place of the track title while a station announces an advertisement.

Radio_CarriesAds.comment: Tooltip on the AD badge beside a station name in the internet radio list.

Radio_Save.comment: Tooltip on the heart button in a radio station row.

Rpm_SignIn_Subtitle.en: Your music collection, streamed from the cloud. Sign in to play it.
Rpm_SignIn_Subtitle.fr: Votre collection musicale, diffusée depuis le cloud. Connectez-vous pour l'écouter.

Rpm_SignIn_Subtitle.de: Deine Musiksammlung, gestreamt aus der Cloud. Melde dich an, um sie zu hören.

Rpm_Library_Empty.en: Nothing here yet. Upload your library from rpm on your computer and it appears here.
Rpm_Library_Empty.fr: Rien ici pour l'instant. Envoyez votre bibliothèque depuis rpm sur votre ordinateur et elle apparaîtra ici.
Rpm_Library_Empty.es: Aquí no hay nada todavía. Sube tu biblioteca desde rpm en tu ordenador y aparecerá aquí.
Rpm_Library_Empty.de: Hier ist noch nichts. Lade deine Mediathek aus rpm auf deinem Rechner hoch, dann erscheint sie hier.
Rpm_Library_Empty.zh-Hans: 这里还没有内容。在电脑上用 rpm 上传你的音乐库后即会显示在这里。

Rpm_Library_Error.es: No se pudo acceder a tu biblioteca.

Rpm_NowPlaying_Stop.comment: Menu item and stage key on the iPhone player that stops playback and empties the queue.

Rpm_Stage_Plate.comment: Visualiser choice on the iPhone stage: the sand-on-a-plate figure. A proper name.

Rpm_Stage_Portrait.comment: Key on the iPhone stage that turns the app back to the portrait player.

Rpm_Album_Tracks.comment: Album header on iPhone. {0} is the track count.

Rpm_Album_Unordered.en: Track order is not available yet.

Rpm_Album_Unordered.de: Die Titelreihenfolge ist noch nicht verfügbar.

Rpm_Playback_Dropped.comment: Now playing status: a track that was playing stopped part way through.

Rpm_Playback_NotPlayable.comment: Now playing status: the decoder refused the file. Nothing about the network.

Rpm_Playback_SignedOut.en: Signed out. Sign in to continue.
Rpm_Playback_SignedOut.es: Sesión cerrada. Inicia sesión para continuar.
Rpm_Playback_SignedOut.de: Abgemeldet. Melde dich an, um fortzufahren.

Rpm_Playback_Original.comment: Shown under the seek bar on the iPhone player when the file is being streamed as uploaded, with no transcoding.

Rpm_Cast_ThisPhone.comment: The entry in the speaker picker that brings playback back to the phone.

Tv_Cast_ThisTv.comment: Android TV: the first entry in the cast menu over the player. Picking it brings the music back to the TV from a Cast device.

Tv_Cast_CannotCast.en: Switched to this TV because {0} can't play this track.
Tv_Cast_CannotCast.fr: Lecture basculée sur ce téléviseur, car {0} ne peut pas lire ce morceau.
Tv_Cast_CannotCast.es: Se cambió a este televisor porque {0} no puede reproducir esta pista.

Rpm_Cast_Searching.comment: Shown in the speaker picker (iPhone) and the cast menu (desktop) while the network is searched. Android TV: in the cast menu while no device has been found.

Rpm_Cast_None.en: No speakers found on this network.
Rpm_Cast_None.fr: Aucune enceinte trouvée sur ce réseau.

Rpm_Cast_Group.comment: Subtitle on a speaker-group entry in the iPhone picker and the desktop cast menu. Android TV: in brackets after a speaker group in the cast menu.

Rpm_Cast_Playing.comment: Shown while casting: the iPhone now-playing screen, and the desktop player's ticker (in capitals there). {0} is the speaker name. Android TV: at the top of the player while casting.

Rpm_NowPlaying_ArtistPage.comment: iPhone now-playing screen, the ... menu: opens the page of the artist of the song playing.

Rpm_Sleep_OneHour.comment: iPhone sleep timer menu: pause playback after one hour.

Rpm_Sleep_EndOfSong.comment: iPhone sleep timer menu and panel: pause playback when the song playing ends.

Rpm_Sleep_AddTime.comment: iPhone sleep timer panel: heading over the buttons that add time to the running timer.

Rpm_Sleep_AddMinutes.comment: iPhone sleep timer panel: button that adds this many minutes to the running timer. {0} is 5, 15 or 30.

Rpm_Sleep_AddHour.comment: iPhone sleep timer panel: button that adds one hour to the running timer.

Rpm_Sleep_TurnOff.comment: iPhone sleep timer panel: button that cancels the running timer.

Rpm_Sleep_StopsAt.es: La reproducción se detiene a las {0}
Rpm_Sleep_StopsAt.comment: iPhone sleep timer panel, under the title. {0} is a clock time, e.g. 23:40.

Rpm_Sleep_StopsAtEndOfSong.en: Playback stops at the end of this song

Rpm_Sleep_StopsAtEndOfSong.es: La reproducción se detiene al final de esta canción
Rpm_Sleep_StopsAtEndOfSong.de: Wiedergabe stoppt am Ende dieses Titels
Rpm_Sleep_StopsAtEndOfSong.zh-Hans: 将在本首歌曲结束时停止播放
Rpm_Sleep_StopsAtEndOfSong.comment: iPhone sleep timer panel, under the title, when the timer is set to the end of the song.

Rpm_Sleep_Close.comment: iPhone sleep timer panel: the close button.

Rpm_Playlists_LoadingFrom.zh-Hans: 正在加载 {0} 的播放列表…

Rpm_Playlists_Error.es: No se pudo acceder a tus listas.

Rpm_Playlist_Empty.en: This playlist is empty. Add tracks by tapping +

Rpm_Playlist_Empty.es: Esta lista está vacía. Añade pistas tocando +
Rpm_Playlist_Empty.de: Diese Playlist ist leer. Füge Titel hinzu, indem du auf + tippst

Rpm_Playlist_Missing.en: {0} tracks aren't in the cloud yet
Rpm_Playlist_Missing.fr: {0} morceaux ne sont pas encore dans le cloud

Rpm_Playlist_MissingOne.en: 1 track isn't in the cloud yet
Rpm_Playlist_MissingOne.fr: 1 morceau n'est pas encore dans le cloud

Rpm_Playlist_MissingOne.zh-Hans: 1 首曲目尚未上传到云端

Rpm_Queue_Empty.en: Nothing is queued. Play something and it appears here.
Rpm_Queue_Empty.fr: La file est vide. Lancez un morceau et il apparaîtra ici.
Rpm_Queue_Empty.es: No hay nada en cola. Reproduce algo y aparecerá aquí.

Rpm_Library_View.comment: iPhone library header button: switch between the albums wall and the artists wall.

Rpm_Playlist_PlayList.comment: iPhone playlist page: the main button that plays the whole playlist from the top.

Rpm_Artist_PlayAll.comment: Key on an artist's page, on the iPhone and in Pegasus (the full-screen player) and the Android TV app: play every track by this artist.

ArtistSort_Name.comment: iPhone artists wall sort option: alphabetical.

ArtistSort_Albums.comment: iPhone artists wall sort option: the artists with the most records first.

ArtistSort_Tracks.comment: iPhone artists wall sort option: the artists with the most songs first.

ArtistSort_Added.comment: iPhone artists wall sort option: whoever's newest record arrived last.

Rip_TitleCd.comment: Header of the window that reads an audio CD and rips it into the library.

Rip_TitleDvd.comment: Header of the window that rips a video DVD's audio into the library.

Pane_Dismiss.comment: Tooltip on the × that closes the left pane's message band.

Rip_Classical.comment: Rip window: mark this disc as a classical record, which turns on the per-track work grouping.

Rip_ClassicalTip.en: Group the tracks into works and movements
Rip_ClassicalTip.fr: Regrouper les pistes en œuvres et mouvements

Rip_ClassicalTip.comment: Tooltip for the Classical switch in the rip window.

Rip_MakePiece.comment: Tooltip on the button that takes a track back out of a work, making it a piece in its own right. The arrow says the rest.

Rip_OfferQuestion.en: There is an audio CD in the drive. Rip it into your collection?

Rip_OfferRip.comment: Button that answers the disc question with yes: opens the disc window on it.

Rip_OfferLater.comment: Button that answers the disc question with no. The disc is left alone and not ejected.

Rip_OfferTooltip.en: An audio CD is in the drive
Rip_OfferTooltip.fr: Un CD audio est dans le lecteur
Rip_OfferTooltip.es: Hay un CD de audio en la unidad
Rip_OfferTooltip.zh-Hans: 光驱中有一张音频 CD
Rip_OfferTooltip.comment: Tooltip on the rip chip while it is asking about a disc rather than showing a rip.

Rip_AutoPlayAction.zh-Hans: 使用 rpm 抓取光盘
Rip_AutoPlayAction.comment: How rpm names itself in the Windows AutoPlay list of things that can happen when a music CD goes in. Windows shows it, not the app.

Rip_CancelTooltip.en: Discard everything this rip has made

Rip_SkipTrackTooltip.zh-Hans: 跳过此曲目并继续下一首

Rip_SkippedUnreadable.de: Übersprungen: zu viel von diesem Titel war nicht lesbar

Rip_TracksRepaired.de: {0} mit unlesbaren Stellen, die mit Stille gefüllt wurden
