Rpm_Tab_Profile.comment: iPhone tab bar label for the account and settings screen.

Rpm_Profile_Subtitle.en: Your account, your storage, and how the app behaves.
Rpm_Profile_Subtitle.fr: Votre compte, votre stockage et le comportement de l'app.
Rpm_Profile_Subtitle.es: Tu cuenta, tu almacenamiento y cómo se comporta la app.
Rpm_Profile_Subtitle.de: Dein Konto, dein Speicher und wie sich die App verhält.
Rpm_Profile_Subtitle.zh-Hans: 你的账户、存储空间，以及应用的行为方式。

Rpm_Profile_SignOutDetail.en: The library is streamed, so signing out leaves nothing behind on this phone.
Rpm_Profile_SignOutDetail.fr: La bibliothèque est diffusée en streaming : la déconnexion ne laisse rien sur ce téléphone.
Rpm_Profile_SignOutDetail.es: La biblioteca se reproduce en streaming, así que cerrar sesión no deja nada en este teléfono.
Rpm_Profile_SignOutDetail.de: Die Bibliothek wird gestreamt, beim Abmelden bleibt auf diesem Telefon nichts zurück.
Rpm_Profile_SignOutDetail.zh-Hans: 音乐库通过流媒体播放，退出登录不会在本机留下任何内容。

Rpm_Profile_DeleteAccount.comment: Profile tab (iPhone), Account card: the red key beside Sign out, one third of the row wide, that opens the delete-account confirmation. One word, because the key is too narrow for Account_Delete. Read aloud as Account_Delete.

Rpm_Profile_Plan.comment: Settings, Profile page: title of the card saying whether this account supports rpm.

Rpm_Profile_PlanFree.comment: Settings, Profile page: the standing of an account that does not support rpm.

Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeDetail.en: 100 GB of cloud storage, every feature, no time limit.
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeDetail.fr: 100 Go de stockage cloud, toutes les fonctions, sans limite de durée.
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeDetail.es: 100 GB de almacenamiento en la nube, todas las funciones, sin límite de tiempo.
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeDetail.de: 100 GB Cloud-Speicher, alle Funktionen, ohne Zeitlimit.
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeDetail.zh-Hans: 100 GB 云存储空间，全部功能，无时间限制。
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeDetail.comment: Settings, Profile page: what an account gets without supporting rpm.

Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeAppeal.en: Please consider supporting rpm. Supporters keep the lights on and get access to supporter-exclusive features.
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeAppeal.fr: Pensez à soutenir rpm. Les soutiens font vivre l'application et ont accès à des fonctions réservées.
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeAppeal.es: Considera apoyar rpm. Los colaboradores mantienen el proyecto en marcha y tienen acceso a funciones exclusivas.
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeAppeal.de: Bitte erwäge, rpm zu unterstützen. Unterstützer halten das Licht an und erhalten Zugang zu exklusiven Funktionen.
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeAppeal.zh-Hans: 请考虑支持 rpm。支持者让 rpm 得以运转，并可使用支持者专属功能。
Rpm_Profile_PlanFreeAppeal.comment: Settings, Profile page: second paragraph under 'Not a supporter', asking the account to support rpm.

Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterDetail.en: Unlimited cloud storage, higher bitrates, advanced recognition, DJ mode and more.
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterDetail.fr: Stockage cloud illimité, débits plus élevés, reconnaissance avancée, mode DJ et plus encore.
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterDetail.es: Almacenamiento en la nube ilimitado, mayor tasa de bits, reconocimiento avanzado, modo DJ y mucho más.
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterDetail.de: Unbegrenzter Cloud-Speicher, höhere Bitraten, erweiterte Erkennung, DJ-Modus und mehr.
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterDetail.zh-Hans: 无限云存储、更高码率、高级识别、DJ 模式等更多功能。
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterDetail.comment: Settings, Profile page: what supporting rpm gets you.

Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterThanks.en: Thank you for supporting rpm. You help keep rpm going and fund new development. We are humbled by your generosity.
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterThanks.fr: Merci de soutenir rpm. Vous aidez rpm à continuer et financez son développement. Votre générosité nous touche.
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterThanks.es: Gracias por apoyar rpm. Ayudas a que rpm siga adelante y financias su desarrollo. Tu generosidad nos conmueve.
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterThanks.de: Danke, dass du rpm unterstützt. Du hilfst, rpm am Laufen zu halten, und finanzierst die Weiterentwicklung. Deine Großzügigkeit bewegt uns.
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterThanks.zh-Hans: 感谢你支持 rpm。你帮助 rpm 持续运行，并资助新的开发。你的慷慨让我们深受感动。
Rpm_Profile_PlanSupporterThanks.comment: Settings, Profile page: second paragraph under 'Supporter', thanking the account for supporting rpm.

Rpm_Profile_QualityDetail.en: The original is exactly as it was uploaded. A lower bitrate uses less data and less space on your phone.
Rpm_Profile_QualityDetail.fr: L'original est exactement tel qu'il a été téléversé. Un débit plus faible consomme moins de données et moins d'espace sur votre téléphone.
Rpm_Profile_QualityDetail.es: El original es exactamente como se subió. Una tasa de bits menor consume menos datos y menos espacio en el teléfono.
Rpm_Profile_QualityDetail.de: Das Original ist genau so, wie es hochgeladen wurde. Eine niedrigere Bitrate verbraucht weniger Daten und weniger Speicher auf dem Telefon.
Rpm_Profile_QualityDetail.zh-Hans: 原始音质与上传时完全一致。较低的码率占用更少的流量和手机空间。
Rpm_Profile_QualityDetail.comment: Settings, Profile page: what the quality choices do.

Rpm_Profile_QualityCapped.en: Supporters can choose any bitrate, up to the original file.
Rpm_Profile_QualityCapped.fr: Les soutiens peuvent choisir n'importe quel débit, jusqu'au fichier d'origine.
Rpm_Profile_QualityCapped.es: Los colaboradores pueden elegir cualquier tasa de bits, hasta el archivo original.
Rpm_Profile_QualityCapped.de: Unterstützer können jede Bitrate wählen, bis hin zur Originaldatei.
Rpm_Profile_QualityCapped.zh-Hans: 支持者可以选择任意码率，直至原始文件。
Rpm_Profile_QualityCapped.comment: Settings, Profile page: why the quality boxes are greyed out for an account that is not a supporter.

Rpm_Profile_QualityLowData.en: Low Data Mode is on, so music streams at 128 kbps.
Rpm_Profile_QualityLowData.fr: Le mode Données limitées est activé, la musique est diffusée à 128 kb/s.
Rpm_Profile_QualityLowData.es: El modo de datos reducidos está activado, la música se reproduce a 128 kb/s.
Rpm_Profile_QualityLowData.de: Sparmodus ist aktiv, Musik wird mit 128 kbit/s gestreamt.
Rpm_Profile_QualityLowData.zh-Hans: 已开启低数据模式，音乐以 128 kbps 播放。
Rpm_Profile_QualityLowData.comment: iPhone settings, under the two streaming quality pickers: shown only while iOS Low Data Mode is on, because it overrules both. Downloads are not affected.

Rpm_Profile_LevellingDetail.en: Plays every album at the same loudness, so you don't have to change the volume between albums. A track that hasn't been measured yet plays at its original level.
Rpm_Profile_LevellingDetail.fr: Joue chaque album au même niveau sonore, pour que vous n'ayez pas à régler le volume d'un album à l'autre. Une piste qui n'a pas encore été mesurée est jouée à son niveau d'origine.
Rpm_Profile_LevellingDetail.es: Reproduce cada álbum al mismo volumen, así no tienes que ajustarlo de un álbum a otro. Una pista que aún no se ha medido suena a su nivel original.
Rpm_Profile_LevellingDetail.de: Spielt jedes Album gleich laut, damit du zwischen zwei Alben nicht die Lautstärke ändern musst. Ein Titel, der noch nicht gemessen wurde, spielt in seiner ursprünglichen Lautstärke.
Rpm_Profile_LevellingDetail.zh-Hans: 让每张专辑以相同响度播放，专辑之间无需再调音量。尚未测量的曲目按原始音量播放。
Rpm_Profile_LevellingDetail.comment: Settings, Profile page (phone): under the Volume levelling choice. Says what levelling does and what happens to a track with no loudness measurement.

Rpm_Profile_Tagline.fr: rpm, redécouvrez votre collection de musique.
Rpm_Profile_Tagline.es: rpm, redescubre tu colección de música.
Rpm_Profile_Tagline.zh-Hans: rpm，重新发现你的音乐收藏。
Rpm_Profile_Tagline.comment: Phone, Profile tab: the app's own line, under the About heading. The same line the desktop's About card carries (Profile_Tagline).

Rpm_Profile_QualityDownload.comment: iPhone settings, Playback card: label of the third quality picker, the bitrate albums are downloaded at. Sits under Rpm_Profile_QualityCellular.

Rpm_Profile_QualityDownloadDetail.en: Applies to new downloads. Albums already on your phone keep their bitrate. A bitrate that is not ready yet is prepared first, then downloaded.
Rpm_Profile_QualityDownloadDetail.fr: S'applique aux nouveaux téléchargements. Les albums déjà sur votre téléphone gardent leur débit. Un débit qui n'est pas encore prêt est d'abord préparé, puis téléchargé.
Rpm_Profile_QualityDownloadDetail.es: Se aplica a las nuevas descargas. Los álbumes que ya están en el teléfono mantienen su tasa de bits. Una tasa de bits que aún no está lista se prepara primero y luego se descarga.
Rpm_Profile_QualityDownloadDetail.de: Gilt für neue Downloads. Alben, die schon auf dem Telefon sind, behalten ihre Bitrate. Eine Bitrate, die noch nicht bereit ist, wird zuerst vorbereitet und dann geladen.
Rpm_Profile_QualityDownloadDetail.zh-Hans: 适用于新的下载。手机上已有的专辑保留原来的码率。尚未准备好的码率会先准备，然后再下载。
Rpm_Profile_QualityDownloadDetail.comment: iPhone settings, Playback card: under the download quality picker.

Naming_ApplySaved.fr: Les modèles de nommage ont été enregistrés.
Naming_ApplySaved.es: Se han guardado las plantillas de nombres.

Naming_ApplyQuestion.en: What should the default template apply to?
Naming_ApplyQuestion.fr: À quoi le modèle par défaut doit-il s'appliquer ?
Naming_ApplyQuestion.es: ¿A qué debe aplicarse la plantilla predeterminada?
Naming_ApplyQuestion.de: Worauf soll die Standardvorlage angewendet werden?
Naming_ApplyQuestion.zh-Hans: 默认模板应用于哪些文件？

Naming_ApplyExplain.en: New files are always filed by the default template. The music already in the collection keeps the folders and names it has, unless it is re-filed now. Re-filing moves the files on disk; each album's cover and review move with it.
Naming_ApplyExplain.fr: Les nouveaux fichiers sont toujours classés selon le modèle par défaut. La musique déjà dans la collection garde ses dossiers et ses noms, sauf si elle est reclassée maintenant. Le reclassement déplace les fichiers sur le disque ; la pochette et la critique de chaque album suivent.
Naming_ApplyExplain.es: Los archivos nuevos siempre se organizan con la plantilla predeterminada. La música que ya está en la colección conserva sus carpetas y nombres, salvo que se reorganice ahora. Reorganizar mueve los archivos en el disco; la portada y la reseña de cada álbum se mueven con ellos.
Naming_ApplyExplain.de: Neue Dateien werden immer nach der Standardvorlage abgelegt. Die Musik, die bereits in der Sammlung liegt, behält ihre Ordner und Namen, sofern sie nicht jetzt neu abgelegt wird. Das Neuablegen verschiebt die Dateien auf der Festplatte; Cover und Rezension jedes Albums wandern mit.
Naming_ApplyExplain.zh-Hans: 新文件始终按默认模板归档。已在音乐收藏中的音乐会保留现有文件夹和名称，除非现在重新归档。重新归档会移动磁盘上的文件，每张专辑的封面和乐评也会一并移动。

Naming_ApplyCount.zh-Hans: 音乐收藏中有 {0} 首曲目。

Naming_ApplyDone.es: Listo: {0} movidas, {1} ya en su sitio.
Naming_ApplyDone.de: Fertig: {0} verschoben, {1} bereits am richtigen Ort.
Naming_ApplyDone.zh-Hans: 完成：已移动 {0} 首，{1} 首本已就位。

Naming_ApplyRefused.en: {0} files could not be moved and were left as they were.
Naming_ApplyRefused.fr: {0} fichiers n'ont pas pu être déplacés et ont été laissés tels quels.
Naming_ApplyRefused.es: No se pudieron mover {0} archivos y se dejaron como estaban.
Naming_ApplyRefused.de: {0} Dateien konnten nicht verschoben werden und blieben unverändert.
Naming_ApplyRefused.zh-Hans: 有 {0} 个文件无法移动，已保持原样。

Naming_ApplyStopped.en: Stopped. Files that already moved stay where they are.
Naming_ApplyStopped.fr: Arrêté. Les fichiers déjà déplacés restent où ils sont.
Naming_ApplyStopped.es: Detenido. Los archivos ya movidos se quedan donde están.
Naming_ApplyStopped.de: Gestoppt. Bereits verschobene Dateien bleiben, wo sie sind.
Naming_ApplyStopped.zh-Hans: 已停止。已经移动的文件保持在原处。

Settings_NamingSaveHint.en: Saving makes the template above the default for the collection.
Settings_NamingSaveHint.fr: Enregistrer fait du modèle ci-dessus celui par défaut pour la collection.
Settings_NamingSaveHint.es: Al guardar, la plantilla de arriba pasa a ser la predeterminada de la colección.
Settings_NamingSaveHint.de: Beim Speichern wird die Vorlage oben zur Standardvorlage der Sammlung.
Settings_NamingSaveHint.zh-Hans: 保存后，上方的模板将成为音乐收藏的默认模板。

CloudChip_PauseTooltip.en: Pause. Nothing is lost, the queue continues where it left off.
CloudChip_PauseTooltip.fr: Mettre en pause. Rien n'est perdu, la file reprend où elle s'est arrêtée.
CloudChip_PauseTooltip.es: Pausar. No se pierde nada, la cola continúa donde se quedó.
CloudChip_PauseTooltip.de: Pausieren. Nichts geht verloren, die Warteschlange macht dort weiter, wo sie war.
CloudChip_PauseTooltip.zh-Hans: 暂停。不会丢失任何内容，队列会从中断处继续。

CloudChip_SummaryPaused.comment: Cloud chip flyout header after the user pauses an upload run, with the tracks finished and the total expected.

CloudChip_Paused.comment: Cloud chip flyout header when an upload run was paused before any track finished, so there are no counts to show.

CloudChip_Resume.comment: Cloud chip flyout button that starts a paused upload run again.

CloudChip_ResumeTooltip.en: Start uploading again, from where it stopped.
CloudChip_ResumeTooltip.fr: Reprendre l'envoi là où il s'est arrêté.
CloudChip_ResumeTooltip.es: Reanudar la subida desde donde se detuvo.
CloudChip_ResumeTooltip.de: Upload dort fortsetzen, wo er gestoppt wurde.
CloudChip_ResumeTooltip.comment: Tooltip on the cloud chip's Resume button.

Cloud_HistoryHint.en: Uploads, removals and downloads from the last {0} days.
Cloud_HistoryHint.fr: Envois, suppressions et téléchargements des {0} derniers jours.
Cloud_HistoryHint.es: Subidas, eliminaciones y descargas de los últimos {0} días.
Cloud_HistoryHint.de: Uploads, Entfernungen und Downloads der letzten {0} Tage.
Cloud_HistoryHint.zh-Hans: 最近 {0} 天的上传、移除和下载记录。

CloudChip_SummaryPreparingUpload.en: Checking what needs to be uploaded.
CloudChip_SummaryPreparingUpload.fr: Vérification de ce qui doit être envoyé.
CloudChip_SummaryPreparingUpload.de: Es wird geprüft, was hochgeladen werden muss.
CloudChip_SummaryPreparingUpload.zh-Hans: 正在检查需要上传的内容。

CloudChip_SummaryPreparingRemove.en: Taking music out of the cloud.
CloudChip_SummaryPreparingRemove.de: Musik wird aus der Cloud entfernt.

Profile_SignedOut.en: You are not signed in. An account is needed for cloud storage, the catalogues and your plan.
Profile_SignedOut.fr: Vous n'êtes pas connecté. Un compte est nécessaire pour le stockage cloud, les catalogues et votre formule.
Profile_SignedOut.es: No has iniciado sesión. Necesitas una cuenta para el almacenamiento en la nube, los catálogos y tu plan.
Profile_SignedOut.de: Du bist nicht angemeldet. Für Cloud-Speicher, die Kataloge und deinen Tarif wird ein Konto benötigt.
Profile_SignedOut.zh-Hans: 你尚未登录。云存储、目录服务和你的套餐都需要账户。

Profile_SignOutDetail.en: Signing out stops the cloud sync. The music on this computer stays exactly where it is.
Profile_SignOutDetail.fr: La déconnexion arrête la synchronisation cloud. La musique sur cet ordinateur reste où elle est.
Profile_SignOutDetail.es: Cerrar sesión detiene la sincronización con la nube. La música de este ordenador se queda donde está.
Profile_SignOutDetail.de: Beim Abmelden stoppt die Cloud-Synchronisierung. Die Musik auf diesem Computer bleibt, wo sie ist.
Profile_SignOutDetail.zh-Hans: 退出登录会停止云端同步。这台电脑上的音乐保持原样。

Account_Delete.comment: Button in Settings, Profile (desktop), under Sign out. Opens the confirmation; also the confirmation's red button on the desktop and the iPhone, and the spoken label of the iPhone's shorter Rpm_Profile_DeleteAccount key.

Account_DeleteBody.en: This deletes your rpm account, your profile and everything in your cloud library: uploaded music, cover art and playlists. Your reviews and comments stay, shown as Deleted user. This cannot be undone.
Account_DeleteBody.fr: Cela supprime votre compte rpm, votre profil et tout le contenu de votre bibliothèque cloud : musique envoyée, pochettes et playlists. Vos critiques et commentaires restent, affichés sous le nom Utilisateur supprimé. Cette action est irréversible.
Account_DeleteBody.es: Esto elimina tu cuenta de rpm, tu perfil y todo lo que hay en tu biblioteca en la nube: música subida, portadas y listas de reproducción. Tus reseñas y comentarios se quedan y se muestran como Usuario eliminado. No se puede deshacer.
Account_DeleteBody.de: Dadurch werden dein rpm-Konto, dein Profil und alles in deiner Cloud-Bibliothek gelöscht: hochgeladene Musik, Cover und Playlists. Deine Rezensionen und Kommentare bleiben und werden als Gelöschter Nutzer angezeigt. Dies kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden.
Account_DeleteBody.zh-Hans: 这会删除你的 rpm 账户、个人资料以及云端音乐库中的所有内容：已上传的音乐、封面和播放列表。你的评论和留言会保留，显示为“已删除的用户”。此操作无法撤销。
Account_DeleteBody.comment: Body of the delete-account confirmation, on both heads.

Account_DeleteKeepsFiles.en: Music files on this computer are not deleted.
Account_DeleteKeepsFiles.fr: Les fichiers musicaux sur cet ordinateur ne sont pas supprimés.
Account_DeleteKeepsFiles.es: Los archivos de música de este ordenador no se eliminan.
Account_DeleteKeepsFiles.de: Musikdateien auf diesem Computer werden nicht gelöscht.
Account_DeleteKeepsFiles.zh-Hans: 此电脑上的音乐文件不会被删除。
Account_DeleteKeepsFiles.comment: Second line of the delete-account confirmation on the desktop.

Account_DeleteCloudOnlyOne.en: 1 track is only in the cloud and will be lost.
Account_DeleteCloudOnlyOne.fr: 1 morceau n'est que dans le cloud et sera perdu.
Account_DeleteCloudOnlyOne.es: 1 canción solo está en la nube y se perderá.
Account_DeleteCloudOnlyOne.de: 1 Titel ist nur in der Cloud und geht verloren.
Account_DeleteCloudOnlyOne.zh-Hans: 有 1 首曲目仅存在于云端，将会丢失。
Account_DeleteCloudOnlyOne.comment: Desktop delete-account confirmation, when exactly one track on this computer exists only in the cloud (offloaded).

Account_DeleteCloudOnly.en: {0} tracks are only in the cloud and will be lost.
Account_DeleteCloudOnly.fr: {0} morceaux ne sont que dans le cloud et seront perdus.
Account_DeleteCloudOnly.es: {0} canciones solo están en la nube y se perderán.
Account_DeleteCloudOnly.de: {0} Titel sind nur in der Cloud und gehen verloren.
Account_DeleteCloudOnly.zh-Hans: 有 {0} 首曲目仅存在于云端，将会丢失。
Account_DeleteCloudOnly.comment: Desktop delete-account confirmation, when more than one track on this computer exists only in the cloud. {0} is the count.

Account_DeleteTypeEmail.comment: Delete-account confirmation, above the box. {0} is the account's email address.

Account_Deleting.comment: The delete-account confirmation's red button while the request runs.

Account_DeleteEmailRefused.en: This email doesn't match your account. If it is correct, contact support.
Account_DeleteEmailRefused.fr: Cette adresse ne correspond pas à votre compte. Si elle est correcte, contactez l'assistance.
Account_DeleteEmailRefused.es: Este correo no coincide con tu cuenta. Si es correcto, contacta con soporte.
Account_DeleteEmailRefused.de: Diese E-Mail-Adresse passt nicht zu deinem Konto. Wenn sie stimmt, wende dich an den Support.
Account_DeleteEmailRefused.zh-Hans: 此邮箱与你的账户不符。如果邮箱无误，请联系支持。
Account_DeleteEmailRefused.comment: Shown in the delete-account confirmation when the server refuses the typed address.

Account_DeleteFailed.en: Your account could not be deleted. Check your connection and try again.
Account_DeleteFailed.fr: Votre compte n'a pas pu être supprimé. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
Account_DeleteFailed.es: No se pudo eliminar tu cuenta. Comprueba tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.
Account_DeleteFailed.de: Dein Konto konnte nicht gelöscht werden. Prüfe deine Verbindung und versuche es erneut.
Account_DeleteFailed.zh-Hans: 无法删除你的账户。请检查网络连接后重试。
Account_DeleteFailed.comment: Shown in the delete-account confirmation when the request did not get through or the server failed. Nothing was deleted.

Account_DeletedTitle.comment: Title of the note shown after the account was deleted.

Account_DeletedBody.en: Your account is deleted and you are signed out. Your cloud library is removed within two hours. You can keep using rpm without an account.
Account_DeletedBody.fr: Votre compte est supprimé et vous êtes déconnecté. Votre bibliothèque cloud est effacée sous deux heures. Vous pouvez continuer à utiliser rpm sans compte.
Account_DeletedBody.es: Tu cuenta se ha eliminado y has cerrado sesión. Tu biblioteca en la nube se borra en un plazo de dos horas. Puedes seguir usando rpm sin cuenta.
Account_DeletedBody.de: Dein Konto ist gelöscht und du bist abgemeldet. Deine Cloud-Bibliothek wird innerhalb von zwei Stunden entfernt. Du kannst rpm ohne Konto weiter nutzen.
Account_DeletedBody.zh-Hans: 你的账户已删除，你已退出登录。你的云端音乐库将在两小时内移除。你可以继续在没有账户的情况下使用 rpm。
Account_DeletedBody.comment: Body of the note shown after the account was deleted, on both heads.

Community_DeletedUser.comment: Shown in place of the author's name on a review, comment or wall post whose account was deleted.

Profile_DataFolderDetail.en: Settings, the artwork cache and your sign-in are kept here. Your music is not: it lives in your music folder.
Profile_DataFolderDetail.fr: Les réglages, le cache des pochettes et votre connexion sont conservés ici. Pas votre musique : elle vit dans votre dossier musical.
Profile_DataFolderDetail.es: Aquí se guardan los ajustes, la caché de portadas y tu sesión. Tu música no: está en tu carpeta de música.
Profile_DataFolderDetail.de: Einstellungen, der Cover-Cache und deine Anmeldung liegen hier. Deine Musik nicht: die liegt in deinem Musikordner.
Profile_DataFolderDetail.zh-Hans: 设置、封面缓存和登录信息保存在这里。你的音乐不在此处：它保存在你的音乐文件夹中。

Profile_Cache.comment: Settings, Profile page: title of the card for downloaded lookup data.

Profile_CacheDetail.en: Artwork, radio stations, lyrics and album information downloaded from the internet. It is kept for 30 days, then downloaded again when needed.
Profile_CacheDetail.fr: Pochettes, stations de radio, paroles et informations sur les albums téléchargées depuis Internet. Ces données sont conservées 30 jours, puis retéléchargées si nécessaire.
Profile_CacheDetail.es: Portadas, emisoras de radio, letras e información de álbumes descargadas de internet. Se conservan 30 días y se vuelven a descargar cuando hacen falta.
Profile_CacheDetail.de: Cover, Radiosender, Songtexte und Albuminformationen aus dem Internet. Sie werden 30 Tage aufbewahrt und bei Bedarf erneut geladen.
Profile_CacheDetail.zh-Hans: 从互联网下载的封面、电台、歌词和专辑信息。保留 30 天，需要时会重新下载。
Profile_CacheDetail.comment: Settings, Profile page: what the cached data card holds.

Profile_CacheUsed.comment: Settings, Profile page: size of the cache. {0} is a size such as 24.3 MB.

Profile_ClearCache.comment: Settings, Profile page: button that empties the cached data.

Update_Title.comment: Title of the window shown when a new version has been downloaded.

Update_Body.en: rpm {0} is ready to install. Restart now, or it installs the next time you quit.
Update_Body.fr: rpm {0} est prêt à être installé. Redémarrez maintenant, ou la mise à jour s'installera à la prochaine fermeture.
Update_Body.es: rpm {0} está listo para instalarse. Reinicia ahora o se instalará la próxima vez que cierres la app.
Update_Body.de: rpm {0} kann installiert werden. Jetzt neu starten, oder es wird beim nächsten Beenden installiert.
Update_Body.zh-Hans: rpm {0} 已可安装。可以立即重启，或在下次退出时自动安装。
Update_Body.comment: Body of the update window. {0} is a version such as 0.2.0.

Update_Restart.comment: Button in the update window: quit and come back on the new version.

Update_Later.comment: Button in the update window: keep going, install it at the next quit.

Profile_Updates.comment: Settings, Profile page: title of the updates card.

Profile_UpdatesDetail.en: rpm checks for a new version when it starts, downloads it in the background and installs it when you quit.
Profile_UpdatesDetail.fr: rpm vérifie s'il existe une nouvelle version au démarrage, la télécharge en arrière-plan et l'installe à la fermeture.
Profile_UpdatesDetail.es: rpm busca una versión nueva al iniciarse, la descarga en segundo plano y la instala al cerrar.
Profile_UpdatesDetail.de: rpm sucht beim Start nach einer neuen Version, lädt sie im Hintergrund und installiert sie beim Beenden.
Profile_UpdatesDetail.zh-Hans: rpm 会在启动时检查新版本，在后台下载，并在退出时安装。
Profile_UpdatesDetail.comment: Settings, Profile page: what the updates card does.

Profile_CheckUpdates.comment: Settings, Profile page: button that reads the update feed now.

Update_Checking.comment: Settings, Profile page: status while the update feed is being read.

Update_Current.comment: Settings, Profile page: status when this is the newest version.

Update_Fetching.fr: Téléchargement de la mise à jour…
Update_Fetching.comment: Settings, Profile page: status while the new version is being downloaded.

Update_Ready.en: rpm {0} is ready. Restart to install.
Update_Ready.fr: rpm {0} est prêt. Redémarrez pour installer.
Update_Ready.es: rpm {0} está listo. Reinicia para instalarlo.
Update_Ready.de: rpm {0} ist bereit. Zum Installieren neu starten.
Update_Ready.zh-Hans: rpm {0} 已就绪。重启以安装。
Update_Ready.comment: Settings, Profile page: status when a version is downloaded and waiting. {0} is a version such as 0.2.0.

Update_Failed.fr: Impossible de vérifier les mises à jour.
Update_Failed.de: Nach Updates konnte nicht gesucht werden.
Update_Failed.comment: Settings, Profile page: status when the update feed could not be read.

Update_Unmanaged.en: This copy of rpm does not update itself.
Update_Unmanaged.fr: Cette copie de rpm ne se met pas à jour toute seule.
Update_Unmanaged.es: Esta copia de rpm no se actualiza sola.
Update_Unmanaged.de: Diese Kopie von rpm aktualisiert sich nicht selbst.
Update_Unmanaged.zh-Hans: 此版本的 rpm 不会自动更新。
Update_Unmanaged.comment: Settings, Profile page: status in a build that was not installed by the installer.

Crash_PromptTitle.fr: rpm s'est fermé de manière inattendue
Crash_PromptTitle.comment: Title of the window shown at launch after rpm crashed, asking once whether to send crash reports.

Crash_PromptBody.en: Send crash reports automatically? A report contains the error, the app version, your operating system and the last things rpm did before it closed, which can include track and file names.
Crash_PromptBody.fr: Envoyer automatiquement les rapports de plantage ? Un rapport contient l'erreur, la version de l'app, votre système d'exploitation et les dernières actions de rpm avant sa fermeture, qui peuvent inclure des noms de morceaux et de fichiers.
Crash_PromptBody.es: ¿Enviar informes de fallos automáticamente? Un informe contiene el error, la versión de la app, tu sistema operativo y lo último que hizo rpm antes de cerrarse, lo que puede incluir nombres de pistas y de archivos.
Crash_PromptBody.de: Absturzberichte automatisch senden? Ein Bericht enthält den Fehler, die App-Version, das Betriebssystem und die letzten Aktionen von rpm vor dem Beenden, darunter möglicherweise Titel- und Dateinamen.
Crash_PromptBody.zh-Hans: 自动发送崩溃报告？报告包含错误信息、应用版本、操作系统，以及 rpm 关闭前的最后操作，其中可能包含曲目名和文件名。
Crash_PromptBody.comment: Body of the crash window. The answer is remembered; Settings, Profile can change it.

Crash_PromptSend.comment: Button in the crash window: send this and future crash reports without asking.

Crash_PromptDontSend.comment: Button in the crash window: never send crash reports, and delete the ones waiting.

Settings_CrashReports.comment: Settings > Profile, updates card: switch for sending crash reports.

Settings_CrashReportsDesc.en: When rpm closes unexpectedly, send a report so the problem can be fixed.
Settings_CrashReportsDesc.fr: Quand rpm se ferme de manière inattendue, envoyer un rapport pour que le problème puisse être corrigé.
Settings_CrashReportsDesc.es: Cuando rpm se cierre inesperadamente, enviar un informe para que se pueda corregir el problema.
Settings_CrashReportsDesc.de: Wenn rpm unerwartet beendet wird, einen Bericht senden, damit das Problem behoben werden kann.
Settings_CrashReportsDesc.zh-Hans: rpm 意外关闭时发送报告，以便修复问题。
Settings_CrashReportsDesc.comment: Settings > Profile: hint under the crash reports switch.

Profile_CacheCleared.comment: Settings, Profile page: confirmation shown after the cache is emptied.

Profile_Tagline.fr: rpm, redécouvrez votre collection de musique.
Profile_Tagline.es: rpm, redescubre tu colección de música.
Profile_Tagline.zh-Hans: rpm，重新发现你的音乐收藏。
Profile_Tagline.comment: Settings, Profile page: the app's own line, under the About heading.

AddMusic_DiscFromRelease.en: The release is a set of {0} discs. The one in the drive was matched by its tracks.
AddMusic_DiscFromRelease.fr: La sortie est un coffret de {0} disques. Celui dans le lecteur a été identifié par ses pistes.
AddMusic_DiscFromRelease.es: La edición es un conjunto de {0} discos. El del lector se identificó por sus pistas.
AddMusic_DiscFromRelease.de: Die Veröffentlichung ist ein Set aus {0} Discs. Die im Laufwerk wurde anhand ihrer Titel erkannt.
AddMusic_DiscFromRelease.zh-Hans: 该版本是 {0} 张碟的套装。驱动器中的这张已按曲目匹配。

AddMusic_DiscFromLibrary.en: “{0}” is already in your collection with {1} tracks, so this looks like disc {2}.
AddMusic_DiscFromLibrary.fr: « {0} » est déjà dans votre collection avec {1} pistes ; ceci semble être le disque {2}.
AddMusic_DiscFromLibrary.es: «{0}» ya está en tu colección con {1} pistas, así que este parece el disco {2}.
AddMusic_DiscFromLibrary.de: „{0}“ liegt bereits mit {1} Titeln in Ihrer Sammlung, das hier ist also wohl Disc {2}.
AddMusic_DiscFromLibrary.zh-Hans: 音乐收藏中已有《{0}》，共 {1} 首曲目，因此这张应该是第 {2} 张碟。

AddMusic_DiscReRip.en: Your collection already has a disc {0} with these tracks. Ripping will replace it.
AddMusic_DiscReRip.fr: Votre collection contient déjà un disque {0} avec ces pistes. L'extraction le remplacera.
AddMusic_DiscReRip.es: Tu colección ya tiene un disco {0} con estas pistas. Extraerlo lo reemplazará.
AddMusic_DiscReRip.de: Ihre Sammlung hat bereits eine Disc {0} mit diesen Titeln. Das Auslesen ersetzt sie.
AddMusic_DiscReRip.zh-Hans: 音乐收藏中已有包含这些曲目的第 {0} 张碟。抓取将替换它。

Album_MoreActions.comment: Album page: tooltip on the key under the sleeve that opens the rest of the album's actions.

Album_NoPapers.en: No information was found for this album.
Album_NoPapers.fr: Aucune information n'a été trouvée pour cet album.
Album_NoPapers.es: No se encontró información sobre este álbum.
Album_NoPapers.de: Zu diesem Album wurden keine Informationen gefunden.
Album_NoPapers.zh-Hans: 未找到该专辑的相关信息。
Album_NoPapers.comment: Album page, papers panel: shown when the catalogues returned nothing about the record or the artist.

Album_PapersUnanswered.en: Album info could not be loaded.
Album_PapersUnanswered.fr: Les informations sur l'album n'ont pas pu être chargées.
Album_PapersUnanswered.es: No se pudo cargar la información del álbum.
Album_PapersUnanswered.de: Die Albuminformationen konnten nicht geladen werden.
Album_PapersUnanswered.comment: Album page, papers panel: shown when the catalogues or Wikipedia did not answer (no connection, a server error). Not the same as Album_NoPapers, which is an answer saying nothing is known.

Album_LoadingInfo.comment: Album page, papers panel: under the turning record, while the catalogues are being read.

Album_NoReviews.comment: Over the empty groove, on the reviews tab. A label on a placeholder, not a sentence: writing one is a button on the album page and the line does not need to say so.

Album_GrooveHide.comment: Tooltip on the key that folds the groove away, in its heading on the album page.

Album_GrooveShow.comment: Tooltip on the key at the right edge of the album page that brings a folded groove back.

Groove_Title.comment: Heading of the social column on the album page: reviews, comments and (later) who a listener follows.

Groove_Counts.comment: Line under the groove heading on the album page, counting what is in it.

Groove_PagePrevious.comment: Tooltip on the back key of the review pager on the album page.

Groove_PageNext.comment: Tooltip on the forward key of the review pager on the album page.

Album_VoteUp.comment: Tooltip on the up arrow under a review on the album page.

Album_VoteDown.comment: Tooltip on the down arrow under a review on the album page.

Groove_BeTheFirst.comment: Under 'No reviews yet' / 'No comments yet' on the empty groove: the invitation, said once for both tabs.

Album_NoComments.comment: Over the empty groove, on the comments tab. The box to write one is right underneath it.

Album_SignInToWrite.en: Sign in to write, vote and comment.
Album_SignInToWrite.fr: Connectez-vous pour écrire, voter et commenter.
Album_SignInToWrite.es: Inicia sesión para escribir, votar y comentar.
Album_SignInToWrite.de: Melden Sie sich an, um zu schreiben, abzustimmen und zu kommentieren.
Album_SignInToWrite.zh-Hans: 登录后可撰写、投票和留言。

Album_CommunityOffline.en: Reviews are not available right now.
Album_CommunityOffline.fr: Les avis ne sont pas disponibles pour le moment.
Album_CommunityOffline.es: Las reseñas no están disponibles ahora mismo.

Album_ReportComment.comment: Menu entry on somebody else's comment on the album page.

Album_ReportSent.fr: Merci. Votre signalement a été envoyé.
Album_ReportSent.es: Gracias. Se ha enviado tu informe.

Profile_WallDetail.en: Your display name and picture are public.
Profile_WallDetail.fr: Votre nom affiché et votre image sont publics.
Profile_WallDetail.es: Tu nombre visible y tu imagen son públicos.
Profile_WallDetail.de: Dein Anzeigename und dein Bild sind öffentlich.
Profile_WallDetail.zh-Hans: 你的显示名称和头像是公开的。
Profile_WallDetail.comment: Settings, Profile page: line under the account, saying the display name and picture are public.

Profile_NameTaken.es: Ese nombre ya está en uso.

Profile_PictureFailed.en: That picture could not be uploaded.
Profile_PictureFailed.fr: Cette image n’a pas pu être envoyée.
Profile_PictureFailed.es: No se pudo subir esa imagen.
Profile_PictureFailed.de: Dieses Bild konnte nicht hochgeladen werden.

Album_ReportAlbumPrompt.en: What is wrong with this album entry? Wrong title, wrong artist, wrong tracks, wrong cover.
Album_ReportAlbumPrompt.fr: Qu’est-ce qui ne va pas dans cette fiche d’album ? Titre, artiste, pistes ou pochette incorrects.
Album_ReportAlbumPrompt.es: ¿Qué está mal en esta ficha de álbum? Título, artista, pistas o portada incorrectos.
Album_ReportAlbumPrompt.de: Was stimmt an diesem Albumeintrag nicht? Falscher Titel, Interpret, Titelliste oder falsches Cover.
Album_ReportAlbumPrompt.zh-Hans: 这张专辑的条目哪里有误？标题、艺人、曲目或封面。

Album_ReportReviewPrompt.en: Why should someone look at this? Reports are read by a person, nothing is hidden automatically.
Album_ReportReviewPrompt.fr: Pourquoi faut-il regarder ceci ? Les signalements sont lus par une personne, rien n'est masqué automatiquement.
Album_ReportReviewPrompt.es: ¿Por qué debería revisarse esto? Los informes los lee una persona, no se oculta nada automáticamente.
Album_ReportReviewPrompt.de: Warum sollte sich das jemand ansehen? Meldungen werden von einer Person gelesen, nichts wird automatisch ausgeblendet.
Album_ReportReviewPrompt.zh-Hans: 为什么需要有人查看？举报会由人工阅读，系统不会自动隐藏任何内容。

Album_ReportCommentPrompt.en: Why should someone look at this? Reports are read by a person, nothing is hidden automatically.
Album_ReportCommentPrompt.fr: Pourquoi faut-il regarder ceci ? Les signalements sont lus par une personne, rien n'est masqué automatiquement.
Album_ReportCommentPrompt.es: ¿Por qué debería revisarse esto? Los informes los lee una persona, no se oculta nada automáticamente.
Album_ReportCommentPrompt.de: Warum sollte sich das jemand ansehen? Meldungen werden von einer Person gelesen, nichts wird automatisch ausgeblendet.
Album_ReportCommentPrompt.zh-Hans: 为什么需要有人查看？举报会由人工阅读，系统不会自动隐藏任何内容。
Album_ReportCommentPrompt.comment: Prompt in the report window when a comment is reported from the album page.

Login_NewHere.en: New here? Continue with Apple or Google and an account is made for you.
Login_NewHere.fr: Nouveau ? Continuez avec Apple ou Google, un compte est créé pour vous.
Login_NewHere.es: ¿Nuevo por aquí? Continúa con Apple o Google y se creará tu cuenta.
Login_NewHere.de: Neu hier? Weiter mit Apple oder Google, ein Konto wird für dich angelegt.
Login_NewHere.zh-Hans: 第一次使用？使用 Apple 或 Google 继续，账户会自动创建。

Login_Subtitle.en: Please sign in to your rpm account.
Login_Subtitle.fr: Veuillez vous connecter à votre compte rpm.
Login_Subtitle.es: Inicia sesión en tu cuenta rpm.
Login_Subtitle.de: Bitte melde dich bei deinem rpm-Konto an.
Login_Subtitle.zh-Hans: 请登录您的 rpm 账户。

Rpm_Album_EditReview.comment: Album page, phone: the same key once this reader has written one.

Rpm_Album_ReviewPlaceholder.en: What did you make of this record?
Rpm_Album_ReviewPlaceholder.de: Was halten Sie von dieser Platte?
Rpm_Album_ReviewPlaceholder.zh-Hans: 你觉得这张唱片怎么样？
Rpm_Album_ReviewPlaceholder.comment: Album page, phone: placeholder in the review sheet's text box.

Rpm_Album_RatingNeeded.comment: Album page, phone: saving a review with no stars. The wall keeps a verdict on every review.

Rpm_Album_MoreReviews.comment: Album page, phone: adds the next page of reviews underneath instead of a row of page numbers.

Settings_Display.comment: Settings rail: the section for how the app looks.

Settings_DisplayIntro.en: How rpm looks: the picture behind the app, and the art display.
Settings_DisplayIntro.fr: L'apparence de rpm : l'image en arrière-plan et l'affichage des pochettes.
Settings_DisplayIntro.es: El aspecto de rpm: la imagen de fondo y la vista de portadas.
Settings_DisplayIntro.de: Das Aussehen von rpm: das Hintergrundbild und die Cover-Ansicht.
Settings_DisplayIntro.zh-Hans: rpm 的外观：应用背景图片和封面显示。
Settings_DisplayIntro.comment: Settings > Display: caption under the page heading.

Settings_Sound.comment: Settings rail: the section for the speakers the music comes out of.

Settings_SoundIntro.en: Which speakers the music plays through, how loud it is, and how it is tuned.
Settings_SoundIntro.fr: Sur quelles enceintes la musique est jouée, à quel volume et avec quel réglage.
Settings_SoundIntro.es: Por qué altavoces suena la música, a qué volumen y con qué ajuste.
Settings_SoundIntro.de: Über welche Lautsprecher die Musik läuft, wie laut sie ist und wie sie eingestellt ist.
Settings_SoundIntro.zh-Hans: 音乐通过哪些扬声器播放、音量大小，以及音效调节。
Settings_SoundIntro.comment: Settings > Sound: caption under the page heading.

Settings_Output.comment: Settings, Sound: label above the output-device picker.

Settings_OutputHint.en: Where the music plays. With the system default, rpm switches with it when you connect a speaker or change outputs. Pick a device and it stays there.
Settings_OutputHint.fr: Où la musique est jouée. Avec la sortie par défaut du système, rpm change en même temps que lui lorsque vous branchez une enceinte ou changez de sortie. Choisissez un appareil et il ne bouge plus.
Settings_OutputHint.es: Dónde suena la música. Con la salida predeterminada del sistema, rpm cambia con él cuando conectas un altavoz o cambias de salida. Elige un dispositivo y se queda fijo.
Settings_OutputHint.de: Wo die Musik spielt. Mit dem Systemstandard wechselt rpm mit, sobald du einen Lautsprecher anschließt oder die Ausgabe wechselst. Wähle ein Gerät, und es bleibt dabei.
Settings_OutputHint.zh-Hans: 音乐的播放位置。使用系统默认设备时，连接扬声器或切换输出后 rpm 会一同切换；选定某个设备后则固定不变。
Settings_OutputHint.comment: Settings, Sound: hint under the output-device picker.

Settings_OutputSystem.fr: Utiliser la sortie par défaut du système
Settings_OutputSystem.es: Usar la salida predeterminada del sistema
Settings_OutputSystem.comment: Settings, Sound: first item in the output picker, the default.

Settings_OutputMissing.en: Not connected right now, so the music plays on the system's speakers until it is reconnected.
Settings_OutputMissing.fr: Pas connecté pour le moment : la musique passe par les enceintes du système jusqu'à sa reconnexion.
Settings_OutputMissing.es: No está conectado ahora mismo, así que la música suena por los altavoces del sistema hasta que se vuelva a conectar.
Settings_OutputMissing.de: Gerade nicht verbunden, die Musik läuft daher über die Systemlautsprecher, bis es wieder da ist.
Settings_OutputMissing.zh-Hans: 当前未连接，音乐将通过系统扬声器播放，直到重新连接。
Settings_OutputMissing.comment: Settings, Sound: shown when the chosen device is not currently on the machine.

Settings_OutputNow.comment: Settings, Sound: which endpoint the app is actually on. {0} is the device name.

Settings_Eq.comment: Settings, Sound: heading of the equalizer card.

Settings_EqHint.en: The same ten bands as the player, saved per set of speakers: a curve that suits a laptop is wrong for a hi-fi, so each one is remembered separately.
Settings_EqHint.fr: Les mêmes dix bandes que le lecteur, enregistrées par jeu d'enceintes : une courbe qui convient à un portable ne convient pas à une chaîne, chacune est donc mémorisée séparément.
Settings_EqHint.es: Las mismas diez bandas que el reproductor, guardadas por juego de altavoces: una curva que va bien en un portátil no vale para un equipo, así que cada una se recuerda por separado.
Settings_EqHint.de: Dieselben zehn Bänder wie im Player, pro Lautsprecherpaar gespeichert: eine Kurve, die zu einem Laptop passt, taugt nicht für eine Anlage, deshalb wird jede einzeln gemerkt.
Settings_EqHint.zh-Hans: 与播放器相同的十个频段，按扬声器分别保存：适合笔记本的曲线并不适合音响，因此各自单独记忆。
Settings_EqHint.comment: Settings, Sound: hint under the equalizer heading, explaining the per-device curves.

Settings_EqOn.comment: Settings, Sound: the equalizer's on/off switch.

Settings_EqPreset.comment: Settings, Sound: label of the preset picker.

Settings_EqReset.comment: Settings, Sound: button that puts every band and the pre-amp back to zero.

Settings_EqPre.comment: Settings, Sound: short label under the pre-amp slider (ALLCAPS, like the player's).

Settings_EqFor.comment: Settings, Sound: which speakers the sliders belong to. {0} is the device name.

Settings_EqForCast.comment: Settings, Sound: shown instead of a device name while the audio is going to a Cast speaker.

Player_NoSpeakers.en: The speakers went away, so playback is paused. Press play once a speaker is available again.
Player_NoSpeakers.fr: Les enceintes ont disparu, la lecture est donc en pause. Appuyez sur lecture dès qu'une sortie est de nouveau disponible.
Player_NoSpeakers.es: Los altavoces han desaparecido, así que la reproducción está en pausa. Pulsa reproducir cuando vuelva a haber una salida disponible.
Player_NoSpeakers.de: Die Lautsprecher sind verschwunden, die Wiedergabe pausiert. Drücke auf Wiedergabe, sobald wieder eine Ausgabe verfügbar ist.
Player_NoSpeakers.zh-Hans: 扬声器已断开，播放已暂停。有可用输出后请再次点击播放。
Player_NoSpeakers.comment: Player: shown when the audio device disappeared and nothing replaced it within ten seconds.

AudioOut_Title.comment: Sound output message, shown when play is pressed and the computer's sound output is not working: the title band.

AudioOut_LibraryMissing.en: A file rpm needs to play sound is missing or blocked, so nothing can play.
AudioOut_LibraryMissing.fr: Un fichier dont rpm a besoin pour lire le son est manquant ou bloqué, donc rien ne peut être lu.
AudioOut_LibraryMissing.es: Falta o está bloqueado un archivo que rpm necesita para reproducir sonido, así que no se puede reproducir nada.
AudioOut_LibraryMissing.de: Eine Datei, die rpm für die Tonwiedergabe braucht, fehlt oder ist blockiert. Deshalb kann nichts wiedergegeben werden.
AudioOut_LibraryMissing.zh-Hans: rpm 播放声音所需的文件缺失或被阻止，因此无法播放。
AudioOut_LibraryMissing.comment: Sound output message: the sound library rpm ships could not be loaded.

AudioOut_NoDevice.en: No speakers or headphones were found, so nothing can play.
AudioOut_NoDevice.fr: Aucun haut-parleur ni casque n'a été trouvé, donc rien ne peut être lu.
AudioOut_NoDevice.es: No se han encontrado altavoces ni auriculares, así que no se puede reproducir nada.
AudioOut_NoDevice.de: Es wurden keine Lautsprecher oder Kopfhörer gefunden. Deshalb kann nichts wiedergegeben werden.
AudioOut_NoDevice.zh-Hans: 未找到扬声器或耳机，因此无法播放。
AudioOut_NoDevice.comment: Sound output message: the computer has no playback device at all.

AudioOut_Refused.en: rpm could not open {0}, so nothing can play.
AudioOut_Refused.fr: rpm n'a pas pu ouvrir {0}, donc rien ne peut être lu.
AudioOut_Refused.es: rpm no ha podido abrir {0}, así que no se puede reproducir nada.
AudioOut_Refused.de: rpm konnte {0} nicht öffnen. Deshalb kann nichts wiedergegeben werden.
AudioOut_Refused.zh-Hans: rpm 无法打开 {0}，因此无法播放。
AudioOut_Refused.comment: Sound output message: a playback device exists and would not open. {0} is the device's name, as the speaker picker lists it.

AudioOut_RefusedUnnamed.en: rpm could not open the sound output, so nothing can play.
AudioOut_RefusedUnnamed.fr: rpm n'a pas pu ouvrir la sortie audio, donc rien ne peut être lu.
AudioOut_RefusedUnnamed.es: rpm no ha podido abrir la salida de audio, así que no se puede reproducir nada.
AudioOut_RefusedUnnamed.de: rpm konnte die Tonausgabe nicht öffnen. Deshalb kann nichts wiedergegeben werden.
AudioOut_RefusedUnnamed.zh-Hans: rpm 无法打开声音输出，因此无法播放。
AudioOut_RefusedUnnamed.comment: Sound output message: as AudioOut_Refused, when the device has no name.

AudioOut_StepReinstall.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step when the sound library is missing.

AudioOut_StepSecurity.en: If your security software removed or blocked a file from rpm, allow rpm there, then reinstall it.
AudioOut_StepSecurity.fr: Si votre logiciel de sécurité a supprimé ou bloqué un fichier de rpm, autorisez rpm dans ce logiciel, puis réinstallez-le.
AudioOut_StepSecurity.es: Si tu software de seguridad ha eliminado o bloqueado un archivo de rpm, permite rpm en él y vuelve a instalarlo.
AudioOut_StepSecurity.de: Wenn deine Sicherheitssoftware eine Datei von rpm entfernt oder blockiert hat, erlaube rpm dort und installiere es dann neu.
AudioOut_StepSecurity.zh-Hans: 如果安全软件删除或阻止了 rpm 的文件，请在该软件中允许 rpm，然后重新安装。
AudioOut_StepSecurity.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step when the sound library is missing.

AudioOut_StepConnect.en: Connect speakers or headphones, or turn on your Bluetooth speaker.
AudioOut_StepConnect.fr: Branchez des haut-parleurs ou un casque, ou allumez votre enceinte Bluetooth.
AudioOut_StepConnect.es: Conecta altavoces o auriculares, o enciende tu altavoz Bluetooth.
AudioOut_StepConnect.de: Schließe Lautsprecher oder Kopfhörer an oder schalte deinen Bluetooth-Lautsprecher ein.
AudioOut_StepConnect.zh-Hans: 连接扬声器或耳机，或打开蓝牙音箱。
AudioOut_StepConnect.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step when no playback device was found.

AudioOut_StepWindowsSound.en: Open Sound settings and check that an output device is selected and turned on.
AudioOut_StepWindowsSound.fr: Ouvrez les paramètres Son et vérifiez qu'un périphérique de sortie est sélectionné et activé.
AudioOut_StepWindowsSound.es: Abre la configuración de Sonido y comprueba que hay un dispositivo de salida seleccionado y activado.
AudioOut_StepWindowsSound.de: Öffne die Soundeinstellungen und prüfe, ob ein Ausgabegerät ausgewählt und aktiviert ist.
AudioOut_StepWindowsSound.zh-Hans: 打开声音设置，确认已选择并启用输出设备。
AudioOut_StepWindowsSound.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step on Windows. Sound settings is the Windows Settings page the button opens.

AudioOut_StepMacSound.en: Open System Settings, then Sound, and choose a device under Output.
AudioOut_StepMacSound.fr: Ouvrez Réglages Système, puis Son, et choisissez un appareil sous Sortie.
AudioOut_StepMacSound.es: Abre Ajustes del Sistema, luego Sonido, y elige un dispositivo en Salida.
AudioOut_StepMacSound.de: Öffne die Systemeinstellungen, dann Ton, und wähle unter Ausgabe ein Gerät.
AudioOut_StepMacSound.zh-Hans: 打开系统设置中的声音，在输出下选择一个设备。
AudioOut_StepMacSound.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step on macOS. Names macOS's own System Settings, Sound, Output, as macOS words them in each language.

AudioOut_StepOtherSound.en: Open your system's sound settings and check that an output device is selected.
AudioOut_StepOtherSound.fr: Ouvrez les paramètres audio du système et vérifiez qu'un périphérique de sortie est sélectionné.
AudioOut_StepOtherSound.es: Abre la configuración de sonido del sistema y comprueba que hay un dispositivo de salida seleccionado.
AudioOut_StepOtherSound.de: Öffne die Toneinstellungen des Systems und prüfe, ob ein Ausgabegerät ausgewählt ist.
AudioOut_StepOtherSound.zh-Hans: 打开系统的声音设置，确认已选择输出设备。
AudioOut_StepOtherSound.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step on a system other than Windows or macOS.

AudioOut_StepPlayAgain.fr: Appuyez ensuite de nouveau sur lecture.
AudioOut_StepPlayAgain.comment: Sound output message, the last numbered step when no playback device was found.

AudioOut_StepCloseOthers.en: Close other apps that are playing sound, then press play again.
AudioOut_StepCloseOthers.fr: Fermez les autres applications qui lisent du son, puis appuyez de nouveau sur lecture.
AudioOut_StepCloseOthers.es: Cierra otras aplicaciones que estén reproduciendo sonido y pulsa reproducir de nuevo.
AudioOut_StepCloseOthers.de: Schließe andere Apps, die Ton wiedergeben, und drücke dann erneut auf Wiedergabe.
AudioOut_StepCloseOthers.zh-Hans: 关闭其他正在播放声音的应用，然后再次点击播放。
AudioOut_StepCloseOthers.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step when a playback device would not open (another app may hold it).

AudioOut_StepReconnect.en: Disconnect the device and connect it again, or restart the computer.
AudioOut_StepReconnect.fr: Débranchez l'appareil et rebranchez-le, ou redémarrez l'ordinateur.
AudioOut_StepReconnect.es: Desconecta el dispositivo y vuelve a conectarlo, o reinicia el ordenador.
AudioOut_StepReconnect.de: Trenne das Gerät und schließe es wieder an, oder starte den Computer neu.
AudioOut_StepReconnect.zh-Hans: 断开设备后重新连接，或重启电脑。
AudioOut_StepReconnect.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step when a playback device would not open.

AudioOut_StepPickOther.zh-Hans: 在设置的{0}中选择其他扬声器。
AudioOut_StepPickOther.comment: Sound output message, a numbered step when a playback device would not open. {0} is Settings_Sound, the section of rpm's settings with the speaker picker; Settings is Settings_Title.

AudioOut_OpenSoundSettings.comment: Sound output message: the button that opens the system's own sound settings (Windows Settings, Sound; macOS System Settings, Sound).

Player_Like.comment: Tooltip on the thumbs-up key on the transport bar: marks the playing song a favourite. Pressing it again takes it back.

Player_Dislike.comment: Tooltip on the thumbs-down key on the transport bar: the playing song is never offered by a generated playlist again. Pressing it again takes it back.

Review_ColComposer.comment: Library table column: who wrote the music.

Review_ColWork.comment: Library table column: the composition a track is a movement of.

Review_ColSubgenre.comment: Subgenre column header in the import workbench, and the name of the subgenre in the required-tags list.

Cloud_StateNoPreview.comment: Cloud column in the track table: the track is in the cloud, its short preview clip is not.

Cloud_FailChannels.comment: Cloud failure reason: a surround file that cannot be mixed down to stereo.

Cloud_FailUnreadable.es: No se pudo leer el audio
Cloud_FailUnreadable.comment: Cloud failure reason: the file is damaged or truncated.

Cloud_FailTranscode.es: No se pudo convertir el audio
Cloud_FailTranscode.comment: Cloud failure reason: the converter refused the file for some other reason.

Cloud_FailNoId.en: This file type cannot be synced
Cloud_FailNoId.fr: Ce type de fichier ne peut pas être synchronisé
Cloud_FailNoId.es: Este tipo de archivo no se puede sincronizar
Cloud_FailNoId.de: Dieser Dateityp kann nicht synchronisiert werden
Cloud_FailNoId.comment: Cloud failure reason: the container cannot store an rpm id.

Cloud_FailUnknown.comment: Cloud failure reason: anything not recognised, usually a network problem.

Library_Title.comment: Heading of the central library panel, over all three of its views.

AlbumGroup_Tooltip.comment: Tooltip on the album list's grouping button.

AlbumGroup_None.comment: Album list grouping: one run of records, no headings. The default.

AlbumGroup_Artist.comment: Album list grouping: a shelf per artist.

AlbumGroup_Genre.comment: Album list grouping: a shelf per genre.

AlbumGroup_Year.comment: Album list grouping: a shelf per release year, newest first.

AlbumGroup_Ungrouped.comment: Album list group heading for records whose tracks carry no genre.

AlbumGroup_NoYear.comment: Group heading for records with no year tagged, in the album list and under All tracks on an artist's page when grouped by year.

Queue_PaneTitle.comment: Heading of the import queue pane; the folder being imported runs underneath.

Queue_ImportAction.comment: Label on the import button under the queue.

Queue_SelectedForImport.comment: Queue subtitle: how many queued tracks are ticked. {0} is the count.

Queue_SelectedForImportOne.comment: Queue subtitle when exactly one track is ticked.

QueueLegend_AlbumFile.comment: Queue legend: a single file holding a whole album.

QueueLegend_Title.comment: Tooltip on the button that opens the import grid's glyph key.

QueueLegend_FileGroup.comment: Heading in the glyph key: marks describing the file itself. Uppercase in English by design.

QueueLegend_CopyGroup.comment: Heading in the legend: marks saying something else already holds the track. Uppercase by design.

Queue_UnknownArtist.comment: Import tree: the group holding tracks with no artist tag.

Queue_UnknownAlbum.comment: Import tree: the group holding tracks with no album tag.

Queue_MissingFields.comment: Tooltip on a queued track's question mark. {0} is a comma-separated list of field names.

QueueLegend_Missing.comment: Queue legend: a track that is missing part of the minimum tag set.

QueueLegend_Complete.comment: Queue legend: a track carrying everything the library needs.

QueueLegend_Duplicate.en: Same or better version already in collection
QueueLegend_Duplicate.fr: Version identique ou meilleure déjà dans la collection
QueueLegend_Duplicate.es: Versión igual o mejor ya en la colección
QueueLegend_Duplicate.de: Gleiche oder bessere Version bereits in der Sammlung
QueueLegend_Duplicate.zh-Hans: 音乐收藏中已有相同或更好的版本
QueueLegend_Duplicate.comment: Legend line: the library holds this track in a copy at least as good.

QueueLegend_Upgrade.en: Better quality than current version in collection
QueueLegend_Upgrade.fr: Meilleure qualité que la version actuelle de la collection
QueueLegend_Upgrade.es: Mejor calidad que la versión actual de la colección
QueueLegend_Upgrade.de: Bessere Qualität als die aktuelle Version in der Sammlung
QueueLegend_Upgrade.zh-Hans: 质量优于音乐收藏中的当前版本
QueueLegend_Upgrade.comment: Legend line: the library holds this track, and the queued file is the better encode.

QueueLegend_QueueDuplicate.en: Same or better version elsewhere in this batch
QueueLegend_QueueDuplicate.fr: Version identique ou meilleure ailleurs dans ce lot
QueueLegend_QueueDuplicate.es: Versión igual o mejor en otra parte de este lote
QueueLegend_QueueDuplicate.de: Gleiche oder bessere Version an anderer Stelle in diesem Stapel
QueueLegend_QueueDuplicate.zh-Hans: 本批次其他位置有相同或更好的版本
QueueLegend_QueueDuplicate.comment: Legend line: another queued file holds the same track in an equal or better copy.

QueueLegend_Dataless.comment: Queue legend: the file is a cloud placeholder, not downloaded.

QueueLegend_Original.zh-Hans: 保留的原始文件（不导入）
QueueLegend_Original.comment: Import queue legend: the whole-album file a split kept, which can never be ticked.

QueueTip_Original.en: The original album file a split kept, in the Originals folder. It is not imported, so it cannot be selected. It stays here in case the split needs to be redone.
QueueTip_Original.fr: Le fichier d'album original conservé par une séparation, dans le dossier Originals. Il n'est pas importé et ne peut donc pas être sélectionné. Il reste ici au cas où la séparation devrait être refaite.
QueueTip_Original.es: El archivo de álbum original que conservó una división, en la carpeta Originals. No se importa, por lo que no se puede seleccionar. Se conserva aquí por si hay que rehacer la división.
QueueTip_Original.de: Die Original-Albumdatei, die beim Teilen aufbewahrt wurde, im Ordner Originals. Sie wird nicht importiert und kann daher nicht ausgewählt werden. Sie bleibt hier, falls das Teilen wiederholt werden muss.
QueueTip_Original.zh-Hans: 拆分时保留的完整专辑文件，位于 Originals 文件夹中。它不会被导入，因此无法选择。保留它是为了在需要时重新拆分。
QueueTip_Original.comment: Tooltip on the archive mark in the import queue's first column.

QueueLegend_Unreadable.comment: Queue legend: nothing could find audio in the file.

QueueTip_Dataless.en: Not on this disk. It is a cloud placeholder, so nothing was read from it and it cannot be imported. Right-click to download it.
QueueTip_Dataless.fr: Absent de ce disque. C'est un fichier cloud non téléchargé : rien n'en a été lu et il ne peut pas être importé. Clic droit pour le télécharger.
QueueTip_Dataless.es: No está en este disco. Es un archivo de la nube sin descargar: no se leyó nada y no se puede importar. Clic derecho para descargarlo.
QueueTip_Dataless.de: Nicht auf dieser Festplatte. Eine Cloud-Platzhalterdatei: nichts wurde gelesen, Import nicht möglich. Zum Herunterladen rechtsklicken.
QueueTip_Dataless.zh-Hans: 不在此磁盘上。这是云端占位文件，未读取任何内容，无法导入。右键点击可下载。
QueueTip_Dataless.comment: Tooltip on the cloud mark in the import queue.

QueueTip_Unreadable.en: Neither the tag reader nor ffmpeg found audio in this file. It cannot be played, so it is not imported.
QueueTip_Unreadable.fr: Ni le lecteur de tags ni ffmpeg n'ont trouvé d'audio dans ce fichier. Il ne peut pas être lu, il n'est donc pas importé.
QueueTip_Unreadable.es: Ni el lector de etiquetas ni ffmpeg encontraron audio en este archivo. No se puede reproducir, así que no se importa.
QueueTip_Unreadable.de: Weder der Tag-Leser noch ffmpeg haben Audio in dieser Datei gefunden. Sie ist nicht abspielbar und wird nicht importiert.
QueueTip_Unreadable.zh-Hans: 标签读取器和 ffmpeg 都未在此文件中找到音频。无法播放，因此不会导入。
QueueTip_Unreadable.comment: Tooltip on the unreadable mark in the import queue.

Queue_CtxDownload.comment: Queue context menu: fetch the selected cloud placeholders so they can be imported.

Queue_CtxDownloadMany.zh-Hans: 从云端下载 {0} 个文件
Queue_CtxDownloadMany.comment: Queue context menu when more than one placeholder is being fetched, e.g. a whole album or artist. {0} is the file count.

Queue_AlbumIntentTip.en: This album has its own settings. They are applied to its folder when it is imported.
Queue_AlbumIntentTip.fr: Cet album a ses propres réglages. Ils sont appliqués à son dossier lors de l'importation.
Queue_AlbumIntentTip.es: Este álbum tiene sus propios ajustes. Se aplican a su carpeta al importarlo.
Queue_AlbumIntentTip.de: Dieses Album hat eigene Einstellungen. Sie werden beim Import auf seinen Ordner angewendet.
Queue_AlbumIntentTip.zh-Hans: 此专辑有自己的设置，导入时会应用到它的文件夹。
Queue_AlbumIntentTip.comment: Tooltip on an album row in the import queue that carries album-level answers (classical, levelling, disc label) waiting for import.

Queue_CtxNameTracks.fr: Métadonnées des pistes depuis une sortie…
Queue_CtxNameTracks.es: Metadatos de pistas desde un lanzamiento…
Queue_CtxNameTracks.zh-Hans: 从发行版获取曲目元数据…
Queue_CtxNameTracks.comment: Menu entry in the import queue and the library table: fill every per-track field the app can get (titles, artists, credits, ids, ISRC) from a release the user picks.

Queue_NamedTracks.en: Updated {0} of {1} tracks from the release
Queue_NamedTracks.fr: {0} pistes sur {1} mises à jour depuis la sortie
Queue_NamedTracks.es: Se actualizaron {0} de {1} pistas desde el lanzamiento
Queue_NamedTracks.de: {0} von {1} Titeln aus der Veröffentlichung aktualisiert
Queue_NamedTracks.zh-Hans: 已从该发行版更新 {1} 个曲目中的 {0} 个
Queue_NamedTracks.comment: Status after 'Track metadata from release': how many rows the listing matched and filled in, of how many were asked about. {0} matched, {1} total.

Queue_NamedNone.en: No track on that release lines up with these files, so nothing was changed.
Queue_NamedNone.fr: Aucune piste de cette sortie ne correspond à ces fichiers, rien n'a été modifié.
Queue_NamedNone.es: Ninguna pista de esa edición coincide con estos archivos, así que no se cambió nada.
Queue_NamedNone.de: Kein Titel dieser Veröffentlichung passt zu diesen Dateien, es wurde nichts geändert.
Queue_NamedNone.zh-Hans: 该发行版本中没有与这些文件对应的曲目，因此未做更改。
Queue_NamedNone.comment: Status line when a release's tracklist could not be lined up with the selected rows: wrong pressing, or a running order that disagrees.

Library_ActionFailed.fr: Cette action ne s'est pas terminée. {0}
Library_ActionFailed.comment: Status bar, when a library menu action fails. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Queue_CtxNumberDiscs.fr: Numéroter les disques d'après les dossiers
Queue_CtxNumberDiscs.es: Numerar los discos según las carpetas
Queue_CtxNumberDiscs.zh-Hans: 根据文件夹为碟片编号
Queue_CtxNumberDiscs.comment: Queue context menu on a record or an artist: read DISCNUMBER off folders like "CD 2" and write it onto the rows.

Queue_DiscsNumbered.fr: {0} fichiers ont reçu un numéro de disque
Queue_DiscsNumbered.es: Se dio número de disco a {0} archivos
Queue_DiscsNumbered.zh-Hans: 已为 {0} 个文件设置碟片编号
Queue_DiscsNumbered.comment: Status line after numbering discs from folders. {0} is the file count.

Queue_DiscsNoneFound.en: No folder here says which disc it is, so nothing was changed.
Queue_DiscsNoneFound.fr: Aucun dossier ici n'indique de quel disque il s'agit, rien n'a été modifié.
Queue_DiscsNoneFound.es: Ninguna carpeta aquí dice de qué disco se trata, así que no se cambió nada.
Queue_DiscsNoneFound.de: Kein Ordner hier sagt, welche Disc er ist, es wurde nichts geändert.
Queue_DiscsNoneFound.zh-Hans: 此处没有文件夹说明属于哪张碟片，因此未做更改。
Queue_DiscsNoneFound.comment: Status line when numbering discs found no evidence. Deliberate: repeated track numbers alone are not proof of a set.

Queue_DiscCount.comment: Suffix on an album row in the import queue when the record is a set. {0} is the disc count.

Queue_CtxEditTrack.comment: Queue context menu on a single row with nothing else ticked: the per-file editor.

Queue_CtxEditAlbum.comment: Queue context menu on an album row: mass-edit every track on that record.

Queue_CtxEditArtist.comment: Queue context menu on an artist row: mass-edit every track filed under that artist.

Queue_SelectAll.comment: Import chin: tick every queued row.

Queue_DeselectAll.comment: Import chin: untick every queued row.

Queue_SelectLabel.comment: Import footer: the word in front of the All / None presses.

Queue_SelectAllWord.comment: Import footer: the All half of "Select All / None". A press, not a sentence.

Queue_SelectNoneWord.comment: Import footer: the None half of "Select All / None". A press, not a sentence.

Queue_RemoveDuplicates.comment: Clean-up menu: keep the best copy of each track, drop the rest.

Queue_RemoveUnreadable.comment: Clean-up menu: drop the rows nothing could read.

Queue_RemovedDuplicates.comment: Status line after the de-duplicate clean-up.

Queue_RemovedDuplicateOne.comment: Status line after the de-duplicate clean-up removed exactly one row.

Queue_RemovedUnreadable.zh-Hans: 已移除 {0} 个无法读取的文件
Queue_RemovedUnreadable.comment: Status line after the unreadable clean-up.

Queue_RemovedUnreadableOne.zh-Hans: 已移除 1 个无法读取的文件
Queue_RemovedUnreadableOne.comment: Status line after the unreadable clean-up removed exactly one row.

Queue_Downloading.comment: Status line while cloud placeholders are being fetched. {0} done, {1} total, {2} file name.

Queue_DownloadDone.comment: Status line after the cloud download finishes.

QueueDup_InLibrary.en: The collection already holds this track, in a copy at least as good.
QueueDup_InLibrary.fr: La collection contient déjà cette piste, dans une copie au moins aussi bonne.
QueueDup_InLibrary.es: La colección ya tiene esta pista, en una copia al menos igual de buena.
QueueDup_InLibrary.de: Die Sammlung enthält diesen Titel bereits, in mindestens gleicher Qualität.
QueueDup_InLibrary.zh-Hans: 音乐收藏中已有这首曲目，且质量不低于此文件。

QueueDup_Upgrade.en: The collection holds this track in a worse copy. Importing replaces it.
QueueDup_Upgrade.fr: La collection contient une copie de moindre qualité. L'import la remplace.
QueueDup_Upgrade.es: La colección tiene una copia peor. Importar la sustituye.
QueueDup_Upgrade.de: Die Sammlung hat eine schlechtere Kopie. Der Import ersetzt sie.
QueueDup_Upgrade.zh-Hans: 音乐收藏中的版本质量更低，导入将替换它。

QueueDup_InQueue.en: Another file in this queue holds the same track, in an equal or better copy.
QueueDup_InQueue.fr: Un autre fichier de cette file contient la même piste, en qualité égale ou meilleure.
QueueDup_InQueue.es: Otro archivo de esta cola tiene la misma pista, en copia igual o mejor.
QueueDup_InQueue.de: Eine andere Datei in dieser Warteschlange enthält denselben Titel, gleich gut oder besser.
QueueDup_InQueue.zh-Hans: 此队列中另有文件包含同一曲目，质量相同或更好。
QueueDup_InQueue.comment: Tooltip on the in-queue duplicate mark.

Stats_Empty.comment: Pane subtitle when the collection or the playlist tree is empty.

Stats_Albums.comment: Pane subtitle: how many records. {0} is the count.

Stats_Songs.comment: Pane subtitle: how many songs. {0} is the count.

Stats_Playlists.comment: Pane subtitle: how many playlists. {0} is the count.

Stats_Stations.comment: Pane subtitle: how many radio stations the dial is carrying. {0} is the count.

Stats_StationsOne.comment: Pane subtitle: exactly one radio station.

Stats_Minutes.comment: A running time under an hour: the pane subtitle, the album length in Pegasus and on the iPhone album page. {0} is minutes.

Stats_HoursMinutes.comment: A running time under a day: the pane subtitle, the album length in Pegasus and on the iPhone album page. {0} hours, {1} minutes.

Stats_DaysHours.comment: Pane subtitle: a running time of days. {0} days, {1} hours.

Stats_DaysHoursOne.comment: Pane subtitle: a running time of exactly one day. {0} is the spare hours.

TrackInfo_PaneTitle.comment: Heading of the track info pane.

TrackInfo_AboutArtist.comment: Track info pane and artist page: heading over the artist biography. Also the heading of the phone's sheet with the full Wikipedia text about an artist.

TrackInfo_ChooseArtist.comment: Tooltip on the round button beside Read on Wikipedia under the artist card in the track info pane. Opens a list of the artists that share this name, so the listener can pick the right one when the catalogue matched the wrong act.

TrackInfo_NoOtherArtists.en: No other artists were found with this name
TrackInfo_NoOtherArtists.fr: Aucun autre artiste portant ce nom n'a été trouvé
TrackInfo_NoOtherArtists.es: No se han encontrado otros artistas con este nombre
TrackInfo_NoOtherArtists.de: Es wurden keine anderen Interpreten mit diesem Namen gefunden
TrackInfo_NoOtherArtists.zh-Hans: 未找到同名的其他艺人
TrackInfo_NoOtherArtists.comment: Message along the foot of the main window after Choose artist finds nobody else. Appears when the catalogue has only one act under this name, so there is nothing to choose between.

TrackInfo_ArtistsUnanswered.en: The list of artists could not be loaded
TrackInfo_ArtistsUnanswered.fr: La liste des artistes n'a pas pu être chargée
TrackInfo_ArtistsUnanswered.es: No se pudo cargar la lista de artistas
TrackInfo_ArtistsUnanswered.de: Die Liste der Interpreten konnte nicht geladen werden
TrackInfo_ArtistsUnanswered.comment: Message along the foot of the main window when Choose artist could not get the artists with this name (no connection, a server error). Not the same as TrackInfo_NoOtherArtists, which is an answer.

TrackInfo_ArtistUnanswered.en: The chosen artist could not be loaded
TrackInfo_ArtistUnanswered.fr: L'artiste choisi n'a pas pu être chargé
TrackInfo_ArtistUnanswered.es: No se pudo cargar el artista elegido
TrackInfo_ArtistUnanswered.de: Der gewählte Interpret konnte nicht geladen werden
TrackInfo_ArtistUnanswered.comment: Message along the foot of the main window when the artist picked under Choose artist could not be looked up (no connection, a server error). The card keeps the artist it had.

TrackInfo_LyricsUseOwn.comment: Tooltip on the button beside the lyrics heading in the track info pane. Opens a file picker so the listener can supply a timed lyric file for a song the catalogues have no lyrics for.

TrackInfo_LyricsNotTimed.en: That file has no timings, so it cannot follow the song
TrackInfo_LyricsNotTimed.fr: Ce fichier ne contient aucun minutage, il ne peut donc pas suivre la chanson
TrackInfo_LyricsNotTimed.es: Ese archivo no tiene marcas de tiempo, así que no puede seguir la canción
TrackInfo_LyricsNotTimed.de: Diese Datei enthält keine Zeitmarken und kann dem Song daher nicht folgen
TrackInfo_LyricsNotTimed.zh-Hans: 该文件没有时间轴，无法跟随歌曲
TrackInfo_LyricsNotTimed.comment: Message along the foot of the main window when the .lrc file the listener chose holds plain words with no timestamps.

TrackInfo_Members.comment: Track info pane and artist page: heading over the list of people in the band, with their dates of birth.

TrackInfo_AboutAlbum.comment: Heading over the album notes, in the track info pane, on the drawer's album screen, and on the phone's sheet with the full Wikipedia text about an album.

TrackInfo_Elsewhere.comment: Track info pane and artist page: heading over links to other sites.

TrackInfo_OfCount.comment: Track info pane: a track's position on its record. {0} of {1}.

TrackInfo_OfficialSite.comment: Track info pane and artist page: link to an artist or label site.

TrackInfo_ReadOnWikipedia.comment: Track info pane and artist page: link under a biography taken from Wikipedia. Also under the full text in the phone's album and artist sheets.

Mac_MicrophoneUsage.en: rpm uses your audio input to record vinyl and other sources you connect.
Mac_MicrophoneUsage.fr: rpm utilise votre entrée audio pour enregistrer des vinyles et les autres sources que vous branchez.
Mac_MicrophoneUsage.es: rpm usa tu entrada de audio para grabar vinilos y otras fuentes que conectes.
Mac_MicrophoneUsage.de: rpm nutzt Ihren Audioeingang, um Schallplatten und andere angeschlossene Quellen aufzunehmen.
Mac_MicrophoneUsage.zh-Hans: rpm 使用你的音频输入来录制黑胶唱片和你连接的其他音源。
Mac_MicrophoneUsage.comment: macOS, under the system's question about the microphone. Written into the Mac bundle by scripts/infoplist_strings.py (Info.plist and InfoPlist.strings), not read by the app.

Mac_LocalNetworkUsage.en: rpm looks for other computers on your network so you can share libraries, and for Google Cast speakers to play on.
Mac_LocalNetworkUsage.fr: rpm recherche les autres ordinateurs de votre réseau pour partager des bibliothèques, ainsi que les enceintes Google Cast pour la lecture.
Mac_LocalNetworkUsage.es: rpm busca otros ordenadores en tu red para que puedas compartir bibliotecas, y altavoces Google Cast en los que reproducir.
Mac_LocalNetworkUsage.de: rpm sucht in Ihrem Netzwerk nach anderen Computern, damit Sie Bibliotheken teilen können, und nach Google-Cast-Lautsprechern für die Wiedergabe.
Mac_LocalNetworkUsage.zh-Hans: rpm 会在你的网络中查找其他电脑以便共享音乐库，并查找可用于播放的 Google Cast 音箱。

Settings_Normalize.comment: Sound settings section heading for ReplayGain-style loudness normalisation.

Settings_NormalizeHint.en: Plays every record at the same loudness, so you do not have to change the volume between one album and the next. Each track is measured once, in the background.
Settings_NormalizeHint.fr: Joue chaque disque au même niveau sonore, pour ne pas avoir à régler le volume d'un album à l'autre. Chaque piste est mesurée une fois, en arrière-plan.
Settings_NormalizeHint.es: Reproduce cada disco al mismo volumen, así no tienes que ajustarlo de un álbum a otro. Cada pista se mide una vez, en segundo plano.
Settings_NormalizeHint.de: Spielt jede Platte gleich laut, damit du zwischen einem Album und dem nächsten nicht die Lautstärke ändern musst. Jeder Titel wird einmal gemessen, im Hintergrund.
Settings_NormalizeHint.zh-Hans: 让每张唱片以相同响度播放，专辑之间无需再调音量。每首曲目在后台测量一次。
Settings_NormalizeHint.comment: Explains what volume levelling does, under the Sound settings heading.

Settings_NormalizeOff.comment: Volume levelling mode: every record plays at the level it was mastered at.

Settings_NormalizeAlbum.comment: Volume levelling mode: the record is levelled as a whole, keeping the distance between its loud and quiet tracks.

Settings_NormalizeTrack.comment: Volume levelling mode: every track levelled on its own.

Settings_NormalizeClassical.comment: Checkbox: whether volume levelling applies to classical records, which are excluded by default.

Settings_NormalizeClassicalHint.en: Off by default. A quiet movement is meant to be quiet, and levelling flattens the dynamics the performance depends on.
Settings_NormalizeClassicalHint.fr: Désactivé par défaut. Un mouvement calme doit rester calme, et l'égalisation du volume aplatit les nuances dont dépend l'interprétation.
Settings_NormalizeClassicalHint.es: Desactivado por defecto. Un movimiento suave debe sonar suave, y nivelar el volumen aplana la dinámica de la que depende la interpretación.
Settings_NormalizeClassicalHint.de: Standardmäßig aus. Ein leiser Satz soll leise sein, und eine Lautheitsangleichung nimmt der Aufführung die Dynamik, auf der sie beruht.
Settings_NormalizeClassicalHint.zh-Hans: 默认关闭。安静的乐章本就该安静，音量拉平会压掉演奏所依赖的动态。
Settings_NormalizeClassicalHint.comment: Explains why classical records are excluded from volume levelling by default.

Settings_NormalizeMeasuring.en: Measuring the collection: {0} tracks to go.
Settings_NormalizeMeasuring.fr: Analyse de la collection : {0} pistes restantes.
Settings_NormalizeMeasuring.zh-Hans: 正在测量收藏：还剩 {0} 首曲目。
Settings_NormalizeMeasuring.comment: Progress line while the background loudness pass works through the library. {0} is a track count.

AlbumEdit_Normalize.comment: Album editor field label: whether this record is volume levelled with the rest of the collection.

AlbumEdit_NormalizeAuto.comment: Album editor choice: leave volume levelling for this record to the global setting. The default.

AlbumEdit_NormalizeOn.comment: Album editor choice: level this record whatever the global setting says.

AlbumEdit_NormalizeOff.comment: Album editor choice: leave this record at its own level whatever the global setting says.

AlbumEdit_Classical.comment: Album editor field label: whether this is a classical record, which decides whether its tracklist is drawn as works with movements under them.

AlbumEdit_ClassicalYes.comment: Album editor choice: this is a classical record.

AlbumEdit_ClassicalNo.comment: Album editor choice: this is not a classical record. The default.

AlbumEdit_GroupSettings.comment: Album editor group kicker for the answers kept in the library rather than written into the files. ALLCAPS, like every other group kicker.

AlbumEdit_TabSettings.comment: Album editor tab label for what the library thinks about the record, as against what its files say.

Deck_ViewTip.comment: Tooltip for the deck's view button, next to the hamburger. Opens a menu of the app's three views.

View_Library.comment: View menu: the ordinary view, meaning the collection, the side pane and the deck. Greyed while it is the view on screen.

View_RPaMp.comment: View menu: the RPaMp skin on its own. A product name, untranslated.

View_Heading.comment: Heading band at the top of the deck's view picker.

View_Pegasus.comment: View picker: the full-screen player. A proper noun, left untranslated.

NewYear_Greeting.comment: Large, centred on the Pegasus room at midnight on 1 January, while ABBA's "Happy New Year" plays. Seen for one minute a year — warm and spoken, not formal.

NewYear_From.comment: The line under the greeting above. Lower case on purpose, as the app's own name is. Keep the ♡.

CloudFull_Title.es: El almacenamiento en la nube está lleno
CloudFull_Title.comment: Title of the window shown when the free cloud storage has run out.

CloudFull_Body.de: rpm lädt keine weitere Musik mehr hoch. Werde Unterstützer, um unbegrenzten Cloud-Speicher freizuschalten.

Supporter_OfferTitle.comment: Supporter window: heading of the offer card.

Supporter_Price.comment: Storage-full window: what supporting rpm costs.

Supporter_PerkStorage.comment: Supporter window: one of the benefits listed on the offer card.

Supporter_PerkRecognition.comment: Supporter window: one of the benefits listed on the offer card.

Supporter_PerkDj.comment: Supporter window: one of the benefits listed on the offer card.

Supporter_PerkKaraoke.zh-Hans: Pegasus 卡拉 OK 模式
Supporter_PerkKaraoke.comment: Supporter window: one of the benefits listed on the offer card.

Supporter_PerkBackdrop.comment: Supporter window: one of the benefits listed on the offer card.

Supporter_PerkBadge.en: Supporter badge next to your name
Supporter_PerkBadge.fr: Badge de soutien à côté de votre nom

Supporter_PerkBadge.comment: Supporter window: one of the benefits listed on the offer card.

Supporter_PerkMore.es: Y más cosas en el futuro…
Supporter_PerkMore.comment: Supporter window: closes the benefit list.

Supporter_Later.comment: Storage-full window: closes it without doing anything.

Supporters_Dj.en: DJ mode is available to supporters of rpm only. Please consider supporting rpm.

Supporters_Backdrop.en: This backdrop is available to supporters of rpm only. Please consider supporting rpm.

Supporters_Karaoke.en: Karaoke mode is available to supporters of rpm only. Please consider supporting rpm.

Supporters_Karaoke.comment: Supporters-only window: shown when word by word lyric timing is switched on by an account that is not a supporter.

Cloud_BecomeSupporter.comment: Button that opens the page where supporting rpm is bought.

Cloud_UsageUnlimited.comment: Cloud settings usage line for a supporter, who has no ceiling to show.

Cloud_UsageAlmostFull.comment: Cloud settings usage line when less than 2 GB is left.

Cloud_UsageFull.comment: Cloud settings usage line when there is no room left at all.

Cloud_AlmostFullHint.fr: Il reste moins de {0}. Une fois plein, rpm cessera d'envoyer.
Cloud_AlmostFullHint.es: Queda menos de {0}. Cuando esté lleno, rpm dejará de subir.

Cloud_AlmostFullHint.zh-Hans: 剩余不足 {0}。存储已满时，rpm 将停止上传。

Cloud_SyncAllPaused.en: Switched to selected music because cloud storage was full.

Cloud_SupporterHeading.comment: Cloud settings: title of the card showing whether the account supports rpm.

Cloud_SupporterFree.en: Free account with 100 GB of cloud storage.
Cloud_SupporterFree.fr: Compte gratuit avec 100 Go de stockage cloud.

Cloud_SupporterFree.zh-Hans: 免费账户，含 100 GB 云存储。
Cloud_SupporterFree.comment: Cloud settings: the standing of an account that is not a supporter.

Cloud_SupporterYes.en: You are a supporter. Your cloud storage is unlimited.
Cloud_SupporterYes.fr: Vous êtes un soutien. Votre stockage cloud est illimité.
Cloud_SupporterYes.es: Eres colaborador. Tu almacenamiento en la nube es ilimitado.
Cloud_SupporterYes.de: Du bist Unterstützer. Dein Cloud-Speicher ist unbegrenzt.
Cloud_SupporterYes.zh-Hans: 你是支持者。你的云存储无限。
Cloud_SupporterYes.comment: Cloud settings: the standing of a supporter.

Cloud_SupporterYesUntil.en: You are a supporter until {0}. Your cloud storage is unlimited.
Cloud_SupporterYesUntil.fr: Vous êtes un soutien jusqu'au {0}. Votre stockage cloud est illimité.
Cloud_SupporterYesUntil.es: Eres colaborador hasta el {0}. Tu almacenamiento en la nube es ilimitado.
Cloud_SupporterYesUntil.de: Du bist Unterstützer bis zum {0}. Dein Cloud-Speicher ist unbegrenzt.
Cloud_SupporterYesUntil.zh-Hans: 你的支持者身份有效期至 {0}。你的云存储无限。

Cloud_SupporterUnknown.en: Your supporter status could not be retrieved.
