Cloud_SupporterUnknown.de: Dein Unterstützer-Status konnte nicht abgerufen werden.
Cloud_SupporterUnknown.zh-Hans: 无法获取你的支持者状态。
Cloud_SupporterUnknown.comment: Cloud settings: the server did not answer, which is not the same as 'not a supporter'.

CloudFull_PausedAll.en: Syncing has switched from all music to selected music only. New albums can be uploaded manually after other albums are removed.
CloudFull_PausedAll.fr: La synchronisation est passée de toute la musique à la musique sélectionnée uniquement. De nouveaux albums pourront être envoyés manuellement une fois d'autres albums retirés.
CloudFull_PausedAll.es: La sincronización ha pasado de toda la música a solo la música seleccionada. Podrás subir álbumes nuevos manualmente cuando quites otros.
CloudFull_PausedAll.de: Die Synchronisierung ist von aller Musik auf nur ausgewählte Musik umgestellt. Neue Alben lassen sich manuell hochladen, sobald andere Alben entfernt sind.
CloudFull_PausedAll.zh-Hans: 同步已从“所有音乐”切换为“仅选定的音乐”。移除其他专辑后，可以手动上传新专辑。
CloudFull_PausedAll.comment: Storage-full window: the second line when the app dropped 'all music' to the selection.

CloudFull_PausedSelected.en: New albums can be uploaded manually after other albums are removed.
CloudFull_PausedSelected.fr: De nouveaux albums pourront être envoyés manuellement une fois d'autres albums retirés.
CloudFull_PausedSelected.es: Podrás subir álbumes nuevos manualmente cuando quites otros.
CloudFull_PausedSelected.de: Neue Alben lassen sich manuell hochladen, sobald andere Alben entfernt sind.
CloudFull_PausedSelected.zh-Hans: 移除其他专辑后，可以手动上传新专辑。
CloudFull_PausedSelected.comment: Storage-full window: the second line when syncing was already on selected albums.

Supporter_PerkCommunity.es: Mantener en marcha la comunidad de rpm
Supporter_PerkCommunity.zh-Hans: 让 rpm 社区持续运转
Supporter_PerkCommunity.comment: Supporter window: one of the benefits listed on the offer card.

CloudFull_NeverAgain.es: No volver a mostrar este mensaje
CloudFull_NeverAgain.comment: Storage-full window: offered from the second showing on, so the weekly reminder can be switched off.

Supporter_PerkBitrate.es: Mayor tasa de bits en la reproducción
Supporter_PerkBitrate.comment: Supporter window: one of the benefits listed on the offer card.

Lookup_SourceRpm.es: la base de datos de rpm
Lookup_SourceRpm.comment: Names the app's own catalogue inside a sentence. The lookup window's progress list uses the provider's own short name ("RPM") instead.

Common_And.comment: Joins the last two items of a spoken list, e.g. "the rpm database and Discogs".

Track_MostPopular.comment: Album page: tooltip on the star beside the most played song on the record.

Track_Favorite.comment: Tooltip on the heart at the end of a track line, in the album views and on the album page.

Track_SetFavorite.comment: Track context-menu item: mark this song as a favorite.

Track_UnsetFavorite.comment: Track context-menu item: clear the favorite mark on this song.

Track_StartRadio.comment: Track context-menu item (song menus, library table, playlist rows): plays this song now and keeps the queue filled with songs of a similar mood, era and genre to whichever song is playing. Not internet radio.

Details_ReleaseType.comment: Tag field (import panel, album editor, track editor): what kind of release the record is. Decides which section of the artist page it appears in.

ReleaseType_Ep.comment: Release type option: an extended play, shorter than an album.

ReleaseType_Live.comment: Release type option: recorded in front of an audience.

ReleaseType_Compilation.comment: Release type option: a best-of or collection of earlier recordings.

ReleaseType_Soundtrack.comment: Release type option: music for a film, series, game or stage show.

Artists_Eps.comment: Heading over the artist's EPs, on their page (desktop and full-screen player).

Artists_Mixtapes.comment: Heading over the artist's mixtapes, on their page (desktop and full-screen player).

Library_FavoritesOnly.comment: Tooltip on the heart toggle in the library header that filters the album wall and list.

Playlists_FavoriteTracks.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing every song marked as a favorite.

Playlists_MostPlayed.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing the songs played most often.

Playlists_SmartFolder.comment: Name of the pinned folder in the playlists pane holding the playlists the app generates.

Playlists_DecadesFolder.comment: Pinned folder in the playlist tree holding one folder per decade, each with that decade's mood playlists.

Playlists_MoodsFolder.comment: Pinned folder in the playlist tree holding the playlists cut from how the music sounds: Chill, Adrenaline, Dancefloor, Lights out and Classical.

Playlists_RecentlyAdded.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing the songs added to the collection most recently.

Playlists_RecentlyPlayed.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing the songs played most recently.

Playlists_NeverPlayed.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing songs in the collection that have never been played.

Playlists_LovedAndForgotten.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing favorite songs not played in six months.

Playlists_PlayedNotLoved.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing songs played often that were never marked favorite.

Playlists_OnRepeat.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing songs played several times in the last month.

Playlists_Rediscover.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing songs played a lot in the past but not for months.

Playlists_LateNight.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing songs mostly played between 11pm and 5am.

Playlists_FirstListens.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing songs heard for the first time in the last month.

Playlists_KeepSkipping.comment: Name of the generated playlist listing songs that get skipped far more than they get played.

Transport_Next.comment: Player transport: tooltip on the next-track button.

Transport_Previous.comment: Player transport: tooltip on the previous-track button.

Transport_PlayPause.comment: Player transport: tooltip on the play and pause button.

Dj_UnavailableTitle.comment: Title of the window shown when a DJ set is asked for and no track can be analysed: this computer cannot run the model and the cloud cannot be reached.

Dj_UnavailableBody.en: The DJ model is not available right now, so these tracks cannot be mixed. This computer cannot run the model and the cloud could not be reached. The tracks are still in the queue and play normally.
Dj_UnavailableBody.fr: Le modèle DJ n'est pas disponible pour le moment, ces pistes ne peuvent donc pas être mixées. Cet ordinateur ne peut pas exécuter le modèle et le cloud est injoignable. Les pistes restent dans la file d'attente et se lisent normalement.
Dj_UnavailableBody.es: El modelo de DJ no está disponible en este momento, así que estas pistas no se pueden mezclar. Este ordenador no puede ejecutar el modelo y no se pudo conectar con la nube. Las pistas siguen en la cola y se reproducen con normalidad.
Dj_UnavailableBody.de: Das DJ-Modell ist derzeit nicht verfügbar, daher können diese Titel nicht gemischt werden. Dieser Computer kann das Modell nicht ausführen und die Cloud war nicht erreichbar. Die Titel bleiben in der Warteschlange und werden normal abgespielt.
Dj_UnavailableBody.zh-Hans: DJ 模型当前不可用，因此无法混音这些曲目。这台电脑无法运行该模型，也无法连接到云端。曲目仍在队列中，可正常播放。
Dj_UnavailableBody.comment: Body of the window shown when a DJ set is asked for and no track can be analysed: no model on this machine and no cloud.

Common_Ok.comment: The close button on a message window that only has something to say.

Share_ChipTooltip.comment: Tooltip on the deck's sharing chip.

Share_MyLibrary.comment: First row of the share button's library list on the deck: this computer's own collection.

Share_SignInNeeded.en: Sharing needs an rpm account. Sign in to share your collection and to open the ones shared with you.
Share_SignInNeeded.fr: Le partage nécessite un compte rpm. Connectez-vous pour partager votre collection et ouvrir celles qui vous sont partagées.
Share_SignInNeeded.es: Compartir requiere una cuenta rpm. Inicia sesión para compartir tu colección y abrir las que compartan contigo.
Share_SignInNeeded.de: Zum Teilen ist ein rpm-Konto nötig. Melde dich an, um deine Sammlung zu teilen und die geteilten zu öffnen.
Share_SignInNeeded.zh-Hans: 共享需要 rpm 账户。登录后即可共享您的音乐收藏，并打开别人共享给您的音乐收藏。
Share_SignInNeeded.comment: Strip above the sharing settings when nobody is signed in.

Share_Title.comment: Header of the sharing chip flyout, and of the sharing section in settings.

Share_AskedQuestion.en: {0} wants to share collections with you.
Share_AskedQuestion.fr: {0} souhaite partager ses collections avec vous.
Share_AskedQuestion.comment: Sharing chip: another computer asked to share. {0} is the computer's name.

Share_Ask.comment: Sharing chip button: ask the other computer to share.

Share_Waiting.comment: Sharing chip: the other computer has been asked and has not answered yet. {0} is its name.

Share_Accepted.comment: Sharing chip: the pairing succeeded. {0} is the other computer's name.

Share_Declined.comment: Sharing chip: the other computer declined. {0} is its name.

Share_Full.comment: Sharing chip: the other computer has reached the limit. {0} is its name.

Share_LimitReached.en: You already share with 5 computers. Remove one to add another.
Share_LimitReached.fr: Vous partagez déjà avec 5 ordinateurs. Retirez-en un pour en ajouter un autre.
Share_LimitReached.es: Ya compartes con 5 equipos. Quita uno para añadir otro.
Share_LimitReached.de: Sie teilen bereits mit 5 Computern. Entfernen Sie einen, um einen weiteren hinzuzufügen.
Share_LimitReached.zh-Hans: 你已与 5 台电脑共享。请先移除一台再添加。
Share_LimitReached.comment: Sharing chip and settings: the local limit of five shared computers is reached.

Settings_ShareLibrary.en: Share my collection on this network
Settings_ShareLibrary.fr: Partager ma collection sur ce réseau
Settings_ShareLibrary.es: Compartir mi colección en esta red
Settings_ShareLibrary.de: Meine Sammlung in diesem Netzwerk teilen
Settings_ShareLibrary.zh-Hans: 在此网络中共享我的音乐收藏
Settings_ShareLibrary.comment: Settings toggle: turn local network sharing on or off.

Settings_ShareLibraryHint.en: Computers running rpm on this network can ask to share. You choose who gets access.
Settings_ShareLibraryHint.fr: Les ordinateurs qui utilisent rpm sur ce réseau peuvent demander à partager. Vous choisissez qui a accès.
Settings_ShareLibraryHint.es: Los equipos con rpm en esta red pueden solicitar compartir. Tú eliges quién tiene acceso.
Settings_ShareLibraryHint.de: Computer mit rpm in diesem Netzwerk können eine Freigabe anfragen. Sie entscheiden, wer Zugriff erhält.
Settings_ShareLibraryHint.zh-Hans: 此网络中运行 rpm 的电脑可以请求共享。由你决定谁可以访问。
Settings_ShareLibraryHint.comment: Settings: hint under the sharing toggle.

Settings_ShareName.comment: Settings: label of the text box holding the name other computers see.

Settings_ShareNameHint.en: Leave this empty to use your display name. When you are not signed in, this computer's name is used.
Settings_ShareNameHint.fr: Laissez ce champ vide pour utiliser votre nom d'affichage. Si vous n'êtes pas connecté, le nom de cet ordinateur est utilisé.
Settings_ShareNameHint.es: Deja este campo vacío para usar tu nombre visible. Si no has iniciado sesión, se usa el nombre de este ordenador.
Settings_ShareNameHint.de: Lassen Sie dieses Feld leer, um Ihren Anzeigenamen zu verwenden. Wenn Sie nicht angemeldet sind, wird der Name dieses Computers verwendet.

Settings_ShareNobody.es: Todavía no hay nada compartido. Abre rpm en otro equipo de esta red y aparecerá aquí.

Settings_ShareRemove.comment: Settings: button that removes one computer from the shared list.

Settings_ShareCount.comment: Settings: how many of the five sharing places are used.

Settings_ShareOffline.comment: Settings: state of a shared computer that cannot be reached right now.

Settings_ShareOnline.comment: Settings: state of a shared computer that can be reached right now.

Settings_ShareMine.comment: Settings: label for a shared computer signed in to the same account.

Album_Format.comment: Album page, pressing card: label before what the release is (Vinyl, LP, Limited Edition, Red).

Album_NotLinked.zh-Hans: 此专辑未关联任何发行版本。

Album_FindRelease.comment: Button in the pressing well on the album page, shown on hover, when nothing is linked yet.

Share_ShowCodeHint.zh-Hans: 请在 {0} 上输入此代码。

Playlists_BlurbSleep.comment: Description under the sleep playlist name. It names no genres because the list is not cut by genre.

Playlists_GenreAnd.comment: Joins the last two genres in a playlist description: 'rock, pop and jazz'. {0} is what came before, {1} is the last one.

Artists_InPlaylists.comment: Artist page: heading over the shelf of the user's own playlists that hold a song by this artist.

Artists_Wall.comment: Heading over the artist wall on an artist's page, where listeners leave comments.

Artists_InLibrary.comment: Heading over the card on an artist's page counting what the collection holds of them.

Artists_WallPlaceholder.fr: Écrivez quelque chose à propos de cet artiste
Artists_WallPlaceholder.de: Schreiben Sie etwas über diesen Interpreten
Artists_WallPlaceholder.zh-Hans: 写下关于这位艺人的想法
Artists_WallPlaceholder.comment: Placeholder in the box where a listener types a comment on the artist wall.

Artists_WallEmpty.en: Nothing on this wall yet. Write the first line about this artist.
Artists_WallEmpty.fr: Rien sur ce mur pour l'instant. Écrivez la première ligne à propos de cet artiste.
Artists_WallEmpty.es: Todavía no hay nada en este muro. Escribe la primera línea sobre este artista.
Artists_WallEmpty.de: Auf dieser Pinnwand steht noch nichts. Schreiben Sie die erste Zeile über diesen Interpreten.
Artists_WallEmpty.zh-Hans: 这面墙上还没有内容。写下关于这位艺人的第一条留言。
Artists_WallEmpty.comment: Empty state on the artist page's wall, shown when nobody has written anything yet.

Artists_WallWroteReview.comment: Line on the artist wall for a review of one of their albums. {0} is the album title.

Artists_WallRated.comment: Line on the artist wall for a rating with no review text. {0} is the album title.

Artists_WallSignIn.en: Sign in to write on this wall.
Artists_WallSignIn.fr: Connectez-vous pour écrire sur ce mur.
Artists_WallSignIn.es: Inicia sesión para escribir en este muro.
Artists_WallSignIn.de: Melden Sie sich an, um auf diese Pinnwand zu schreiben.
Artists_WallSignIn.zh-Hans: 登录后即可在这面墙上留言。
Artists_WallSignIn.comment: Line under the artist wall's box when nobody is signed in.

Artists_WallOffline.en: The wall is not available right now.
Artists_WallOffline.fr: Le mur n'est pas disponible pour le moment.
Artists_WallOffline.es: El muro no está disponible en este momento.
Artists_WallOffline.de: Die Pinnwand ist derzeit nicht verfügbar.
Artists_WallOffline.comment: Shown on the artist page when the wall cannot be read or written.

Artists_WallDelete.comment: Menu item on your own line of the artist wall.

Artists_WallReport.comment: Menu item on somebody else's line of the artist wall.

Artists_Related.comment: Heading on an artist's page (Android TV, iPhone, Apple TV): other artists in the collection who made records with them or play the same genres.

Artists_Popular.comment: Heading over the artist's best-known records on their page, ranked by Discogs collectors.

Artists_PopularTracks.comment: iPhone: heading over the first section of an artist's page, their songs the world plays most (ListenBrainz play counts).

Artists_PopularSource.comment: Line under the Most popular heading saying where the ranking comes from.

Artists_PopularConnect.en: Connect a Discogs account in Settings to see this.
Artists_PopularConnect.fr: Connectez un compte Discogs dans les paramètres pour voir ceci.
Artists_PopularConnect.es: Conecta una cuenta de Discogs en Ajustes para ver esto.
Artists_PopularConnect.de: Verbinden Sie in den Einstellungen ein Discogs-Konto, um dies zu sehen.
Artists_PopularConnect.zh-Hans: 在设置中连接 Discogs 账户以查看。
Artists_PopularConnect.comment: Shown in the Most popular card on an artist's page when no Discogs account is connected.

Artists_PopularHave.comment: Under a record in the Most popular card: how many Discogs users own a copy.

Artists_SearchTracks.comment: Placeholder in the search field beside All tracks on an artist's page.

Artists_TracksByLetter.comment: Tooltip on the key that groups All tracks on an artist's page by the first letter of the title. Shown when there are more than 20 songs.

Artists_TracksByYear.comment: Tooltip on the key that groups All tracks on an artist's page by year, newest first. Shown when there are more than 20 songs.

Artists_NoTrackMatch.fr: Aucun titre ne correspond à votre recherche.
Artists_NoTrackMatch.es: Ninguna canción coincide con tu búsqueda.
Artists_NoTrackMatch.zh-Hans: 没有曲目匹配您的搜索。
Artists_NoTrackMatch.comment: Shown under All tracks on an artist's page when a search matches no song.

Artists_SearchClear.comment: Tooltip on the buttons that empty the Artists search field and the track search on an artist's page.

Artists_NoMatch.fr: Aucun artiste ne correspond à votre recherche.
Artists_NoMatch.es: Ningún artista coincide con tu búsqueda.
Artists_NoMatch.zh-Hans: 没有艺人匹配您的搜索。
Artists_NoMatch.comment: Shown over the Artists wall when a search matches nobody, and as the line under the heading.

Lookup_SetTrackMetadata.comment: Checkbox in the release lookup footer: after picking a release, go on to a page that fills the album's tracks in from it.

Lookup_Next.comment: Primary button in the release lookup when the track-metadata step is ticked: go to the track page.

Lookup_Back.comment: Button on the release lookup's track page: back to the search results.

Lookup_ApplyTracks.comment: Primary button on the release lookup's track page: write the release's values to the ticked tracks.

Lookup_TracksHeading.comment: Title of the release lookup window while its track page is showing.

Lookup_StepRelease.comment: First step in the release lookup's step ribbon: pick a release.

Lookup_StepTracks.comment: Second step in the release lookup's step ribbon: fill the album's tracks in from it.

Lookup_TracksFrom.comment: Line above the track grid naming the release the values come from. {0} is the release name and artist, {1} the number of tracks on it.

Lookup_TracksMatched.zh-Hans: {1} 个曲目中有 {0} 个已匹配
Lookup_TracksMatched.comment: Status line on the track page: how many of the album's tracks the release has an entry for.

Lookup_AlbumFields.en: Also set album, artist, year and label
Lookup_AlbumFields.fr: Définir aussi l'album, l'artiste, l'année et le label
Lookup_AlbumFields.es: También establecer álbum, artista, año y sello
Lookup_AlbumFields.de: Auch Album, Interpret, Jahr und Label setzen
Lookup_AlbumFields.zh-Hans: 同时设置专辑、艺术家、年份和厂牌
Lookup_AlbumFields.comment: Checkbox on the track page: write the release's album-level values to every track as well.

Lookup_ColCurrent.comment: Column header on the track page showing what each file's title says now.

Lookup_TrackNumber.comment: Row label on the track page: which track of the album this line is. {0} is the number.

Lookup_TrackUntitled.comment: Shown in the Current column on the track page when the file has no title yet.

Lookup_NoTrackOnRelease.en: This release has no track here, so this one is left unchanged.
Lookup_NoTrackOnRelease.fr: Cette sortie n'a pas de piste ici, celle-ci reste inchangée.
Lookup_NoTrackOnRelease.es: Este lanzamiento no tiene una pista aquí, así que esta queda sin cambios.
Lookup_NoTrackOnRelease.de: Diese Veröffentlichung hat hier keinen Titel, dieser bleibt unverändert.
Lookup_NoTrackOnRelease.zh-Hans: 该发行版本在此处没有曲目，因此这首保持不变。
Lookup_NoTrackOnRelease.comment: Tooltip on the warning icon in front of a track the release has no entry for, because the album has more tracks than the release.

Lookup_TickAllTooltip.comment: Tooltip on the header checkbox of the track page, which ticks or unticks every matched track.

Lookup_NoListing.en: That release has no track listing, so there is nothing to fill in.
Lookup_NoListing.fr: Cette sortie n'a pas de liste de pistes, il n'y a rien à remplir.
Lookup_NoListing.es: Ese lanzamiento no tiene lista de pistas, así que no hay nada que rellenar.
Lookup_NoListing.de: Diese Veröffentlichung hat keine Titelliste, es gibt nichts auszufüllen.
Lookup_NoListing.zh-Hans: 该发行版本没有曲目列表，因此没有可填充的内容。
Lookup_NoListing.comment: Status line when the picked release has no tracklist, so the track page cannot open.

Lookup_ListingUnanswered.en: The track listing could not be loaded. Try again, or pick another pressing.
Lookup_ListingUnanswered.fr: La liste des pistes n'a pas pu être chargée. Réessayez ou choisissez une autre édition.
Lookup_ListingUnanswered.es: No se pudo cargar la lista de pistas. Inténtalo de nuevo o elige otra edición.
Lookup_ListingUnanswered.de: Die Titelliste konnte nicht geladen werden. Versuche es erneut oder wähle eine andere Pressung.
Lookup_ListingUnanswered.zh-Hans: 无法加载曲目列表。请重试，或选择其他版本。
Lookup_ListingUnanswered.comment: Release lookup: status line when the picked release's track listing did not arrive (no connection, a server error). Not the same as Lookup_NoListing, which says the release has no listing.

Lookup_ListingTimedOut.en: The catalogue did not answer in time. Try again, or pick another pressing.
Lookup_ListingTimedOut.fr: Le catalogue n'a pas répondu à temps. Réessayez ou choisissez une autre édition.
Lookup_ListingTimedOut.es: El catálogo no respondió a tiempo. Inténtalo de nuevo o elige otra edición.
Lookup_ListingTimedOut.de: Der Katalog hat nicht rechtzeitig geantwortet. Versuchen Sie es erneut oder wählen Sie eine andere Pressung.
Lookup_ListingTimedOut.zh-Hans: 目录未及时响应。请重试或选择其他版本。
Lookup_ListingTimedOut.comment: Status line when fetching a release's track listing timed out, so the track page could not open.

Recognize_ReachAdvanced.comment: Recognize dialog footer: what this account's run will use, for a supporter.

Recognize_ReachAdvancedUntil.zh-Hans: 高级识别（支持者有效期至 {0}）
Recognize_ReachAdvancedUntil.comment: Recognize dialog footer, when the supporter status has an end date.

Recognize_ReachBasic.comment: Recognize dialog footer: what a non-supporter gets.

Recognize_SupportPitch.en: Please consider supporting rpm and unlock advanced AudD track recognition.
Recognize_SupportPitch.fr: Envisagez de soutenir rpm pour débloquer la reconnaissance avancée AudD.
Recognize_SupportPitch.es: Considera apoyar a rpm para desbloquear el reconocimiento avanzado de AudD.
Recognize_SupportPitch.de: Unterstützen Sie rpm und schalten Sie die erweiterte AudD-Erkennung frei.
Recognize_SupportPitch.zh-Hans: 支持 rpm 即可解锁 AudD 高级音轨识别。
Recognize_SupportPitch.comment: Recognize dialog: shown only when the account is known not to be a supporter.

Recognize_AdvancedNote.en: AudD: {0} sent, {1} identified. Identified tracks are saved and are not sent again.
Recognize_AdvancedNote.fr: AudD : {0} envoyés, {1} identifiés. Les morceaux identifiés sont enregistrés et ne sont pas renvoyés.
Recognize_AdvancedNote.es: AudD: {0} enviadas, {1} identificadas. Las pistas identificadas se guardan y no se vuelven a enviar.
Recognize_AdvancedNote.de: AudD: {0} gesendet, {1} erkannt. Erkannte Titel werden gespeichert und nicht erneut gesendet.
Recognize_AdvancedNote.zh-Hans: AudD：已发送 {0} 首，已识别 {1} 首。已识别的曲目会被保存，不会再次发送。
Recognize_AdvancedNote.comment: Recognize dialog report note, shown only when at least one track was sent to AudD. {0} is how many tracks were sent to AudD, {1} how many of them AudD identified. Tracks AudD did not identify are not saved and are sent again next time.

Recognize_AdvancedRefused.en: Advanced recognition is for supporters. The rest of the run used basic recognition only.
Recognize_AdvancedRefused.fr: La reconnaissance avancée est réservée aux soutiens. Le reste de l’analyse a utilisé la reconnaissance de base.
Recognize_AdvancedRefused.es: El reconocimiento avanzado es para patrocinadores. El resto del proceso usó solo el reconocimiento básico.
Recognize_AdvancedRefused.de: Die erweiterte Erkennung ist Unterstützern vorbehalten. Der Rest des Durchlaufs nutzte nur die einfache Erkennung.
Recognize_AdvancedRefused.zh-Hans: 高级识别仅限支持者使用。本次其余曲目仅使用基础识别。
Recognize_AdvancedRefused.comment: Recognize dialog, and the split window's status line after Recognize selected: the server refused the advanced layer mid-run, so the run carried on without it.

Recognize_ColStatus.comment: Recognize dialog, column header over each target track’s state.

Recognize_ColResult.comment: Recognize dialog, column header over what each track came back as.

Recognize_ColSource.comment: Recognize dialog, column header over which layer answered.

CoverSearch_Heading.comment: Title of the cover art search window.

CoverSearch_SearchKicker.comment: Group header over the artist and album boxes in the cover art search window.

CoverSearch_SourcesKicker.comment: Group header over the source tick boxes in the cover art search window.

CoverSearch_Search.comment: Button that runs the cover art search.

CoverSearch_Use.comment: Primary button in the cover art search window: take the selected picture.

CoverSearch_OpenSource.comment: Button in the cover art search window: open the page the selected picture came from.

CoverSearch_EmptyStart.en: Enter an artist or an album, then select Search.
CoverSearch_EmptyStart.fr: Saisissez un artiste ou un album, puis sélectionnez Rechercher.
CoverSearch_EmptyStart.es: Escribe un artista o un álbum y selecciona Buscar.
CoverSearch_EmptyStart.de: Geben Sie einen Interpreten oder ein Album ein und wählen Sie Suchen.
CoverSearch_EmptyStart.zh-Hans: 输入艺人或专辑，然后选择“搜索”。
CoverSearch_EmptyStart.comment: Empty state in the cover art search window before anything has been searched for.

CoverSearch_Searching.comment: Shown in the cover art search window while the search is running.

CoverSearch_NoResults.en: No covers found. Try fewer words, or just the album name.
CoverSearch_NoResults.fr: Aucune pochette trouvée. Essayez moins de mots, ou seulement le nom de l'album.
CoverSearch_NoResults.es: No se encontraron portadas. Prueba con menos palabras o solo el nombre del álbum.
CoverSearch_NoResults.de: Keine Cover gefunden. Versuchen Sie es mit weniger Wörtern oder nur dem Albumnamen.
CoverSearch_NoResults.zh-Hans: 未找到封面。请尝试减少关键词，或只输入专辑名称。
CoverSearch_NoResults.comment: Empty state in the cover art search window when a search returned nothing.

CoverSearch_Failed.en: The search could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
CoverSearch_Failed.fr: La recherche n'a pas abouti. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
CoverSearch_Failed.es: No se pudo completar la búsqueda. Comprueba tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.
CoverSearch_Failed.de: Die Suche konnte nicht abgeschlossen werden. Prüfen Sie Ihre Verbindung und versuchen Sie es erneut.
CoverSearch_Failed.zh-Hans: 搜索无法完成。请检查网络连接后重试。
CoverSearch_Failed.comment: Shown in the cover art search window when the search call itself failed.

CoverSearch_Found.zh-Hans: 来自 {1} 个来源的 {0} 张封面
CoverSearch_Found.comment: Status line in the cover art search window. {0} is the number of results, {1} the number of sources that answered.

CoverSearch_Fetching.fr: Téléchargement de l'image en taille réelle.
CoverSearch_Fetching.es: Descargando la imagen a tamaño completo.
CoverSearch_Fetching.de: Bild in voller Größe wird heruntergeladen.
CoverSearch_Fetching.zh-Hans: 正在下载完整尺寸的图片。
CoverSearch_Fetching.comment: Status line in the cover art search window while the chosen picture is being downloaded.

CoverSearch_CouldNotFetch.en: That picture could not be downloaded. Select another one.
CoverSearch_CouldNotFetch.fr: Cette image n'a pas pu être téléchargée. Sélectionnez-en une autre.
CoverSearch_CouldNotFetch.es: No se pudo descargar esa imagen. Selecciona otra.
CoverSearch_CouldNotFetch.de: Dieses Bild konnte nicht heruntergeladen werden. Wählen Sie ein anderes.
CoverSearch_CouldNotFetch.zh-Hans: 无法下载该图片。请选择其他图片。
CoverSearch_CouldNotFetch.comment: Status line in the cover art search window when the chosen picture's host refused the download.

CoverSearch_ConnectDiscogs.en: Connect a Discogs account in Settings to also search its release scans.
CoverSearch_ConnectDiscogs.fr: Connectez un compte Discogs dans les Paramètres pour rechercher aussi ses scans de pressages.
CoverSearch_ConnectDiscogs.es: Conecta una cuenta de Discogs en Ajustes para buscar también sus escaneos de ediciones.
CoverSearch_ConnectDiscogs.de: Verbinden Sie in den Einstellungen ein Discogs-Konto, um auch dessen Pressungs-Scans zu durchsuchen.
CoverSearch_ConnectDiscogs.zh-Hans: 在“设置”中连接 Discogs 账户，即可一并搜索其版本扫描图。
CoverSearch_ConnectDiscogs.comment: Hint in the cover art search window shown when Discogs is not available as a source.

Details_FindArt.comment: Button under the cover in the album and track editors: opens the cover art search window.

CoverSearch_NoSources.en: No sources could be reached. Check your connection, or sign in again.
CoverSearch_NoSources.fr: Aucune source n'a pu être jointe. Vérifiez votre connexion ou reconnectez-vous.
CoverSearch_NoSources.es: No se pudo acceder a ninguna fuente. Comprueba tu conexión o vuelve a iniciar sesión.
CoverSearch_NoSources.de: Es konnten keine Quellen erreicht werden. Prüfen Sie Ihre Verbindung oder melden Sie sich erneut an.
CoverSearch_NoSources.zh-Hans: 无法连接到任何来源。请检查网络连接，或重新登录。
CoverSearch_NoSources.comment: Hint in the cover art search window when the server returned no sources at all, which means the API could not be reached.

CoverSearch_HeadingDisc.comment: Title of the cover art search window when it was opened from the disc art picture.

CoverSearch_UseDisc.comment: Primary button in the cover art search window when searching for disc art.

CoverSearch_IncludesDisc.en: Disc art is included with this cover
CoverSearch_IncludesDisc.fr: L'image du disque est incluse avec cette pochette
CoverSearch_IncludesDisc.es: La imagen del disco se incluye con esta portada
CoverSearch_IncludesDisc.de: Das Disc-Bild ist bei diesem Cover enthalten
CoverSearch_IncludesDisc.comment: Tooltip on the small disc mark shown on a cover result that also has disc art.

CoverSearch_NoDiscs.en: No disc art found. Not every release has it.
CoverSearch_NoDiscs.fr: Aucune image de disque trouvée. Toutes les éditions n'en ont pas.
CoverSearch_NoDiscs.es: No se encontraron imágenes del disco. No todas las ediciones la tienen.
CoverSearch_NoDiscs.de: Kein Disc-Bild gefunden. Nicht jede Veröffentlichung hat eines.
CoverSearch_NoDiscs.zh-Hans: 未找到碟面图。并非所有版本都有。
CoverSearch_NoDiscs.comment: Empty state in the cover art search window when a disc art search returned nothing.

CoverSearch_DiscSourcesShort.en: Only these sources label disc art separately from covers.
CoverSearch_DiscSourcesShort.fr: Seules ces sources distinguent l'image du disque de la pochette.
CoverSearch_DiscSourcesShort.es: Solo estas fuentes distinguen la imagen del disco de la portada.
CoverSearch_DiscSourcesShort.de: Nur diese Quellen führen Disc-Bilder getrennt von Covern.
CoverSearch_DiscSourcesShort.zh-Hans: 只有这些来源会将碟面图与封面分开标注。
CoverSearch_DiscSourcesShort.comment: Hint in the cover art search window explaining why the source list is shorter when searching for disc art.

CoverSearch_FetchingBoth.en: Downloading the cover and the disc art.
CoverSearch_FetchingBoth.fr: Téléchargement de la pochette et de l'image du disque.
CoverSearch_FetchingBoth.es: Descargando la portada y la imagen del disco.
CoverSearch_FetchingBoth.zh-Hans: 正在下载封面和碟面图。
CoverSearch_FetchingBoth.comment: Status line in the cover art search window while a cover and its matching disc art are both being downloaded.

Lookup_OverwriteArt.comment: Checkbox in the release lookup window's footer: whether the pressing's cover and disc label replace the ones the record already has. Shown only where the caller is taking pictures at all.

Rpm_Track_AddToPlaylist.comment: Key in the drawer behind a track row on the iPhone: opens the playlist picker.

Rpm_Playlist_AddSongs.comment: Plus button in the header of an open playlist on the iPhone: opens the song picker to add more.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_Add.comment: Button in the iPhone playlist picker that files the song in the playlist chosen.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_AlreadyInBody.en: This track is already in this playlist. Add it again?
Rpm_PlaylistPick_AlreadyInBody.fr: Ce morceau est déjà dans cette liste. L'ajouter à nouveau ?
Rpm_PlaylistPick_AlreadyInBody.es: Esta pista ya está en esta lista. ¿Añadirla otra vez?
Rpm_PlaylistPick_AlreadyInBody.de: Dieser Titel ist bereits in dieser Wiedergabeliste. Erneut hinzufügen?
Rpm_PlaylistPick_AlreadyInBody.zh-Hans: 此曲目已在此播放列表中。要再次添加吗？
Rpm_PlaylistPick_AlreadyInBody.comment: Body of the confirmation shown when one song is added to a playlist that already holds it (iPhone playlist picker and desktop). Its title names the playlist.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_AddAgain.comment: Key on that confirmation (iPhone and desktop) that puts a second copy of the song, or songs, in the playlist.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_AlreadyIn.comment: Title of the confirmation when a song chosen is already in the playlist picked (iPhone playlist picker, and every add to playlist on the desktop), and the line shown when a write found it there. {0} is the playlist name.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_Empty.en: No playlists yet. Make one on the Playlists tab, or pick one for the cloud in rpm on your computer.
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Empty.fr: Aucune liste de lecture. Créez-en une dans l'onglet Listes, ou choisissez-en une pour le cloud dans rpm sur votre ordinateur.
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Empty.es: Aún no hay listas. Crea una en la pestaña Listas, o elige una para la nube en rpm en tu ordenador.
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Empty.de: Noch keine Playlists. Erstelle eine im Tab Playlists, oder wähle eine in rpm auf deinem Computer für die Cloud aus.
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Empty.zh-Hans: 还没有播放列表。在“播放列表”标签页新建一个，或在电脑的 rpm 中选一个同步到云端。
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Empty.comment: Empty state of the iPhone playlist picker at the top of the tree.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_EmptyFolder.comment: Empty state of the iPhone playlist picker inside a folder.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_Failed.en: The playlist could not be updated.
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Failed.fr: La liste de lecture n'a pas pu être mise à jour.
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Failed.es: No se ha podido actualizar la lista.
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Failed.de: Die Playlist konnte nicht aktualisiert werden.
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Failed.comment: Shown in the iPhone playlist picker when reading or writing the playlist failed.

Rpm_NewPlaylist_Name.comment: Placeholder in the name field of the iPhone new-playlist sheet.

Rpm_NewPlaylist_In.comment: Line under the name field of the iPhone new-playlist sheet, saying which folder the playlist is being made in. {0} = the folder. Hidden when it is not in one.

Rpm_NewPlaylist_Search.comment: Placeholder in the song search field of the iPhone new-playlist sheet.

Rpm_NewPlaylist_Added.comment: Button on the iPhone new-playlist sheet that switches the list to the songs picked so far. {0} = count.

Rpm_NewPlaylist_Start.en: Search for songs to add to this playlist.
Rpm_NewPlaylist_Start.fr: Recherchez des titres à ajouter à cette playlist.
Rpm_NewPlaylist_Start.es: Busca canciones para añadir a esta lista.
Rpm_NewPlaylist_Start.de: Suche nach Titeln für diese Playlist.
Rpm_NewPlaylist_Start.zh-Hans: 搜索要添加到此播放列表的歌曲。
Rpm_NewPlaylist_Start.comment: Empty state in the iPhone new-playlist sheet before anything has been searched for.

Rpm_NewPlaylist_NoResults.fr: Aucun titre ne correspond à votre recherche.
Rpm_NewPlaylist_NoResults.es: Ninguna canción coincide con tu búsqueda.
Rpm_NewPlaylist_NoResults.zh-Hans: 没有歌曲符合你的搜索。
Rpm_NewPlaylist_NoResults.comment: Empty state in the iPhone new-playlist sheet when a song search finds nothing.

Rpm_NewPlaylist_NoneAdded.comment: Empty state in the iPhone new-playlist sheet when the added-songs list is opened and nothing has been picked.

Rpm_Share_Title.comment: Phone: title of the picker that switches between your library and shared ones.

Rpm_Share_Pick.comment: Phone: accessibility name of the share button in the library header.

Rpm_Share_Unknown.comment: Phone: name of a shared library whose owner has no profile name.

Rpm_Share_CloudOnly.comment: Phone: what a shared library holds on a phone, shown under its name in the picker.

Rpm_Share_SharedBy.comment: Phone: library header, while a shared library is open. {0} is the person's name.

Rpm_Share_Hint.en: Sharing is set up in rpm on a computer, with both computers on the same network. Libraries shared with you appear here.
Rpm_Share_Hint.fr: Le partage se configure dans rpm sur un ordinateur, les deux ordinateurs étant sur le même réseau. Les bibliothèques partagées avec vous apparaissent ici.
Rpm_Share_Hint.es: El uso compartido se configura en rpm en un ordenador, con ambos ordenadores en la misma red. Las bibliotecas compartidas contigo aparecen aquí.
Rpm_Share_Hint.de: Die Freigabe wird in rpm auf einem Computer eingerichtet, wobei beide Computer im selben Netzwerk sind. Mit dir geteilte Bibliotheken erscheinen hier.
Rpm_Share_Hint.zh-Hans: 共享需在电脑上的 rpm 中设置，且两台电脑需连接同一网络。与你共享的音乐库会显示在这里。
Rpm_Share_Hint.comment: Phone: hint under the library picker and in the profile sharing card, saying where sharing is set up.

Rpm_Share_Opened.comment: Phone profile: label on the shared library that the library tab is showing.

Rpm_Share_EmptyShelf.en: This library has no tracks in the cloud yet.
Rpm_Share_EmptyShelf.fr: Cette bibliothèque n'a encore aucun titre dans le cloud.

Rpm_Share_NotServed.en: This shared library can't be opened yet. Update rpm on your computer, or try again later.

Rpm_Share_NotServed.comment: Phone: shown instead of the wall when the store would not hand over a shared library, which in practice means the API has not been updated yet.

Rpm_Album_RatingsOne.comment: Rating count beside the stars on the iPhone album page, when there is one.

Rpm_Album_Ratings.comment: Rating count beside the stars on the iPhone album page. {0} = the number.

Rpm_Album_ReviewSaveFailed.de: Deine Rezension konnte nicht gespeichert werden.

Rpm_Album_ReviewRemoveFailed.fr: Votre avis n'a pas pu être supprimé.

Rpm_Album_ReviewRemoveFailed.de: Deine Rezension konnte nicht entfernt werden.
Rpm_Album_ReviewRemoveFailed.comment: Error under the review sheet on the iPhone when deleting fails.

Rpm_Cast_NoneNearby.en: No speakers found. They need to be on this Wi-Fi, and rpm needs permission to look.
Rpm_Cast_NoneNearby.fr: Aucune enceinte trouvée. Elles doivent être sur ce Wi-Fi, et rpm doit avoir l'autorisation de les chercher.
Rpm_Cast_NoneNearby.es: No se han encontrado altavoces. Tienen que estar en esta red Wi-Fi y rpm necesita permiso para buscarlos.

Rpm_Cast_NoneNearby.zh-Hans: 未找到扬声器。它们需要连接此 Wi-Fi，并且 rpm 需要查找权限。
Rpm_Cast_NoneNearby.comment: Empty state of the iPhone speaker sheet: covers both the network and the permission.

Rpm_Playlists_EmptyHere.en: No playlists here yet. Pick one for the cloud in rpm on your computer.
Rpm_Playlists_EmptyHere.fr: Aucune liste de lecture ici. Choisissez-en une pour le cloud dans rpm sur votre ordinateur.
Rpm_Playlists_EmptyHere.es: Aún no hay listas aquí. Elige una para la nube en rpm en tu ordenador.
Rpm_Playlists_EmptyHere.de: Hier gibt es noch keine Playlists. Wähle eine in rpm auf deinem Computer für die Cloud aus.
Rpm_Playlists_EmptyHere.zh-Hans: 这里还没有播放列表。在电脑的 rpm 中选一个同步到云端。
Rpm_Playlists_EmptyHere.comment: Empty state of the iPhone Playlists tab.

Rpm_Playlists_CreateFailed.en: The playlist could not be created.
Rpm_Playlists_CreateFailed.fr: La liste de lecture n'a pas pu être créée.
Rpm_Playlists_CreateFailed.es: No se ha podido crear la lista.
Rpm_Playlists_CreateFailed.de: Die Playlist konnte nicht erstellt werden.
Rpm_Playlists_CreateFailed.comment: Error on the iPhone when making a playlist fails and there is no reason to give.

Rpm_Playlists_OrderFailed.en: That order could not be saved.
Rpm_Playlists_OrderFailed.fr: Cet ordre n'a pas pu être enregistré.
Rpm_Playlists_OrderFailed.es: No se ha podido guardar ese orden.
Rpm_Playlists_OrderFailed.de: Diese Reihenfolge konnte nicht gespeichert werden.
Rpm_Playlists_OrderFailed.comment: Error on the iPhone after dragging playlist rows into a new order.

Rpm_Playlists_LenHourOne.comment: Playlist total length between one and two hours. {0} = minutes.

Rpm_Playlists_LenMinuteOne.comment: Playlist total length when it is a single minute.

Rpm_Profile_TracksOne.comment: Cloud storage line on the iPhone profile when the account holds one track.

Rpm_Profile_QuotaUnknown.en: Your storage could not be read.
Rpm_Profile_QuotaUnknown.fr: Votre stockage n'a pas pu être lu.
Rpm_Profile_QuotaUnknown.es: No se ha podido leer tu almacenamiento.
Rpm_Profile_QuotaUnknown.de: Dein Speicher konnte nicht gelesen werden.
Rpm_Profile_QuotaUnknown.zh-Hans: 无法读取你的存储用量。
Rpm_Profile_QuotaUnknown.comment: Shown on the iPhone profile when the cloud quota call fails.

Rpm_Profile_ArtCache.comment: Heading of the on-device artwork cache on the iPhone profile.

Rpm_Profile_ArtCacheDetail.en: Album covers kept on this phone so they appear instantly. They are downloaded again when needed.
Rpm_Profile_ArtCacheDetail.fr: Pochettes conservées sur ce téléphone pour un affichage instantané. Elles sont retéléchargées au besoin.

Rpm_Profile_ArtCacheDetail.zh-Hans: 封面保存在这台手机上，因此会立即显示。需要时会重新下载。
Rpm_Profile_ArtCacheDetail.comment: Explains the artwork cache on the iPhone profile, under its size.

Rpm_Queue_ToComeOne.comment: Subtitle of the iPhone queue panel when one track is left after this one.

Rpm_Queue_ToCome.comment: Subtitle of the iPhone queue panel. {0} = tracks left after this one.

Rpm_Radio_DialEmpty.es: No hay nada en el dial
Rpm_Radio_DialEmpty.comment: Shown under the iPhone radio dial when no station is under the needle.

Rpm_SignIn_Failed.en: Sign in failed. Please try again.
Rpm_SignIn_Failed.fr: Échec de la connexion. Veuillez réessayer.
Rpm_SignIn_Failed.es: No se ha podido iniciar sesión. Inténtalo de nuevo.
Rpm_SignIn_Failed.de: Anmeldung fehlgeschlagen. Bitte versuche es erneut.
Rpm_SignIn_Failed.comment: Shown on the iPhone sign-in screen when a social sign-in comes back with nothing.

Rpm_Stage_PinOn.comment: Accessibility label of the pin key on the iPhone stage, when pressing it pins them.

Rpm_Stage_PinOff.comment: Accessibility label of the pin key on the iPhone stage, when pressing it unpins them.

Rpm_Library_SharedBy.comment: Prefix on the iPhone library counts line when the wall is somebody else's. {0} = their name.

Rpm_Queue_Shuffle.comment: Key on the iPhone queue panel that puts the tracks still to come in another order.

Rpm_Queue_Rearrange.comment: Key on the iPhone queue panel and Now playing page that turns row dragging on.

Rpm_Library_SearchCeiling.es: Se muestran los primeros {0} resultados. Escribe más para acotar la búsqueda.
Rpm_Library_SearchCeiling.de: Die ersten {0} Treffer werden angezeigt. Tippe mehr, um die Suche einzugrenzen.
Rpm_Library_SearchCeiling.zh-Hans: 显示前 {0} 个结果。输入更多内容以缩小搜索范围。
Rpm_Library_SearchCeiling.comment: Line under the iPhone library search results when the list is capped. {0} is the number shown.

Rpm_Cast_PlayOn.comment: The speaker key when nothing is casting: accessibility label on the iPhone player, tooltip on the desktop cast button. Android TV: accessibility label of the cast key in the player.

Rpm_Playlist_EmptyPlain.comment: Empty state on the iPhone playlist page when songs cannot be added to it. Rpm_Playlist_Empty is the one with the plus.

Rpm_Share_OwnLibrary.comment: The user's own row in the iPhone library picker.

Rpm_Share_NobodyShares.en: Nobody shares a library with you yet.
Rpm_Share_NobodyShares.fr: Personne ne partage encore de bibliothèque avec vous.

Rpm_Share_NobodyShares.zh-Hans: 还没有人与你共享音乐库。
Rpm_Share_NobodyShares.comment: Subtitle of the iPhone library picker when only the user's own library is in it.

Rpm_Share_SharedWithYouCount.comment: Subtitle of the iPhone library picker. {0} is how many other libraries are in the list.

Rpm_Album_RatingOutOf.comment: Accessibility label of the star rating on the iPhone album page. {0} is the score.

Rpm_Stage_ArtworkDesc.en: No visualiser. Shows the album cover on the app background, with a photo of the artist behind it.
Rpm_Stage_ArtworkDesc.fr: Aucun visualiseur. Affiche la pochette sur le fond de l'app, avec une photo de l'artiste derrière.
Rpm_Stage_ArtworkDesc.es: Sin visualizador. Muestra la portada sobre el fondo de la app, con una foto del artista detrás.
Rpm_Stage_ArtworkDesc.de: Keine Visualisierung. Zeigt das Cover auf dem Hintergrund der App, mit einem Foto des Künstlers dahinter.
Rpm_Stage_ArtworkDesc.zh-Hans: 无可视化效果。在应用背景上显示专辑封面，后面是艺人照片。
Rpm_Stage_ArtworkDesc.comment: Description of the Artwork choice in the iPhone landscape stage picker.

Rpm_Library_Reading.comment: Wait line on the iPhone while the library is being fetched at startup.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_Borrowed.en: These playlists belong to somebody else. You can only add songs to your own.

Rpm_PlaylistPick_Borrowed.zh-Hans: 这些播放列表属于其他人。你只能将歌曲添加到自己的播放列表。
Rpm_PlaylistPick_Borrowed.comment: iPhone playlist picker, opened while a borrowed library is being viewed: every list in reach is somebody else's.

Rpm_NewPlaylist_Results.comment: First half of the switch on the iPhone add-songs panel: the search results, as against the songs already added.

Home_Heading.comment: The home view's own name, in the app's pane heading face (lower case, like 'the groove').

Home_Listened.comment: Heading over the home view's row of albums played most recently.

Home_Continue.comment: Line over the home banner card holding up the record that was playing last.

Home_Suggested.comment: Heading over the home view's row of albums suggested from listening history.

Home_Taste.comment: Heading over the home view's row of albums picked from the artists and genres the listener plays most.

Home_Played.comment: Heading over the home view's row of albums with the most plays.

Home_Added.comment: Heading over the home view's row of albums added last.

Home_Count.comment: Line under the home view's name, saying how many albums the collection holds.

Home_Empty.en: Nothing here yet. Play something and your listening appears here.
Home_Empty.fr: Rien ici pour l'instant. Écoutez quelque chose et vos écoutes apparaîtront ici.
Home_Empty.es: Aquí no hay nada todavía. Reproduce algo y tus escuchas aparecerán aquí.
Home_Empty.de: Hier ist noch nichts. Spiele etwas ab, dann erscheint dein Hörverlauf hier.
Home_Empty.zh-Hans: 这里还没有内容。播放一些音乐，你的收听记录就会出现在这里。
Home_Empty.comment: Home view's empty state, for a collection with nothing played and nothing on it.

Deck_HomeTip.comment: Tooltip for the deck's home pill.

Home_MadeForYou.comment: Heading over the home view's row of playlists the library generates from listening.

Home_QuickPicks.comment: Heading over the home view block of songs, albums, playlists and stations played most.

Home_QuickAlbum.comment: Kind label on an album entry in the home view's quick selection, before the artist: 'Album • Sting'. Desktop and iPhone.

Home_QuickPlaylist.comment: Kind label on a playlist entry in the home view's quick selection, before its caption: 'Playlist • 24 songs'. Desktop and iPhone.

Home_QuickStation.comment: Second line of a radio station entry in the home view's quick selection, under the station's name. Desktop and iPhone.

Home_QuickKindJoin.comment: Second line of an album or playlist entry in the home view's quick selection. {0} = Home_QuickAlbum or Home_QuickPlaylist, {1} = the artist or the playlist's caption.

Home_PlayAllTracks.comment: Button beside the quick selection heading. Queues only the songs in it, not the albums, playlists or stations.

Home_Songs.comment: Line under a generated playlist's name on the home view: how many songs are in it.

Rpm_Net_Offline.comment: Bar across the top of the iPhone app while the phone has no network, and the message for a request the app declined to send for the same reason.

Rpm_Net_Failed.en: No connection. Check your network and try again.
Rpm_Net_Failed.fr: Aucune connexion. Vérifiez votre réseau et réessayez.
Rpm_Net_Failed.es: Sin conexión. Comprueba tu red e inténtalo de nuevo.
Rpm_Net_Failed.de: Keine Verbindung. Prüfe dein Netzwerk und versuche es erneut.
Rpm_Net_Failed.zh-Hans: 无法连接。请检查网络后重试。
Rpm_Net_Failed.comment: Shown when a request on the iPhone was sent and the network failed under it.

Genres_About.comment: Heading over the Wikipedia article card on a genre's page.

Genres_AboutUnavailable.en: The article could not be loaded. Open the genre again to retry.
Genres_AboutUnavailable.fr: L'article n'a pas pu être chargé. Ouvrez à nouveau le genre pour réessayer.
Genres_AboutUnavailable.es: No se pudo cargar el artículo. Abre el género otra vez para reintentarlo.
Genres_AboutUnavailable.de: Der Artikel konnte nicht geladen werden. Öffnen Sie das Genre erneut, um es noch einmal zu versuchen.
Genres_AboutUnavailable.zh-Hans: 无法加载条目。请重新打开该流派以重试。
Genres_AboutUnavailable.comment: Genre page, in the About column, when the Wikipedia article did not arrive. Shown instead of the article card so the column is not blank and silent.

Genres_Subgenres.comment: Heading over the card listing related genres on a genre's page.

Genres_SubgenreAlbums.comment: Count beside one related genre in the Subgenres card on a genre's page.

Genres_SubgenreAlbumOne.comment: Count beside a related genre in the Subgenres card when it holds exactly one album.

Genres_RecentlyAdded.comment: Heading over the newest records of one genre on its page. {0} is the genre, e.g. rock.

Genres_NotableArtists.comment: Heading over the biggest acts of one genre on its page. {0} is the genre, e.g. rock.

Genres_PopularTracks.comment: Heading over the most played songs of one genre on its page.

Genres_PopularPlayAll.comment: Button on a genre's page: on the desktop beside the Popular tracks heading, adding every song on the card to the queue; in Pegasus and the Android TV app the key under the genre's head, playing its popular songs, or its newest records where there are none.

Genres_PopularSource.fr: Les plus écoutés dans le monde
Genres_PopularSource.es: Las más reproducidas en el mundo
Genres_PopularSource.comment: Line under the Popular tracks heading saying where the ranking comes from.

Genres_YourMostPlayed.comment: Heading over the listener's own most played songs of one genre on its page (iPhone). {0} is the genre, e.g. rock.

Genres_Essential.comment: Heading over the generated playlists for one genre on its page.

Genres_MoodPlaylists.comment: Heading over the mood playlists narrowed to one genre on its page.

Genres_Eras.comment: Heading over the genre's records grouped by decade. {0} is the genre, e.g. rock.

Genres_Decade.comment: Label over one decade's records in the Era row on a genre's page. {0} is a year, e.g. 1970.

Genres_InLibrary.comment: Line under a genre's name on its page saying how much of it the collection holds.

Filter_Clear.comment: Button in a column filter: takes the filter off, showing every track again.

Filter_StartsWith.comment: Match in a column filter: the column begins with the typed text.

Filter_Contains.comment: Match in a column filter: the column holds the typed text anywhere.

Filter_EndsWith.comment: Match in a column filter: the column ends with the typed text.

Filter_Apply.comment: Button in a column filter: narrows the table to the rows that match.

Grid_SortAscending.comment: Column header menu in the data table: sorts the table by this column, A to Z.

Grid_SortDescending.comment: Column header menu in the data table: sorts the table by this column, Z to A.

Grid_ClearFilter.comment: Column header menu in the data table: takes this column's filter off.

Grid_HideColumn.comment: Column header menu in the data table: takes this column off the table.

Grid_ShowAllColumns.comment: Column header menu in the data table: puts back every column that was hidden.

Grid_Columns.comment: Column header menu in the data table: submenu listing every column, ticked when shown.

Vinyl_ToneKicker.comment: Record a record, calibrate step: group header over the equaliser.

Vinyl_ToneHint.en: Set the tone while the record plays. This changes what you hear now and what the tracks sound like when they are cut, not the recording itself.
Vinyl_ToneHint.fr: Réglez la tonalité pendant que le disque tourne. Cela modifie ce que vous entendez maintenant et le son des pistes une fois découpées, pas l'enregistrement lui-même.
Vinyl_ToneHint.es: Ajuste el tono mientras suena el disco. Esto cambia lo que oye ahora y cómo suenan las pistas al cortarlas, no la grabación en sí.
Vinyl_ToneHint.de: Stellen Sie den Klang ein, während die Platte läuft. Das ändert, was Sie jetzt hören und wie die Titel nach dem Schneiden klingen, nicht die Aufnahme selbst.
Vinyl_ToneHint.zh-Hans: 在唱片播放时调整音色。这会改变您现在听到的声音以及切分后音轨的声音，但不会改变录音本身。
Vinyl_ToneHint.comment: Record a record, calibrate step: sentence under the TONE header.

Vinyl_ToneOn.comment: Record a record, calibrate step: tick that turns the equaliser on.

Vinyl_ToneReset.comment: Record a record, calibrate step: button that flattens the equaliser.

Split_DeclickOn.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: click removal, step 1 tick that turns click removal on.

Split_DeclickFound.es: {0} chasquidos reparados ({1}% de esta vista previa)
Split_DeclickFound.zh-Hans: 已修复 {0} 处爆音（占此试听的 {1}%）
Split_DeclickFound.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: Listen control: text after the version with changes was prepared, saying what the click repair did. {0} is a count like 947, {1} is a percentage of the stretch like 1.44.

Vinyl_ToneTreble.comment: Record a record, calibrate step: label under the treble fader, the last in the row of equaliser faders. Also the Treble slider label in the split window's Bass and treble tool.

Split_TakeProfile.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: noise reduction, step 2 button that measures the noise from the selection.

Split_ToolsButton.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: label on the toolbar button that opens the Corrections menu (noise reduction, click removal, bass and treble).

Split_ToolsTooltip.en: Noise reduction, click removal, and bass and treble
Split_ToolsTooltip.fr: Réduction du bruit, suppression des craquements, graves et aigus
Split_ToolsTooltip.es: Reducción de ruido, eliminación de chasquidos, graves y agudos
Split_ToolsTooltip.zh-Hans: 降噪、消除爆音、低音和高音
Split_ToolsTooltip.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: tooltip on the Tools button.

Split_ToolNoise.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: menu item and panel title for the noise reduction tool.

Split_ToolClicks.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: menu item and panel title for the click removal tool.

Split_ToolTone.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: menu item and panel title for the bass and treble tool.

Split_ToolOn.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: menu item text for a tool that is switched on. {0} is the tool's name, such as Noise reduction.

Split_ToolClose.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: tooltip on the button that closes the open tool's panel.

Split_ShowAdvanced.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: button that shows the tool's sliders.

Split_HideAdvanced.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: button that hides the tool's sliders again.

Split_ResetDefaults.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: tooltip on the undo arrow at the top right of a group of sliders, which puts them back to their default values.

Split_StepSelectQuiet.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: noise reduction, step 1 title.

Split_SelectGap.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: noise reduction, step 1 button that selects the quietest gap between two tracks on the waveform.

Split_SelectQuietHint.fr: Ou faites glisser sur un passage sans musique, comme le blanc entre deux pistes.
Split_SelectQuietHint.es: O arrastre sobre una parte sin música, como el hueco entre dos pistas.

Split_NoGapHint.zh-Hans: 未找到曲目之间的间隙。请在没有音乐的部分上拖动选择。

Split_StepTakeProfile.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: noise reduction, step 2 title.

Split_ProfileMeasuring.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: noise reduction, step 2 text while the profile is being measured.

Split_ProfileReady.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: noise reduction, step 2 text when a profile was taken in an earlier session.

Split_NoProfileYet.fr: Pas encore de profil de bruit.

Split_StepTurnOn.comment: Split window, vinyl only, clean-up tools: noise reduction, step 3 title.
