Credits_ITunes_Use.es: Portadas, fechas de publicación y etiquetas de contenido explícito.
Credits_ITunes_Use.de: Cover, Erscheinungsdaten und Kennzeichnungen für explizite Inhalte.
Credits_ITunes_Use.zh-Hans: 封面、发行日期与露骨内容标记。
Credits_ITunes_Use.comment: About screen: what the iTunes Search API is asked for.

Credits_GoogleCast_Use.en: Plays your music on Chromecast and Google speakers.
Credits_GoogleCast_Use.fr: Diffuse votre musique sur Chromecast et les enceintes Google.
Credits_GoogleCast_Use.es: Reproduce tu música en Chromecast y altavoces de Google.
Credits_GoogleCast_Use.de: Spielt deine Musik auf Chromecast und Google-Lautsprechern ab.
Credits_GoogleCast_Use.zh-Hans: 在 Chromecast 和 Google 扬声器上播放你的音乐。
Credits_GoogleCast_Use.comment: About screen: what Google Cast is used for.

Credits_Sonovault_Use.fr: Informations sur les albums, les morceaux et les éditions.
Credits_Sonovault_Use.es: Información de álbumes, pistas y ediciones.
Credits_Sonovault_Use.de: Informationen zu Alben, Titeln und Veröffentlichungen.
Credits_Sonovault_Use.comment: About screen: what SonoVault is asked for.

Wizard_StepOf.comment: Kicker above the heading on every setup wizard step.

Wizard_Next.comment: Setup wizard: go to the next step.

Wizard_SkipForNow.comment: Setup wizard step 2: leave without importing anything.

Wizard_FolderTitle.fr: Où votre musique doit-elle être rangée ?

Wizard_FolderBody.en: Pick one empty folder. rpm files everything you import into it, named and organised.
Wizard_FolderBody.fr: Choisissez un dossier vide. rpm y range tout ce que vous importez, nommé et organisé.
Wizard_FolderBody.es: Elige una carpeta vacía. rpm archiva en ella todo lo que importes, con nombre y orden.
Wizard_FolderBody.de: Wähle einen leeren Ordner. rpm legt alles Importierte benannt und geordnet darin ab.
Wizard_FolderBody.zh-Hans: 选择一个空文件夹。rpm 会把导入的所有音乐命名整理后存放在其中。
Wizard_FolderBody.comment: Setup wizard step 1, line under the heading.

Wizard_NoFolderChosen.comment: Setup wizard step 1, the picker row before a folder is picked.

Wizard_ImportBody.en: Choose where your music is now. rpm reads it, checks it, and files it into your collection.
Wizard_ImportBody.fr: Indiquez où se trouve votre musique. rpm la lit, la vérifie et la range dans votre collection.
Wizard_ImportBody.es: Indica dónde está tu música ahora. rpm la lee, la revisa y la archiva en tu colección.
Wizard_ImportBody.de: Gib an, wo deine Musik jetzt liegt. rpm liest sie, prüft sie und legt sie in deiner Sammlung ab.
Wizard_ImportBody.zh-Hans: 选择音乐当前所在位置。rpm 会读取、检查并归档到你的收藏中。
Wizard_ImportBody.comment: Setup wizard step 2, line under the heading, before a source is chosen.

Wizard_ScanSummary.zh-Hans: {0} 个文件，{1} 张专辑，{2} 首散曲
Wizard_ScanSummary.comment: Setup wizard step 2, the scan strip over the review.

Wizard_LayoutHeading.comment: Setup wizard step 2, heading over the naming template choice.

Wizard_ClassicalFound.comment: Setup wizard step 2, chip on the work/movement template when the scan saw classical.

Wizard_OriginalsHeading.comment: Setup wizard step 2, heading over the move/copy choice.

Wizard_OriginalsMove.comment: Setup wizard step 2, move option. One copy of every record, in the collection.

Wizard_OriginalsCopy.en: Copy, leave the originals where they are
Wizard_OriginalsCopy.fr: Copier, en laissant les originaux en place
Wizard_OriginalsCopy.es: Copiar y dejar los originales donde están

Wizard_PlanHeading.comment: Setup wizard step 2, heading over the destination grid. It shows the collection the import will build.

Wizard_PlanClashes.zh-Hans: 已自动解决 {0} 处名称冲突
Wizard_PlanClashes.comment: Setup wizard step 2, under the destination preview.

Wizard_DoneAlbums.comment: Setup wizard step 3, the result card.

Wizard_DoneTracks.comment: Setup wizard step 3, under the album count.

Wizard_SupportTitle.comment: Setup wizard step 3, heading over the supporter pitch.

Wizard_SupportPitch.en: rpm is built by a small team of dedicated people who love music and believe in collecting and owning your own music. Supporters help with the hosting costs and with the development of new features.
Wizard_SupportPitch.fr: rpm est conçu par une petite équipe de passionnés qui aiment la musique et croient qu'il faut collectionner et posséder sa propre musique. Les soutiens aident à payer l'hébergement et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
Wizard_SupportPitch.es: rpm lo crea un pequeño equipo de personas dedicadas que aman la música y creen en coleccionar y poseer tu propia música. Los mecenas ayudan con los costes de alojamiento y con el desarrollo de nuevas funciones.
Wizard_SupportPitch.de: rpm wird von einem kleinen, engagierten Team gebaut, das Musik liebt und daran glaubt, die eigene Musik zu sammeln und zu besitzen. Unterstützer helfen bei den Hosting-Kosten und bei der Entwicklung neuer Funktionen.
Wizard_SupportPitch.zh-Hans: rpm 由一支热爱音乐的小团队打造，我们相信收藏并真正拥有自己的音乐。支持者帮助我们承担托管费用和新功能的开发。
Wizard_SupportPitch.comment: Setup wizard step 3, the supporter pitch.

Wizard_Finish.comment: Setup wizard step 3, the button that finishes without becoming a supporter.

Coach_AddMusic.en: Add music here. Point rpm at a folder, a CD or a turntable and it files everything into your collection.
Coach_AddMusic.fr: Ajoutez de la musique ici. Indiquez à rpm un dossier, un CD ou une platine et il range tout dans votre collection.
Coach_AddMusic.es: Añade música aquí. Indica a rpm una carpeta, un CD o un tocadiscos y lo archiva todo en tu colección.
Coach_AddMusic.de: Hier kommt Musik herein. Zeig rpm einen Ordner, eine CD oder einen Plattenspieler, und alles wird in deiner Sammlung abgelegt.
Coach_AddMusic.zh-Hans: 在这里添加音乐。给 rpm 指定一个文件夹、一张 CD 或一台唱机，它会把所有内容归入你的收藏。
Coach_AddMusic.comment: First-run hint pointing at the Import tab in the left rail.

Coach_ArtHeader.en: Drag this to open the artwork, or double click it to put it away.
Coach_ArtHeader.fr: Faites glisser pour ouvrir la pochette, ou double-cliquez pour la ranger.
Coach_ArtHeader.es: Arrastra esto para abrir la portada, o haz doble clic para guardarla.
Coach_ArtHeader.de: Zieh hier, um das Cover zu öffnen, oder klick doppelt, um es wegzulegen.
Coach_ArtHeader.zh-Hans: 拖动这里可以展开封面，双击可以收起。
Coach_ArtHeader.comment: First-run hint pointing at the grip under the artwork band.

Coach_Views.en: Three ways to look at your collection: a list, a wall of covers, or the albums in a grid.
Coach_Views.fr: Trois façons de voir votre collection : une liste, un mur de pochettes ou les albums en grille.
Coach_Views.es: Tres formas de ver tu colección: una lista, un muro de portadas o los álbumes en cuadrícula.
Coach_Views.de: Drei Ansichten deiner Sammlung: eine Liste, eine Cover-Wand oder die Alben im Raster.
Coach_Views.zh-Hans: 查看收藏的三种方式：列表、封面墙，或专辑网格。
Coach_Views.comment: First-run hint pointing at the view switch in the library header.

HomeLock_Kicker.comment: Kicker on the locked home panel. Shown in caps.

HomeLock_ToGo.comment: Locked home panel heading, counting down to the threshold.

HomeLock_ToGoOne.comment: Locked home panel heading when a single album is missing.

HomeLock_Body.en: Home shows what you've been playing and what to put on next. It needs a few more records before it can say anything useful.
HomeLock_Body.fr: L'accueil montre ce que vous avez écouté et quoi mettre ensuite. Il lui faut quelques disques de plus pour être utile.
HomeLock_Body.es: Inicio muestra lo que has escuchado y qué poner después. Necesita unos discos más para decir algo útil.
HomeLock_Body.de: Start zeigt, was du gehört hast und was als Nächstes läuft. Dafür braucht es noch ein paar Platten mehr.
HomeLock_Body.zh-Hans: 主页展示你最近在听什么，以及接下来放什么。还需要几张唱片才能给出有用的结果。
HomeLock_Body.comment: Locked home panel, line under the heading.

HomeLock_Progress.comment: Locked home panel, under the progress bar.

HomeLock_AddMusic.comment: Locked home panel, the one button. Opens the add-music window on the library page.

ListLock_Songs.comment: Locked generated playlist: the band does not hold enough songs yet.

ListLock_SongsOne.comment: Locked generated playlist, singular form of ListLock_Songs.

ListLock_Measuring.en: Still measuring your music ({0} of {1} tracks).
ListLock_Measuring.fr: Analyse de votre musique en cours ({0} titres sur {1}).
ListLock_Measuring.es: Aún analizando tu música ({0} de {1} pistas).
ListLock_Measuring.de: Deine Musik wird noch analysiert ({0} von {1} Titeln).
ListLock_Measuring.zh-Hans: 正在分析你的音乐（{0} / {1} 首）。
ListLock_Measuring.comment: Locked generated playlist: the measuring pass has not reached enough of the collection.

ListLock_Plays.en: Play {0} more songs to fill this list.
ListLock_Plays.fr: Écoutez {0} titres de plus pour remplir cette liste.
ListLock_Plays.es: Escucha {0} canciones más para llenar esta lista.
ListLock_Plays.de: Höre {0} weitere Titel, um diese Liste zu füllen.
ListLock_Plays.zh-Hans: 再听 {0} 首即可填满这个列表。
ListLock_Plays.comment: Locked generated playlist: it reads the listening log and there is not enough listening yet.

ListLock_PlaysOne.en: Play 1 more song to fill this list.
ListLock_PlaysOne.fr: Écoutez 1 titre de plus pour remplir cette liste.
ListLock_PlaysOne.es: Escucha 1 canción más para llenar esta lista.
ListLock_PlaysOne.de: Höre 1 weiteren Titel, um diese Liste zu füllen.
ListLock_PlaysOne.zh-Hans: 再听 1 首即可填满这个列表。
ListLock_PlaysOne.comment: Locked generated playlist, singular form of ListLock_Plays.

ListLock_Kicker.comment: Kicker on the card in the playlists pane about lists that are not there yet. Shown in caps.

ListLock_Heading.comment: Heading on the card in the playlists pane about lists that are not there yet.

ListLock_Body.en: Playlists unlock as your collection grows and as you listen.
ListLock_Body.fr: Les playlists se débloquent à mesure que votre collection grandit et que vous écoutez.
ListLock_Body.es: Las listas se desbloquean a medida que crece tu colección y vas escuchando.
ListLock_Body.de: Playlists werden freigeschaltet, während deine Sammlung wächst und du Musik hörst.
ListLock_Body.zh-Hans: 随着音乐收藏增加和你的收听，播放列表会逐渐解锁。
ListLock_Body.comment: Line under the heading on the playlists pane card about lists that are not there yet.

ListLock_Hide.comment: Tooltip on the × in the top-right corner of the playlists pane card about lists that are not there yet. Hides the card for good.

Wizard_Welcome.en: Welcome to rpm. We will guide you through setting up your music collection.
Wizard_Welcome.fr: Bienvenue dans rpm. Nous allons vous guider pour configurer votre collection musicale.
Wizard_Welcome.es: Te damos la bienvenida a rpm. Te guiaremos para configurar tu colección de música.
Wizard_Welcome.de: Willkommen bei rpm. Wir führen dich durch die Einrichtung deiner Musiksammlung.
Wizard_Welcome.zh-Hans: 欢迎使用 rpm。我们将引导你完成音乐收藏的设置。
Wizard_Welcome.comment: Setup wizard step 1, under the wordmark and tagline, above the folder question.

Wizard_ChooseFolder.comment: Setup wizard step 2: the one source. Onboarding imports a folder of files and nothing else.

Wizard_PlanFolder.comment: Setup wizard step 2, destination grid: the folder a file lands in, relative to the collection.

Wizard_PlanFile.comment: Setup wizard step 2, destination grid: what the file will be called.

Wizard_ImportMove.zh-Hans: 将 {0} 个文件移动到收藏
Wizard_ImportMove.comment: Setup wizard step 2 press button when Move is chosen.

Wizard_ImportCopy.zh-Hans: 将 {0} 个文件复制到收藏
Wizard_ImportCopy.comment: Setup wizard step 2 press button when Copy is chosen.

Wizard_ImportMoveUnknown.en: Move {0} files to collection ({1} as Unknown Artist)
Wizard_ImportMoveUnknown.fr: Déplacer {0} fichiers vers la collection ({1} en Artiste inconnu)
Wizard_ImportMoveUnknown.es: Mover {0} archivos a la colección ({1} como Artista desconocido)
Wizard_ImportMoveUnknown.de: {0} Dateien in die Sammlung verschieben ({1} als Unbekannter Interpret)
Wizard_ImportMoveUnknown.zh-Hans: 将 {0} 个文件移动到收藏（{1} 个归为未知艺人）
Wizard_ImportMoveUnknown.comment: Setup wizard step 2 press button, Move, when some files are not identified.

Wizard_ImportCopyUnknown.en: Copy {0} files to collection ({1} as Unknown Artist)
Wizard_ImportCopyUnknown.fr: Copier {0} fichiers vers la collection ({1} en Artiste inconnu)
Wizard_ImportCopyUnknown.es: Copiar {0} archivos a la colección ({1} como Artista desconocido)
Wizard_ImportCopyUnknown.de: {0} Dateien in die Sammlung kopieren ({1} als Unbekannter Interpret)
Wizard_ImportCopyUnknown.zh-Hans: 将 {0} 个文件复制到收藏（{1} 个归为未知艺人）
Wizard_ImportCopyUnknown.comment: Setup wizard step 2 press button, Copy, when some files are not identified.

Wizard_LayoutHint.en: Please select the folder structure you wish to use for the music collection.
Wizard_LayoutHint.fr: Choisissez la structure de dossiers à utiliser pour la collection musicale.
Wizard_LayoutHint.es: Elige la estructura de carpetas que quieres usar para la colección de música.
Wizard_LayoutHint.de: Wähle die Ordnerstruktur, die für die Musiksammlung verwendet werden soll.
Wizard_LayoutHint.zh-Hans: 请选择音乐收藏所使用的文件夹结构。
Wizard_LayoutHint.comment: Setup wizard step 2, under the Folder layout heading, above the template choices.

Wizard_OriginalsHint.en: What do you want rpm to do with the music files in the folder you selected?
Wizard_OriginalsHint.fr: Que doit faire rpm avec les fichiers musicaux du dossier que vous avez choisi ?
Wizard_OriginalsHint.es: ¿Qué quieres que rpm haga con los archivos de música de la carpeta que elegiste?
Wizard_OriginalsHint.de: Was soll rpm mit den Musikdateien im gewählten Ordner tun?
Wizard_OriginalsHint.zh-Hans: 你希望 rpm 如何处理所选文件夹中的音乐文件？
Wizard_OriginalsHint.comment: Setup wizard step 2, under The original files heading, above the move/copy choice.

Wizard_PlanHint.en: This is the initial folder structure of your music collection.
Wizard_PlanHint.fr: Voici la structure de dossiers initiale de votre collection musicale.
Wizard_PlanHint.es: Esta es la estructura de carpetas inicial de tu colección de música.
Wizard_PlanHint.de: Das ist die anfängliche Ordnerstruktur deiner Musiksammlung.
Wizard_PlanHint.zh-Hans: 这是你音乐收藏的初始文件夹结构。
Wizard_PlanHint.comment: Setup wizard step 2, under the Music collection heading, above the destination grid.

QueueDup_InCloud.en: In your cloud, with no file on this computer. Importing it puts the file here.
QueueDup_InCloud.fr: Dans votre cloud, sans fichier sur cet ordinateur. L'importer place le fichier ici.
QueueDup_InCloud.es: En tu nube, sin archivo en este ordenador. Al importarlo, el archivo queda aquí.
QueueDup_InCloud.de: In deiner Cloud, ohne Datei auf diesem Computer. Beim Import landet die Datei hier.
QueueDup_InCloud.zh-Hans: 已在你的云端，但此电脑上没有文件。导入后文件就会在本机。
QueueDup_InCloud.comment: Tooltip on the cloud mark in the import queue.

Queue_StatusInCloud.comment: Setup wizard step 2 and the import pane: files the collection lists as cloud records.

Queue_StatusInCloudOne.comment: Setup wizard step 2 and the import pane: files the collection lists as cloud records.

Wizard_GoImport.comment: Setup wizard step 3, when nothing was imported: goes back to the import step.

LibProblem_MissingTitle.fr: Votre dossier de musique est introuvable
LibProblem_MissingTitle.es: No se encuentra tu carpeta de música
LibProblem_MissingTitle.zh-Hans: 找不到你的音乐文件夹
LibProblem_MissingTitle.comment: Heading on the problem screen at startup when the saved music folder is not a folder that is there now (unmounted disk, renamed, deleted).

LibProblem_MissingBody.en: rpm could not find the folder your collection is filed in, so there is nothing to open. Your music files have not been changed.
LibProblem_MissingBody.fr: rpm n'a pas trouvé le dossier où votre collection est rangée, il n'y a donc rien à ouvrir. Vos fichiers de musique n'ont pas été modifiés.
LibProblem_MissingBody.es: rpm no ha encontrado la carpeta donde está tu colección, así que no hay nada que abrir. Tus archivos de música no se han modificado.
LibProblem_MissingBody.de: rpm hat den Ordner mit deiner Sammlung nicht gefunden, es gibt also nichts zu öffnen. Deine Musikdateien wurden nicht geändert.
LibProblem_MissingBody.zh-Hans: rpm 没有找到存放你音乐收藏的文件夹，因此没有可以打开的内容。你的音乐文件没有被改动。

LibProblem_MissingStep1.en: If your music is on an external disk or a network drive, connect it and try again.
LibProblem_MissingStep1.fr: Si votre musique est sur un disque externe ou un lecteur réseau, connectez-le puis réessayez.
LibProblem_MissingStep1.es: Si tu música está en un disco externo o una unidad de red, conéctala y vuelve a intentarlo.
LibProblem_MissingStep1.de: Wenn deine Musik auf einer externen Festplatte oder einem Netzlaufwerk liegt, verbinde sie und versuche es erneut.
LibProblem_MissingStep1.zh-Hans: 如果音乐放在移动硬盘或网络驱动器上，请接好设备后重试。
LibProblem_MissingStep1.comment: Problem screen, missing folder: first troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_MissingStep2.en: If the folder was renamed or moved, choose another folder and point rpm at its new place.
LibProblem_MissingStep2.fr: Si le dossier a été renommé ou déplacé, choisissez un autre dossier et indiquez son nouvel emplacement à rpm.
LibProblem_MissingStep2.es: Si la carpeta se ha renombrado o movido, elige otra carpeta e indícale a rpm dónde está ahora.
LibProblem_MissingStep2.de: Wenn der Ordner umbenannt oder verschoben wurde, wähle einen anderen Ordner und zeige rpm, wo er jetzt liegt.
LibProblem_MissingStep2.zh-Hans: 如果文件夹被改名或移动了，请另选一个文件夹，告诉 rpm 它现在的位置。
LibProblem_MissingStep2.comment: Problem screen, missing folder: second troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_MissingStep3.en: If the folder was deleted, choose another folder to set up a new collection. rpm never deletes your music files.
LibProblem_MissingStep3.fr: Si le dossier a été supprimé, choisissez un autre dossier pour créer une nouvelle collection. rpm ne supprime jamais vos fichiers de musique.
LibProblem_MissingStep3.es: Si la carpeta se ha eliminado, elige otra carpeta para crear una colección nueva. rpm nunca elimina tus archivos de música.
LibProblem_MissingStep3.de: Wenn der Ordner gelöscht wurde, wähle einen anderen Ordner für eine neue Sammlung. rpm löscht deine Musikdateien nie.
LibProblem_MissingStep3.zh-Hans: 如果文件夹被删除了，请另选一个文件夹来新建收藏。rpm 从不删除你的音乐文件。
LibProblem_MissingStep3.comment: Problem screen, missing folder: third troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_NewerTitle.en: This collection needs a newer rpm
LibProblem_NewerTitle.fr: Cette collection nécessite une version plus récente de rpm
LibProblem_NewerTitle.es: Esta colección necesita una versión más reciente de rpm
LibProblem_NewerTitle.de: Diese Sammlung braucht ein neueres rpm
LibProblem_NewerTitle.zh-Hans: 这个收藏需要更新版本的 rpm
LibProblem_NewerTitle.comment: Heading on the problem screen when the collection file was written by a newer version of rpm.

LibProblem_NewerBody.en: The collection in this folder was last opened by a newer version of rpm, which this version cannot read. Nothing was changed.
LibProblem_NewerBody.fr: La collection de ce dossier a été ouverte pour la dernière fois par une version plus récente de rpm, que cette version ne peut pas lire. Rien n'a été modifié.
LibProblem_NewerBody.es: La colección de esta carpeta se abrió por última vez con una versión más reciente de rpm, que esta versión no puede leer. No se ha modificado nada.
LibProblem_NewerBody.de: Die Sammlung in diesem Ordner wurde zuletzt mit einer neueren Version von rpm geöffnet, die diese Version nicht lesen kann. Es wurde nichts geändert.
LibProblem_NewerBody.zh-Hans: 这个文件夹里的收藏上次是用更新版本的 rpm 打开的，当前版本无法读取。没有改动任何内容。

LibProblem_NewerStep1.en: Update rpm to the latest version and open it again.
LibProblem_NewerStep1.fr: Mettez rpm à jour vers la dernière version, puis ouvrez-le à nouveau.
LibProblem_NewerStep1.es: Actualiza rpm a la última versión y vuelve a abrirlo.
LibProblem_NewerStep1.de: Aktualisiere rpm auf die neueste Version und öffne es dann erneut.
LibProblem_NewerStep1.zh-Hans: 请把 rpm 更新到最新版本，然后重新打开。
LibProblem_NewerStep1.comment: Problem screen, newer collection: first troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_NewerStep2.en: Or open this folder with the newer version of rpm you used before.
LibProblem_NewerStep2.fr: Ou ouvrez ce dossier avec la version plus récente de rpm que vous avez utilisée.
LibProblem_NewerStep2.es: O abre esta carpeta con la versión más reciente de rpm que usaste antes.
LibProblem_NewerStep2.de: Oder öffne diesen Ordner mit der neueren Version von rpm, die du vorher benutzt hast.
LibProblem_NewerStep2.zh-Hans: 或者用你之前使用的那个更新版本的 rpm 打开这个文件夹。
LibProblem_NewerStep2.comment: Problem screen, newer collection: second troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_NewerStep3.en: Or choose another folder to work on a different collection for now.
LibProblem_NewerStep3.fr: Ou choisissez un autre dossier pour travailler sur une autre collection en attendant.
LibProblem_NewerStep3.es: O elige otra carpeta para trabajar entretanto en otra colección.
LibProblem_NewerStep3.de: Oder wähle vorerst einen anderen Ordner für eine andere Sammlung.
LibProblem_NewerStep3.zh-Hans: 或者先另选一个文件夹，使用另一个收藏。
LibProblem_NewerStep3.comment: Problem screen, newer collection: third troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_NewerVersions.en: Collection version {0}, this version of rpm reads up to {1}.
LibProblem_NewerVersions.fr: Version de la collection : {0}. Cette version de rpm lit jusqu'à la version {1}.
LibProblem_NewerVersions.es: Versión de la colección: {0}. Esta versión de rpm lee hasta la {1}.
LibProblem_NewerVersions.de: Version der Sammlung: {0}. Diese Version von rpm liest bis Version {1}.
LibProblem_NewerVersions.zh-Hans: 收藏版本 {0}，当前 rpm 最高可读 {1}。
LibProblem_NewerVersions.comment: Problem screen, newer collection: the two schema version numbers, under the folder path. {0} is the version found, {1} the newest this build reads.

LibProblem_UnreadableTitle.en: Your collection could not be opened
LibProblem_UnreadableTitle.fr: Votre collection n'a pas pu être ouverte
LibProblem_UnreadableTitle.es: No se ha podido abrir tu colección
LibProblem_UnreadableTitle.de: Deine Sammlung konnte nicht geöffnet werden
LibProblem_UnreadableTitle.comment: Heading on the problem screen when the folder is there and its collection file could not be read.

LibProblem_UnreadableBody.en: The collection file in your music folder could not be read, so there is nothing to show. Your music files have not been changed.
LibProblem_UnreadableBody.fr: Le fichier de collection de votre dossier de musique n'a pas pu être lu, il n'y a donc rien à afficher. Vos fichiers de musique n'ont pas été modifiés.
LibProblem_UnreadableBody.es: No se ha podido leer el archivo de colección de tu carpeta de música, así que no hay nada que mostrar. Tus archivos de música no se han modificado.
LibProblem_UnreadableBody.de: Die Sammlungsdatei in deinem Musikordner konnte nicht gelesen werden, es gibt also nichts zu zeigen. Deine Musikdateien wurden nicht geändert.
LibProblem_UnreadableBody.zh-Hans: 无法读取音乐文件夹里的收藏文件，因此没有可显示的内容。你的音乐文件没有被改动。

LibProblem_UnreadableStep1.en: Close any other copy of rpm that is open, then try again.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep1.fr: Fermez toute autre copie de rpm ouverte, puis réessayez.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep1.es: Cierra cualquier otra copia de rpm que esté abierta y vuelve a intentarlo.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep1.de: Schließe jede andere offene Kopie von rpm und versuche es dann erneut.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep1.zh-Hans: 请关闭其他已打开的 rpm，然后重试。
LibProblem_UnreadableStep1.comment: Problem screen, unreadable collection: first troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_UnreadableStep2.en: If the folder is on an external disk or a network drive, check that it is connected and that you can save files to it.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep2.fr: Si le dossier est sur un disque externe ou un lecteur réseau, vérifiez qu'il est connecté et que vous pouvez y enregistrer des fichiers.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep2.es: Si la carpeta está en un disco externo o una unidad de red, comprueba que está conectada y que puedes guardar archivos en ella.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep2.de: Wenn der Ordner auf einer externen Festplatte oder einem Netzlaufwerk liegt, prüfe, ob sie verbunden ist und ob du dort Dateien speichern kannst.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep2.zh-Hans: 如果文件夹在移动硬盘或网络驱动器上，请检查设备是否已连接，以及你是否可以在其中保存文件。
LibProblem_UnreadableStep2.comment: Problem screen, unreadable collection: second troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_UnreadableStep3.en: If this keeps happening, choose another folder to set up a new collection. Your music files stay where they are.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep3.fr: Si le problème persiste, choisissez un autre dossier pour créer une nouvelle collection. Vos fichiers de musique restent où ils sont.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep3.es: Si sigue ocurriendo, elige otra carpeta para crear una colección nueva. Tus archivos de música se quedan donde están.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep3.de: Wenn das weiterhin passiert, wähle einen anderen Ordner für eine neue Sammlung. Deine Musikdateien bleiben, wo sie sind.
LibProblem_UnreadableStep3.zh-Hans: 如果一直这样，请另选一个文件夹来新建收藏。你的音乐文件会留在原处。
LibProblem_UnreadableStep3.comment: Problem screen, unreadable collection: third troubleshooting step.

LibProblem_ReadFailedTitle.en: Your collection could not be read
LibProblem_ReadFailedTitle.fr: Votre collection n'a pas pu être lue
LibProblem_ReadFailedTitle.es: No se ha podido leer tu colección
LibProblem_ReadFailedTitle.de: Deine Sammlung konnte nicht gelesen werden
LibProblem_ReadFailedTitle.comment: Heading on the problem screen shown over the library when the collection opened and a later read of its collection file failed.

LibProblem_ReadFailedBody.en: rpm opened your collection and then could not read its collection file, so there is nothing to show. Your music files have not been changed.
LibProblem_ReadFailedBody.fr: rpm a ouvert votre collection, puis n'a pas pu lire son fichier de collection, il n'y a donc rien à afficher. Vos fichiers de musique n'ont pas été modifiés.
LibProblem_ReadFailedBody.es: rpm abrió tu colección y después no pudo leer su archivo de colección, así que no hay nada que mostrar. Tus archivos de música no se han modificado.
LibProblem_ReadFailedBody.de: rpm hat deine Sammlung geöffnet und konnte danach ihre Sammlungsdatei nicht lesen, es gibt also nichts zu zeigen. Deine Musikdateien wurden nicht geändert.
LibProblem_ReadFailedBody.zh-Hans: rpm 打开了你的收藏，之后却无法读取其收藏文件，因此没有可显示的内容。你的音乐文件没有被改动。

LibProblem_StepsHeading.comment: Problem screen: heading over the three troubleshooting steps.

LibProblem_Retry.comment: Problem screen: the main button, opens the same folder again.

LibProblem_Choose.comment: Problem screen: the second button, goes to the folder step of setup.

LibProblem_Details.comment: Problem screen: link that shows the technical error text under it.

LibProblem_Unchanged.fr: Le problème est toujours le même.
LibProblem_Unchanged.es: El problema sigue siendo el mismo.
LibProblem_Unchanged.comment: Problem screen: status line after Try again opened the same folder and hit the same problem.

Coach_Dismiss.comment: Tooltip on a first-run hint's close button.

Settings_ShowHintsAgain.es: Volver a mostrar los consejos iniciales
Settings_ShowHintsAgain.zh-Hans: 重新显示首次运行提示
Settings_ShowHintsAgain.comment: Settings button that puts every coachmark back.

Coach_SignIn.en: Sign in to rpm to use the cloud: your collection on your phone, and streaming wherever you are.
Coach_SignIn.fr: Connectez-vous à rpm pour utiliser le cloud : votre collection sur votre téléphone, et l'écoute en streaming où que vous soyez.
Coach_SignIn.es: Inicia sesión en rpm para usar la nube: tu colección en el móvil y streaming estés donde estés.
Coach_SignIn.de: Melde dich bei rpm an, um die Cloud zu nutzen: deine Sammlung auf dem Handy und Streaming von überall.
Coach_SignIn.zh-Hans: 登录 rpm 即可使用云功能：手机上访问你的收藏，随时随地在线播放。
Coach_SignIn.comment: First-run hint pointing at the menu, shown only while signed out.

Settings_Hints.comment: Display settings, card heading over the button that replays the coachmarks.

Settings_HintsHint.en: The arrows that point out where music comes in, how the artwork header opens, and how to switch views. They appear once each and then stop.
Settings_HintsHint.fr: Les flèches qui montrent par où la musique arrive, comment ouvrir l'en-tête de pochette et comment changer de vue. Elles apparaissent une fois chacune, puis disparaissent.
Settings_HintsHint.es: Las flechas que muestran por dónde entra la música, cómo se abre la cabecera de portada y cómo cambiar de vista. Aparecen una vez cada una y luego no vuelven.
Settings_HintsHint.de: Die Pfeile, die zeigen, wo Musik hereinkommt, wie sich das Cover-Banner öffnet und wie man die Ansicht wechselt. Jeder erscheint einmal und dann nicht mehr.
Settings_HintsHint.zh-Hans: 这些箭头会指出音乐从哪里导入、封面横幅如何展开，以及如何切换视图。每个只出现一次。
Settings_HintsHint.comment: Display settings, line under the first-run hints heading.

Settings_HintsBack.comment: Display settings, what the replay button says once it has been pressed.

Rpm_Net_OfflineDownloads.en: Only downloaded albums can be played.
Rpm_Net_OfflineDownloads.fr: Seuls les albums téléchargés peuvent être lus.
Rpm_Net_OfflineDownloads.es: Solo se pueden reproducir los álbumes descargados.
Rpm_Net_OfflineDownloads.de: Nur geladene Alben können abgespielt werden.
Rpm_Net_OfflineDownloads.zh-Hans: 只能播放已下载的专辑。
Rpm_Net_OfflineDownloads.comment: Second line of the offline bar on the iPhone once signed in.

Rpm_Download_Download.comment: Accessibility label of the download button on an iPhone album page.

Rpm_Download_Progress.comment: Accessibility label of the download button while an album downloads. {0} tracks done, {1} in total.

Rpm_Download_OnPhone.comment: Accessibility label of the download button once every track is on the iPhone.

Rpm_Download_Stuck.fr: Certains titres n'ont pas pu être téléchargés. Touchez pour réessayer.
Rpm_Download_Stuck.es: Algunas canciones no se pudieron descargar. Toca para reintentar.
Rpm_Download_Stuck.de: Einige Titel konnten nicht geladen werden. Zum erneuten Versuch tippen.
Rpm_Download_Stuck.zh-Hans: 部分歌曲无法下载。轻点以重试。
Rpm_Download_Stuck.comment: Accessibility label of the download button when some tracks failed.

Rpm_Download_StuckCount.comment: Downloads list on the iPhone: tracks downloaded out of the album's total, for an album whose download stopped.

Rpm_Download_Stop.comment: Destructive button in the dialog that stops an album download on the iPhone.

Rpm_Download_StopQuestion.fr: Arrêter le téléchargement de cet album ?
Rpm_Download_StopQuestion.zh-Hans: 要停止下载这张专辑吗？
Rpm_Download_StopQuestion.comment: Title of the dialog that stops an album download on the iPhone.

Rpm_Download_Remove.comment: Destructive button that removes downloaded albums from the iPhone.

Rpm_Download_RemoveQuestion.en: Remove this album from your iPhone? It stays in your cloud library.
Rpm_Download_RemoveQuestion.fr: Supprimer cet album de votre iPhone ? Il reste dans votre bibliothèque cloud.
Rpm_Download_RemoveQuestion.es: ¿Eliminar este álbum de tu iPhone? Seguirá en tu biblioteca en la nube.
Rpm_Download_RemoveQuestion.de: Dieses Album vom iPhone entfernen? Es bleibt in deiner Cloud-Bibliothek.
Rpm_Download_RemoveQuestion.zh-Hans: 要从 iPhone 移除这张专辑吗？它仍会保留在你的云端音乐库中。

Rpm_Downloads_Title.comment: Heading of the downloads card on the iPhone profile tab, and of the downloads list.

Rpm_Downloads_None.comment: Downloads card on the iPhone profile tab when nothing is downloaded.

Rpm_Downloads_Summary.comment: Downloads on the iPhone: album count, then the space they use, e.g. '12 albums (3.2 GB)'.

Rpm_Downloads_SummaryOne.comment: Downloads on the iPhone when there is one album, with the space it uses.

Rpm_Downloads_Detail.en: Downloaded albums play without an internet connection.
Rpm_Downloads_Detail.fr: Les albums téléchargés sont lus sans connexion Internet.
Rpm_Downloads_Detail.es: Los álbumes descargados se reproducen sin conexión a Internet.
Rpm_Downloads_Detail.de: Geladene Alben werden ohne Internetverbindung abgespielt.
Rpm_Downloads_Detail.zh-Hans: 已下载的专辑无需联网即可播放。
Rpm_Downloads_Detail.comment: Explanation under the downloads card on the iPhone profile tab.

Rpm_Downloads_Manage.comment: Button on the iPhone profile tab that opens the list of downloaded albums.

Rpm_Downloads_Select.comment: Button on the iPhone downloads list that turns on selection.

Rpm_Downloads_Done.comment: Button on the iPhone downloads list that turns off selection.

Rpm_Downloads_SelectAll.comment: Button on the iPhone downloads list that selects every album.

Rpm_Downloads_SelectNone.comment: Button on the iPhone downloads list that clears the selection.

Rpm_Downloads_RemoveCount.comment: Button on the iPhone downloads list that removes the selected albums. {0} is how many are selected.

Rpm_Downloads_RemoveQuestion.en: Remove {0} albums from your iPhone? They stay in your cloud library.
Rpm_Downloads_RemoveQuestion.fr: Supprimer {0} albums de votre iPhone ? Ils restent dans votre bibliothèque cloud.
Rpm_Downloads_RemoveQuestion.es: ¿Eliminar {0} álbumes de tu iPhone? Seguirán en tu biblioteca en la nube.
Rpm_Downloads_RemoveQuestion.de: {0} Alben vom iPhone entfernen? Sie bleiben in deiner Cloud-Bibliothek.
Rpm_Downloads_RemoveQuestion.zh-Hans: 要从 iPhone 移除 {0} 张专辑吗？它们仍会保留在你的云端音乐库中。
Rpm_Downloads_RemoveQuestion.comment: Title of the dialog that removes several downloaded albums from the iPhone.

Rpm_Downloads_Empty.en: No downloads yet. Open an album and tap the download button to play it without an internet connection.
Rpm_Downloads_Empty.fr: Aucun téléchargement pour l'instant. Ouvrez un album et touchez le bouton de téléchargement pour l'écouter sans connexion Internet.
Rpm_Downloads_Empty.es: Aún no hay descargas. Abre un álbum y toca el botón de descarga para escucharlo sin conexión a Internet.
Rpm_Downloads_Empty.de: Noch keine Downloads. Öffne ein Album und tippe auf die Download-Taste, um es ohne Internetverbindung zu hören.
Rpm_Downloads_Empty.zh-Hans: 还没有下载。打开一张专辑并轻点下载按钮，即可在没有网络时播放。
Rpm_Downloads_Empty.comment: Empty state of the iPhone downloads list.

Rpm_About_ReadMore.comment: Album and artist pages, phone: small glass button at the end of the shortened Wikipedia text. Opens the full text in a sheet.

Fault_Offline.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). No network, or the server name could not be found.

Fault_Timeout.en: The server did not respond. Please try again.
Fault_Timeout.fr: Le serveur n'a pas répondu. Réessayez.
Fault_Timeout.es: El servidor no respondió. Inténtalo de nuevo.
Fault_Timeout.de: Der Server hat nicht geantwortet. Bitte erneut versuchen.
Fault_Timeout.zh-Hans: 服务器没有响应，请重试。
Fault_Timeout.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). The request was sent and no answer came in time.

Fault_SignedOut.en: Signed out. Sign in to continue.
Fault_SignedOut.es: Sesión cerrada. Inicia sesión para continuar.
Fault_SignedOut.de: Abgemeldet. Melde dich an, um fortzufahren.
Fault_SignedOut.zh-Hans: 已退出登录。请登录后继续。
Fault_SignedOut.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). The server refused the sign-in token.

Fault_Server.en: The server could not complete this. Please try again later.
Fault_Server.fr: Le serveur n'a pas pu terminer l'opération. Réessayez plus tard.
Fault_Server.es: El servidor no pudo completarlo. Inténtalo de nuevo más tarde.
Fault_Server.de: Der Server konnte den Vorgang nicht abschließen. Bitte später erneut versuchen.
Fault_Server.zh-Hans: 服务器无法完成此操作，请稍后重试。
Fault_Server.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). The server answered with an error.

Fault_NoPermission.en: rpm does not have permission to use this file or folder.
Fault_NoPermission.fr: rpm n'a pas l'autorisation d'utiliser ce fichier ou ce dossier.
Fault_NoPermission.es: rpm no tiene permiso para usar este archivo o carpeta.
Fault_NoPermission.de: rpm hat keine Berechtigung für diese Datei oder diesen Ordner.
Fault_NoPermission.zh-Hans: rpm 没有权限使用此文件或文件夹。
Fault_NoPermission.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). The operating system refused access to a file or folder.

Fault_NoSpace.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). A write failed because the disk has no free space.

Fault_FileMissing.en: The file or folder could not be found.
Fault_FileMissing.fr: Le fichier ou le dossier est introuvable.
Fault_FileMissing.es: No se encontró el archivo o la carpeta.
Fault_FileMissing.de: Die Datei oder der Ordner wurde nicht gefunden.
Fault_FileMissing.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). A file or folder was moved, deleted or is on a disk that is not connected.

Fault_FileInUse.en: The file is in use by another app.
Fault_FileInUse.fr: Le fichier est utilisé par une autre app.
Fault_FileInUse.es: Otra app está usando el archivo.
Fault_FileInUse.de: Die Datei wird von einer anderen App verwendet.
Fault_FileInUse.zh-Hans: 该文件正被其他应用使用。
Fault_FileInUse.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). Another program has the file open.

Fault_Unreadable.en: The data could not be read.
Fault_Unreadable.fr: Les données n'ont pas pu être lues.
Fault_Unreadable.es: No se pudieron leer los datos.
Fault_Unreadable.de: Die Daten konnten nicht gelesen werden.
Fault_Unreadable.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). A file or a server answer was damaged or in an unexpected format.

Fault_Unknown.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Fault_Unknown.es: Algo salió mal. Inténtalo de nuevo.
Fault_Unknown.de: Etwas ist schiefgelaufen. Bitte erneut versuchen.
Fault_Unknown.comment: Shown in place of a .NET exception message wherever a step fails (sign-in, cloud, casting, import). Any failure that is not one of the other Fault_ strings. The details go to the log.

Login_WrongPassword.fr: Adresse e-mail ou mot de passe incorrect.
Login_WrongPassword.comment: Sign-in dialog error: the accounts service refused the email and password.

Login_NotConfirmed.en: Confirm your email address first, then sign in again.
Login_NotConfirmed.fr: Confirmez d'abord votre adresse e-mail, puis reconnectez-vous.
Login_NotConfirmed.es: Primero confirma tu correo electrónico y vuelve a iniciar sesión.
Login_NotConfirmed.de: Bestätige zuerst deine E-Mail-Adresse und melde dich dann erneut an.
Login_NotConfirmed.zh-Hans: 请先确认你的邮箱地址，然后重新登录。
Login_NotConfirmed.comment: Sign-in dialog error: the account exists and its email address has not been confirmed.

Login_BrowserTimedOut.en: Sign-in was not completed in your browser. Please try again.
Login_BrowserTimedOut.fr: La connexion n'a pas été terminée dans votre navigateur. Réessayez.
Login_BrowserTimedOut.es: No se completó el inicio de sesión en tu navegador. Inténtalo de nuevo.
Login_BrowserTimedOut.de: Die Anmeldung im Browser wurde nicht abgeschlossen. Bitte erneut versuchen.
Login_BrowserTimedOut.zh-Hans: 未在浏览器中完成登录，请重试。
Login_BrowserTimedOut.comment: Sign-in dialog error: Google or Apple sign-in was opened in the browser and not finished within 3 minutes.

Cloud_SyncStopped.comment: Cloud settings status line. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Cloud_TracksNotRemoved.de: {0} von {1} Titeln konnten nicht aus der Cloud entfernt werden. {2}
Cloud_TracksNotRemoved.zh-Hans: {1} 首中有 {0} 首无法从云端移除。{2}
Cloud_TracksNotRemoved.comment: Cloud settings status line after removing an album, playlist or folder from the cloud. {2} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Cloud_PlaylistNotRemoved.en: The playlist could not be removed from the cloud. {0}
Cloud_PlaylistNotRemoved.fr: La playlist n'a pas pu être retirée du cloud. {0}
Cloud_PlaylistNotRemoved.es: No se pudo quitar la lista de reproducción de la nube. {0}
Cloud_PlaylistNotRemoved.de: Die Playlist konnte nicht aus der Cloud entfernt werden. {0}
Cloud_PlaylistNotRemoved.zh-Hans: 无法从云端移除该播放列表。{0}
Cloud_PlaylistNotRemoved.comment: Cloud settings status line. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Cloud_PlaylistNotStored.en: The playlist "{0}" could not be saved to the cloud. {1}

Cloud_PlaylistNotStored.es: No se pudo guardar la lista de reproducción «{0}» en la nube. {1}
Cloud_PlaylistNotStored.de: Die Playlist „{0}“ konnte nicht in der Cloud gespeichert werden. {1}
Cloud_PlaylistNotStored.zh-Hans: 无法将播放列表“{0}”保存到云端。{1}

Catalog_DiscogsConnectError.comment: Catalogue settings, under the Discogs row. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Catalog_DiscogsDisconnectError.fr: Discogs n'a pas pu être déconnecté. {0}
Catalog_DiscogsDisconnectError.comment: Catalogue settings, under the Discogs row. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Viz_CouldNotStart.en: The visuals could not start on this computer.
Viz_CouldNotStart.fr: Les visuels n'ont pas pu démarrer sur cet ordinateur.
Viz_CouldNotStart.es: Los efectos visuales no pudieron iniciarse en este ordenador.
Viz_CouldNotStart.de: Die Visualisierung konnte auf diesem Computer nicht gestartet werden.
Viz_CouldNotStart.zh-Hans: 无法在这台电脑上启动视觉效果。
Viz_CouldNotStart.comment: On the black behind the full-screen player and the visualizer, when the graphics could not start. The music keeps playing.

Split_SettingsUnreadable.en: The saved clean up settings could not be read, so the clean up is off.
Split_SettingsUnreadable.fr: Les réglages de nettoyage enregistrés n'ont pas pu être lus, le nettoyage est donc désactivé.
Split_SettingsUnreadable.es: No se pudieron leer los ajustes de limpieza guardados, así que la limpieza está desactivada.
Split_SettingsUnreadable.de: Die gespeicherten Bereinigungseinstellungen konnten nicht gelesen werden, daher ist die Bereinigung aus.
Split_SettingsUnreadable.zh-Hans: 无法读取已保存的降噪设置，因此降噪已关闭。
Split_SettingsUnreadable.comment: Split window, clean up panel: the settings file saved with a vinyl recording is damaged.

Split_ProfileFailed.en: The noise profile could not be taken. {0}
Split_ProfileFailed.fr: Le profil de bruit n'a pas pu être relevé. {0}
Split_ProfileFailed.es: No se pudo tomar el perfil de ruido. {0}
Split_ProfileFailed.de: Das Rauschprofil konnte nicht erstellt werden. {0}
Split_ProfileFailed.comment: Split window, clean up panel. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Split_PreviewFailed.en: The preview could not be made. {0}
Split_PreviewFailed.fr: L'aperçu n'a pas pu être créé. {0}
Split_PreviewFailed.es: No se pudo crear la vista previa. {0}
Split_PreviewFailed.de: Die Vorschau konnte nicht erstellt werden. {0}
Split_PreviewFailed.comment: Split window, under the clean up preview. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Vinyl_DeviceFailed.en: The input device could not be opened. Check that it is connected and that rpm is allowed to use it.
Vinyl_DeviceFailed.fr: Le périphérique d'entrée n'a pas pu être ouvert. Vérifiez qu'il est branché et que rpm est autorisé à l'utiliser.
Vinyl_DeviceFailed.es: No se pudo abrir el dispositivo de entrada. Comprueba que esté conectado y que rpm tenga permiso para usarlo.
Vinyl_DeviceFailed.de: Das Eingabegerät konnte nicht geöffnet werden. Prüfe, ob es angeschlossen ist und rpm es verwenden darf.
Vinyl_DeviceFailed.zh-Hans: 无法打开输入设备。请检查它是否已连接，以及是否允许 rpm 使用它。
Vinyl_DeviceFailed.comment: Record vinyl dialog, when monitoring or recording cannot start. On a Mac this is often the microphone permission.

Vinyl_SideNotSaved.en: The side could not be saved. {0}
Vinyl_SideNotSaved.fr: La face n'a pas pu être enregistrée. {0}
Vinyl_SideNotSaved.es: No se pudo guardar la cara. {0}
Vinyl_SideNotSaved.de: Die Seite konnte nicht gespeichert werden. {0}
Vinyl_SideNotSaved.comment: Record vinyl dialog, after pressing Stop. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Naming_ApplyFailed.en: Re-filing stopped. Files that already moved stay where they are. {0}
Naming_ApplyFailed.fr: Le reclassement s'est arrêté. Les fichiers déjà déplacés restent où ils sont. {0}
Naming_ApplyFailed.es: La reorganización se detuvo. Los archivos que ya se movieron se quedan donde están. {0}
Naming_ApplyFailed.de: Das Neuablegen wurde abgebrochen. Bereits verschobene Dateien bleiben, wo sie sind. {0}
Naming_ApplyFailed.zh-Hans: 重新归档已停止。已移动的文件保持原位。{0}
Naming_ApplyFailed.comment: Apply naming dialog, when re-filing the collection fails part way. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

AddMusic_PendingDeleteFailed.en: The rip could not be deleted. {0}
AddMusic_PendingDeleteFailed.fr: Le rip n'a pas pu être supprimé. {0}
AddMusic_PendingDeleteFailed.es: No se pudo eliminar la copia. {0}
AddMusic_PendingDeleteFailed.de: Der Rip konnte nicht gelöscht werden. {0}
AddMusic_PendingDeleteFailed.comment: Add music, pending rips list. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Sharing_ServeFailed.en: A request from another computer could not be answered.
Sharing_ServeFailed.fr: Une demande d'un autre ordinateur n'a pas pu aboutir.
Sharing_ServeFailed.es: No se pudo responder a una solicitud de otro ordenador.
Sharing_ServeFailed.de: Eine Anfrage von einem anderen Computer konnte nicht beantwortet werden.
Sharing_ServeFailed.zh-Hans: 无法响应来自另一台电脑的请求。
Sharing_ServeFailed.comment: Library settings, sharing section: this computer failed while answering another computer. Details are in the log.

Sharing_ReadFailed.en: {0} is on the network and did not send its music.
Sharing_ReadFailed.fr: {0} est sur le réseau mais n'a pas envoyé sa musique.
Sharing_ReadFailed.es: {0} está en la red y no envió su música.
Sharing_ReadFailed.de: {0} ist im Netzwerk, hat seine Musik aber nicht gesendet.
Sharing_ReadFailed.zh-Hans: {0} 在网络上，但没有发送它的音乐。
Sharing_ReadFailed.comment: Library settings, sharing section. {0} is the other computer's name. Its shelf here stops updating.

Sharing_CloudFailed.en: The cloud copies could not be shared. {0}
Sharing_CloudFailed.fr: Les copies dans le cloud n'ont pas pu être partagées. {0}
Sharing_CloudFailed.es: No se pudieron compartir las copias de la nube. {0}
Sharing_CloudFailed.de: Die Cloud-Kopien konnten nicht geteilt werden. {0}
Sharing_CloudFailed.comment: Library settings, sharing section. {0} is the reason, one of the Fault_ sentences.

Cast_ThisComputer.comment: Desktop cast menu (the player and the deck bar). The entry that plays on this computer instead of a speaker.

Cast_SoundCard.comment: Desktop cast menu (the player and the deck bar). Second line under This computer.

Cast_Lossless.comment: Desktop cast menu (the player and the deck bar). Checkbox: send FLAC instead of MP3.

Cast_LosslessHint.en: 24-bit, not re-compressed. Unavailable on speakers that cannot play FLAC.
Cast_LosslessHint.fr: 24 bits, sans recompression. Indisponible sur les enceintes qui ne lisent pas le FLAC.
Cast_LosslessHint.es: 24 bits, sin recomprimir. No disponible en altavoces que no reproducen FLAC.
Cast_LosslessHint.de: 24 Bit, ohne erneute Komprimierung. Nicht verfügbar auf Lautsprechern, die kein FLAC abspielen.
Cast_LosslessHint.zh-Hans: 24 位，不再压缩。不支持 FLAC 的扬声器无法使用。
Cast_LosslessHint.comment: Desktop cast menu (the player and the deck bar). Under the Lossless checkbox.

Cast_Surround.comment: Desktop cast menu (the player and the deck bar). Checkbox: send surround tracks as Dolby Digital.

Cast_SurroundHint.en: Sends surround tracks as Dolby Digital. Unavailable on speakers that cannot pass it through.
Cast_SurroundHint.fr: Envoie les pistes surround en Dolby Digital. Indisponible sur les enceintes qui ne peuvent pas le transmettre.
Cast_SurroundHint.es: Envía las pistas envolventes como Dolby Digital. No disponible en altavoces que no pueden transmitirlo.
Cast_SurroundHint.de: Sendet Surround-Titel als Dolby Digital. Nicht verfügbar auf Lautsprechern, die es nicht weitergeben können.
Cast_SurroundHint.zh-Hans: 以杜比数字格式发送环绕声曲目。不支持直通的扬声器无法使用。
Cast_SurroundHint.comment: Desktop cast menu (the player and the deck bar). Under the Surround checkbox.

Cast_ScreenOff.comment: Desktop cast menu (the player and the deck bar). Checkbox: a TV shows black while the music plays.

Cast_ScreenOffHint.en: The TV goes black and the music keeps playing. Unavailable on speakers without a screen.
Cast_ScreenOffHint.fr: La télévision s'éteint et la musique continue. Indisponible sur les enceintes sans écran.
Cast_ScreenOffHint.es: La televisión se apaga y la música sigue sonando. No disponible en altavoces sin pantalla.
Cast_ScreenOffHint.de: Der Fernseher wird schwarz und die Musik läuft weiter. Nicht verfügbar auf Lautsprechern ohne Bildschirm.
Cast_ScreenOffHint.zh-Hans: 电视黑屏，音乐继续播放。没有屏幕的扬声器无法使用。
Cast_ScreenOffHint.comment: Desktop cast menu (the player and the deck bar). Under the Turn off the screen checkbox.

Cast_TooltipCasting.es: Reproduciendo en {0}. Haz clic para cambiar.
Cast_TooltipCasting.zh-Hans: 正在 {0} 上播放。点击以更改。
Cast_TooltipCasting.comment: Tooltip on the desktop cast button while casting. {0} is the speaker's name.

Firewall_CastBlocked.en: Windows Firewall is blocking rpm on this network, so speakers can't play music from this computer.
Firewall_CastBlocked.fr: Le pare-feu Windows bloque rpm sur ce réseau. Les enceintes ne peuvent donc pas lire la musique de cet ordinateur.
Firewall_CastBlocked.es: El Firewall de Windows está bloqueando rpm en esta red, así que los altavoces no pueden reproducir música de este ordenador.
Firewall_CastBlocked.de: Die Windows-Firewall blockiert rpm in diesem Netzwerk, daher können Lautsprecher keine Musik von diesem Computer abspielen.
Firewall_CastBlocked.zh-Hans: Windows 防火墙正在此网络上阻止 rpm，因此扬声器无法播放这台电脑上的音乐。
Firewall_CastBlocked.comment: Cast menu, under the speaker list, Windows only. A firewall rule blocks rpm, so a speaker cannot fetch the music. A button to fix it follows (Firewall_Allow).

Firewall_ShareBlocked.en: Windows Firewall is blocking rpm on this network, so other computers can't find or open this collection, and this computer can't find theirs.
Firewall_ShareBlocked.fr: Le pare-feu Windows bloque rpm sur ce réseau. Les autres ordinateurs ne peuvent donc ni trouver ni ouvrir cette collection, et cet ordinateur ne trouve pas les leurs.
Firewall_ShareBlocked.es: El Firewall de Windows está bloqueando rpm en esta red, así que otros equipos no pueden encontrar ni abrir esta colección, y este equipo no encuentra las suyas.
Firewall_ShareBlocked.de: Die Windows-Firewall blockiert rpm in diesem Netzwerk, daher können andere Computer diese Sammlung weder finden noch öffnen, und dieser Computer findet ihre nicht.
Firewall_ShareBlocked.zh-Hans: Windows 防火墙正在此网络上阻止 rpm，因此其他电脑无法找到或打开这个音乐收藏，这台电脑也找不到它们的收藏。
Firewall_ShareBlocked.comment: Library settings, sharing section, Windows only, while sharing is on. A firewall rule blocks rpm. A button to fix it follows (Firewall_Allow).

Firewall_BlocksEverything.en: Windows Firewall is blocking all incoming connections on this network, so speakers and other computers can't connect to rpm. You can change this in Windows Security.
Firewall_BlocksEverything.fr: Le pare-feu Windows bloque toutes les connexions entrantes sur ce réseau. Les enceintes et les autres ordinateurs ne peuvent donc pas se connecter à rpm. Vous pouvez modifier ce réglage dans Sécurité Windows.
Firewall_BlocksEverything.es: El Firewall de Windows está bloqueando todas las conexiones entrantes en esta red, así que los altavoces y otros equipos no pueden conectarse a rpm. Puedes cambiarlo en Seguridad de Windows.
Firewall_BlocksEverything.de: Die Windows-Firewall blockiert in diesem Netzwerk alle eingehenden Verbindungen, daher können Lautsprecher und andere Computer keine Verbindung zu rpm herstellen. Du kannst das in Windows-Sicherheit ändern.
Firewall_BlocksEverything.zh-Hans: Windows 防火墙正在此网络上阻止所有传入连接，因此扬声器和其他电脑无法连接到 rpm。你可以在 Windows 安全中心中更改此设置。
Firewall_BlocksEverything.comment: Cast menu and library settings (sharing), Windows only. The firewall's 'block all incoming connections' setting is on; no rule can fix it. A button that opens Windows Security follows (Firewall_OpenSecurity).

Firewall_StillBlocked.en: Windows Firewall still blocks rpm on this network. Your organisation may manage the firewall on this computer.
Firewall_StillBlocked.fr: Le pare-feu Windows bloque toujours rpm sur ce réseau. Votre organisation gère peut-être le pare-feu de cet ordinateur.
Firewall_StillBlocked.es: El Firewall de Windows sigue bloqueando rpm en esta red. Puede que tu organización administre el firewall de este equipo.
Firewall_StillBlocked.de: Die Windows-Firewall blockiert rpm in diesem Netzwerk weiterhin. Möglicherweise verwaltet deine Organisation die Firewall auf diesem Computer.
Firewall_StillBlocked.zh-Hans: Windows 防火墙仍在此网络上阻止 rpm。这台电脑的防火墙可能由你的组织管理。
Firewall_StillBlocked.comment: Cast menu and library settings (sharing), Windows only. Shown instead of Firewall_CastBlocked or Firewall_ShareBlocked after the person allowed rpm and the firewall still blocks it.

Firewall_Allow.es: Permitir en el Firewall de Windows
Firewall_Allow.zh-Hans: 在 Windows 防火墙中允许
Firewall_Allow.comment: Button under Firewall_CastBlocked or Firewall_ShareBlocked. Starts the Windows administrator prompt that adds the firewall rule.

Firewall_OpenSecurity.zh-Hans: 打开 Windows 安全中心
Firewall_OpenSecurity.comment: Button under Firewall_BlocksEverything. Opens the Windows Security app at Firewall and network protection.

Firewall_AskTitle.fr: Autoriser rpm dans le pare-feu Windows ?
Firewall_AskTitle.es: ¿Permitir rpm en el Firewall de Windows?
Firewall_AskTitle.zh-Hans: 允许 rpm 通过 Windows 防火墙吗？
Firewall_AskTitle.comment: Title of the question shown when a speaker is picked in the cast menu and Windows Firewall is blocking rpm. Windows only.

Firewall_AskBody.en: Windows Firewall is blocking rpm on this network, so {0} can't play music from this computer. Windows will ask you to confirm the change.
Firewall_AskBody.fr: Le pare-feu Windows bloque rpm sur ce réseau. {0} ne peut donc pas lire la musique de cet ordinateur. Windows vous demandera de confirmer la modification.
Firewall_AskBody.es: El Firewall de Windows está bloqueando rpm en esta red, así que {0} no puede reproducir música de este ordenador. Windows te pedirá que confirmes el cambio.
Firewall_AskBody.de: Die Windows-Firewall blockiert rpm in diesem Netzwerk, daher kann {0} keine Musik von diesem Computer abspielen. Windows bittet dich, die Änderung zu bestätigen.
Firewall_AskBody.zh-Hans: Windows 防火墙正在此网络上阻止 rpm，因此 {0} 无法播放这台电脑上的音乐。Windows 会请你确认此更改。
Firewall_AskBody.comment: Body of the question under Firewall_AskTitle. {0} is the speaker's name. The Windows administrator prompt follows if the person chooses Allow.

Firewall_AskAllow.comment: Primary button of the question under Firewall_AskTitle. The other button is Common_Cancel, which cancels the cast.

Transport_Stop.comment: Player transport: tooltip and accessible name of the stop button, on the deck at the bottom of the window and in the mini player.

Transport_Shuffle.comment: Mini player: tooltip and accessible name of the shuffle toggle.

Transport_Repeat.comment: Mini player: tooltip and accessible name of the repeat toggle.

Transport_VolumeDown.comment: Deck at the bottom of the window: tooltip and accessible name of the minus key left of the volume slider.

Transport_VolumeUp.comment: Deck at the bottom of the window: tooltip and accessible name of the plus key right of the volume slider.

Window_Minimize.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the minimize button in the window's own title bar (Windows) and in the mini player.

Window_Maximize.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the maximize button in the window's own title bar on Windows, while the window is not maximized.

Window_Restore.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the same button while the window is maximized: it returns the window to its earlier size.

Window_Close.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the close button in the window's own title bar (Windows), of the mini player, and of the mini player's collection panel.

Amp_Collection.comment: Mini player: tooltip and accessible name of the list key that shows or hides the collection panel.

Amp_KeepOnTop.comment: Mini player: tooltip and accessible name of the pin toggle that keeps the mini player above other windows.

Amp_Columns.comment: Mini player's collection panel: tooltip and accessible name of the key that opens the list of columns to show.

Deck_MenuTip.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the menu pill at the right end of the deck at the bottom of the window.

Shell_Menu.comment: Accessible name of the menu key in the top right of the main window, which opens Settings, the account and Help.

Row_ScrollLeft.comment: Accessible name of the arrow key at the left end of a row of cards, on the home screen and on an artist's page. Moves the row back by a page.

Row_ScrollRight.comment: Accessible name of the arrow key at the right end of a row of cards, on the home screen and on an artist's page. Moves the row on by a page.

Common_MoreOptions.comment: Accessible name of a key showing three dots that opens a menu: on a review or comment on the album page, on an album in the album list, on a post on an artist's wall.

Playlists_Expand.comment: Accessible name of the chevron before a playlist folder in the playlist tree, while the folder is closed.

Playlists_Collapse.comment: Accessible name of the same chevron while the folder is open.

Radio_PlayStation.comment: Accessible name of the play key at the end of a station row in the internet radio pane, and of the play key on Pegasus's radio tuner page.

Radio_StopStation.comment: Accessible name of the same keys on the station that is playing; a press stops it.

Review_OneStar.comment: Accessible name of the first star in the review editor's rating row. A press rates the album one star.

Review_Stars.comment: Accessible name of the second to fifth star in the review editor's rating row. {0} is the number, 2 to 5.

Home_FeatureDot.comment: Accessible name of a dot under the home screen's banner. A press shows that card. {0} is the card's number, {1} how many cards there are.

Transport_Mute.comment: Deck at the bottom of the window: tooltip and accessible name of the speaker mark left of the volume keys while there is sound. A click takes the level to zero.

Transport_Unmute.comment: The same speaker mark while the level is zero. A click puts back the level it was at.

App_Name.comment: The app's name under its icon and on its banner in the Android TV launcher, and the wordmark's spoken name. The brand name, written the same in every language.

Tv_SignIn_Scan.en: Scan a code with your phone's camera and sign in on your phone.
Tv_SignIn_Scan.fr: Scannez un code avec l'appareil photo de votre téléphone et connectez-vous sur votre téléphone.
Tv_SignIn_Scan.es: Escanea un código con la cámara de tu teléfono e inicia sesión en el teléfono.
Tv_SignIn_Scan.de: Scanne einen Code mit der Kamera deines Telefons und melde dich auf dem Telefon an.
Tv_SignIn_Scan.zh-Hans: 用手机相机扫描二维码，然后在手机上登录。
Tv_SignIn_Scan.comment: Android TV sign-in screen, under the two QR codes (Google and Apple). The person scans one with a phone and finishes signing in there; the TV signs in by itself.

Tv_Library_Empty.en: Nothing here yet. Upload your library from rpm on your computer and it appears here.
Tv_Library_Empty.fr: Rien pour l'instant. Envoyez votre bibliothèque depuis rpm sur votre ordinateur et elle apparaîtra ici.
Tv_Library_Empty.es: Aquí no hay nada todavía. Sube tu biblioteca desde rpm en tu ordenador y aparecerá aquí.
Tv_Library_Empty.de: Hier ist noch nichts. Lade deine Bibliothek mit rpm auf deinem Computer hoch, dann erscheint sie hier.
Tv_Library_Empty.zh-Hans: 这里还没有内容。在电脑上用 rpm 上传你的音乐库后就会出现在这里。
Tv_Library_Empty.comment: Android TV album wall when the signed-in account has no music in the cloud.

Tv_Library_ReadingCount.zh-Hans: 正在读取你的音乐库（{0} 首曲目）
Tv_Library_ReadingCount.comment: Android TV: under the rpm logo on the opening screen while the library is read from the cloud with nothing cached on the TV. {0} is how many tracks have arrived so far.

Tv_MenuExit.comment: Android TV: the key at the foot of the side menu. Leaves the app. The desktop's says Exit Pegasus (Viz_MenuExit), because there it leaves the full-screen view; on the TV the whole app is that view.

Tv_Radio_AddFavorite.comment: Entry in a station's menu on the Android TV radio screen (held OK or the Menu key on a station). Keeps the station in the favorite stations row.

Tv_Radio_RemoveFavorite.comment: Entry in a station's menu on the Android TV radio screen, for a station that is a favorite.

Tv_Radio_NoFavorites.en: No favorite stations yet. Hold OK on a station and choose Add to favorites.
Tv_Radio_NoFavorites.fr: Aucune station favorite pour l'instant. Maintenez OK sur une station et choisissez Ajouter aux favoris.
Tv_Radio_NoFavorites.es: Aún no hay emisoras favoritas. Mantén pulsado OK sobre una emisora y elige Añadir a favoritos.
Tv_Radio_NoFavorites.de: Noch keine Lieblingssender. Halte OK auf einem Sender gedrückt und wähle Zu Favoriten hinzufügen.
Tv_Radio_NoFavorites.zh-Hans: 还没有收藏的电台。在电台上按住 OK 并选择“添加到收藏”。
Tv_Radio_NoFavorites.comment: Shown on the Android TV radio screen under the favorite stations heading when no station is a favorite.

Tv_Menu_Computers.comment: Entry in the Android TV side menu and heading of the screen listing the computers on the network that share rpm.

Tv_SignIn_Intro.en: (re)discover your music collection. Sign in using one of the following methods:
Tv_SignIn_Intro.fr: (Re)découvrez votre collection musicale. Connectez-vous avec l'une des méthodes suivantes :
Tv_SignIn_Intro.es: (Re)descubre tu colección de música. Inicia sesión con uno de los siguientes métodos:
Tv_SignIn_Intro.de: Entdecke deine Musiksammlung (neu). Melde dich mit einer der folgenden Methoden an:
Tv_SignIn_Intro.zh-Hans: （重新）发现你的音乐收藏。请选择以下一种方式登录：
Tv_SignIn_Intro.comment: Text under the logo on the Android TV sign-in screen, above the sign-in options.

Tv_SignIn_WithGoogle.comment: Option on the Android TV sign-in screen. Opens a QR code for signing in with Google.

Tv_SignIn_WithApple.comment: Option on the Android TV sign-in screen. Opens a QR code for signing in with Apple.

Tv_SignIn_WithAccount.en: Sign in with an rpm account
Tv_SignIn_WithAccount.fr: Se connecter avec un compte rpm
Tv_SignIn_WithAccount.es: Iniciar sesión con una cuenta de rpm
Tv_SignIn_WithAccount.zh-Hans: 使用 rpm 账户登录
Tv_SignIn_WithAccount.comment: Option on the Android TV sign-in screen. Opens a QR code for signing in with an rpm email and password.

Tv_SignIn_ScanThis.en: Scan the code with your phone's camera and sign in on your phone.
Tv_SignIn_ScanThis.fr: Scannez le code avec l'appareil photo de votre téléphone et connectez-vous sur votre téléphone.
Tv_SignIn_ScanThis.es: Escanea el código con la cámara del teléfono e inicia sesión en el teléfono.
Tv_SignIn_ScanThis.de: Scanne den Code mit der Kamera deines Telefons und melde dich auf dem Telefon an.
Tv_SignIn_ScanThis.zh-Hans: 用手机相机扫描此代码，然后在手机上登录。
Tv_SignIn_ScanThis.comment: Under the QR code in the Android TV sign-in pop-up.

Tv_SignIn_Done.fr: Vous êtes connecté en tant que {0}.
Tv_SignIn_Done.zh-Hans: 你已以 {0} 的身份登录。
Tv_SignIn_Done.comment: Shown on the Android TV after signing in. {0} is the account's name or email.

Tv_Setup_Continue.comment: Button under the signed-in message on the Android TV. Opens the first set-up screen.

Tv_Setup_PictureTitle.comment: Title of the first Android TV set-up screen.

Tv_Setup_PictureHint.en: Choose the colours that look best on your TV.
Tv_Setup_PictureHint.fr: Choisissez les couleurs qui rendent le mieux sur votre téléviseur.
Tv_Setup_PictureHint.es: Elige los colores que mejor se ven en tu televisor.
Tv_Setup_PictureHint.de: Wähle die Farben, die auf deinem Fernseher am besten aussehen.
Tv_Setup_PictureHint.zh-Hans: 选择在你的电视上效果最好的颜色。
Tv_Setup_PictureHint.comment: Under the title of the first Android TV set-up screen, above the colour samples.

Tv_Setup_ViewTitle.comment: Title of the second Android TV set-up screen, where the player's opening layout is chosen.

Tv_Setup_ViewHint.en: Choose how the player looks when it opens. You can change this later in Settings.
Tv_Setup_ViewHint.fr: Choisissez l'apparence du lecteur à l'ouverture. Vous pourrez la modifier plus tard dans les paramètres.
Tv_Setup_ViewHint.es: Elige cómo se ve el reproductor al abrirse. Puedes cambiarlo más tarde en Ajustes.
Tv_Setup_ViewHint.de: Wähle, wie der Player beim Öffnen aussieht. Du kannst das später in den Einstellungen ändern.
Tv_Setup_ViewHint.zh-Hans: 选择播放器打开时的外观。你可以稍后在设置中更改。
Tv_Setup_ViewHint.comment: Under the title of the second Android TV set-up screen.

Tv_Setup_Next.comment: Button on the first Android TV set-up screen.

Tv_Setup_Finish.comment: Button on the last Android TV set-up screen. Opens the app.

Tv_Setup_LibraryTitle.comment: Title of the third Android TV set-up screen, where the albums screen is chosen as a grid or a carousel.

Tv_Setup_LibraryHint.en: Choose how your albums are shown.
Tv_Setup_LibraryHint.fr: Choisissez comment vos albums sont affichés.

Rpm_PlaylistWrite_NotYours.en: That playlist belongs to somebody else.
